info.name: Alfresco Share - Open Redirect
info.author: pdteam
info.description: Alfresco Share before 5.2.6, 6.0.N and 6.1.N contains an open redirect vulnerability via a crafted POST request. An attacker can redirect a user to a malicious site and possibly obtain sensitive information, modify data, and/or execute unauthorized operations.
info.impact: An attacker can trick users into visiting a malicious website, leading to potential phishing attacks or the disclosure of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches or updates provided by Alfresco to fix the open redirect vulnerability.

info.name: T24 Web Server - Local File Inclusion
info.author: 0x_Akoko
info.description: T24 web server is vulnerable to unauthenticated local file inclusion that permits an attacker to exfiltrate data directly from server.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to read sensitive files on the server, potentially leading to unauthorized access or information disclosure.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches or updates provided by the vendor to fix the LFI vulnerability in the T24 Web Server.

info.name: Aptana Jaxer 1.0.3.4547 - Local File inclusion
info.author: daffainfo
info.description: Aptana Jaxer 1.0.3.4547 is vulnerable to local file inclusion in the wikilite source code viewer. An attacker can read internal files on the server via a tools/sourceViewer/index.html?filename=../ URI.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to read sensitive files on the server, leading to unauthorized access and potential data leakage.
info.remediation: Upgrade to a patched version of Aptana Jaxer or apply the necessary security patches to mitigate the LFI vulnerability.

info.name: Pallets Werkzeug <0.15.5 - Local File Inclusion
info.author: madrobot
info.description: Pallets Werkzeug before 0.15.5 is susceptible to local file inclusion because SharedDataMiddleware mishandles drive names (such as C:) in Windows pathnames.
info.impact: The LFI vulnerability can lead to unauthorized access to sensitive files, potential data leakage, and remote code execution.
info.remediation: Upgrade Pallets Werkzeug to version 0.15.5 or above to mitigate the LFI vulnerability.

info.name: WordPress UserPro 4.9.32 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: daffainfo
info.description: WordPress UserPro 4.9.32 is vulnerable to reflected cross-site scripting because the Instagram PHP API (v2) it relies on allows it via the example/success.php error_description parameter.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the context of the victim's browser, potentially leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version of UserPro or apply the provided patch to fix the XSS vulnerability.

info.name: OpenEMR <5.0.2 - Local File Inclusion
info.author: TenBird
info.description: OpenEMR before 5.0.2 is vulnerable to local file inclusion via the fileName parameter in custom/ajax_download.php. An attacker can download any file (that is readable by the web server user) from server storage. If the requested file is writable for the web server user and the directory /var/www/openemr/sites/default/documents/cqm_qrda/ exists, the file will be deleted from server.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to access sensitive information, such as configuration files, credentials, or other sensitive data.
info.remediation: Upgrade OpenEMR to version 5.0.2 or later to mitigate the LFI vulnerability.

info.name: Open-School 3.0/Community Edition 2.3 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: Open-School 3.0, and Community Edition 2.3, allows cross-site scripting via the osv/index.php?r=students/guardians/create id parameter.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the context of the victim's browser, leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: To remediate this issue, it is recommended to implement proper input validation and sanitization techniques to prevent the execution of malicious scripts.

info.name: osTicket < 1.12.1 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: TenBird
info.description: An issue was discovered in osTicket before 1.10.7 and 1.12.x before 1.12.1. Stored XSS exists in setup/install.php. It was observed that no input sanitization was provided in the firstname and lastname fields of the application. The insertion of malicious queries in those fields leads to the execution of those queries. This can further lead to cookie stealing or other malicious actions.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the context of the victim's browser, leading to potential data theft or unauthorized actions.
info.remediation: Upgrade osTicket to version 1.12.1 or later to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Custom 404 Pro < 3.2.8 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: r3Y3r53
info.description: Custom 404 Pro before 3.2.9 is susceptible to cross-site scripting via the title parameter due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. An attacker can inject arbitrary script in the browser of an unsuspecting user in the context of the affected site. This can allow the attacker to steal cookie-based authentication credentials and launch other attacks.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute malicious scripts in the context of the victim's browser, potentially leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Update to Custom 404 Pro version 3.2.8 or later to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Meta Box <= 4.16.2 - Arbitrary File Deletion
info.author: ritikchaddha
info.description: The Meta Box plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to arbitrary file deletion in the ajax_delete_file function. The function accepts any attachment_id from the POST request and directly calls wp_delete_attachment() or unlink() without validating that the attachment belongs to the specified Meta Box field, without path traversal protection on the unlink path, and without any ownership or authorization checks. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers to delete arbitrary files on the server including wp-config.php.
info.impact: Authenticated attackers can delete arbitrary files on the server. Deleting wp-config.php triggers the WordPress installation wizard, allowing the attacker to reconfigure the database connection and achieve remote code execution.
info.remediation: Update Meta Box to version 4.16.3 or later, which adds in_array validation to verify the attachment is stored in the field value and upload_dir path normalization to ensure deletion stays within ABSPATH.

info.name: WP Live Chat Support <= 8.0.27 — Stored Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: daffainfo
info.description: wp-live-chat-support plugin before 8.0.27 for WordPress contains a reflected cross-site scripting caused by insufficient sanitization in the GDPR page, letting attackers execute arbitrary scripts in the context of the victim's browser, exploit requires victim to visit a malicious page.
info.impact: Attackers can execute arbitrary scripts in the victim's browser, potentially leading to session hijacking or defacement.
info.remediation: Update to version 8.0.27 or later.

info.name: SugarCRM Enterprise 9.0.0 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: madrobot
info.description: SugarCRM Enterprise 9.0.0 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability via mobile/error-not-supported-platform.html?desktop_url.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the context of the victim's browser, leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patch or upgrade to a non-vulnerable version of SugarCRM Enterprise.

info.name: Grafana - Improper Access Control
info.author: Joshua Rogers
info.description: Grafana 2.x through 6.x before 6.3.4 is susceptible to improper access control. An attacker can delete and create arbitrary snapshots, leading to denial of service.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to gain unauthorized access to sensitive information or perform unauthorized actions.
info.remediation: Upgrade to 6.3.4 or higher.

info.name: Webmin <= 1.920 - Unauthenticated Remote Command Execution
info.author: bp0lr
info.description: Webmin <=1.920. is vulnerable to an unauthenticated remote command execution via the parameter 'old' in password_change.cgi.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges.
info.remediation: Upgrade to Webmin version 1.930 or later to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: L-Soft LISTSERV <16.5-2018a - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: LogicalHunter,arafatansari
info.description: L-Soft LISTSERV before 16.5-2018a contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability via the /scripts/wa.exe OK parameter.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the context of the victim's browser, leading to potential data theft or unauthorized actions.
info.remediation: Upgrade to a version of L-Soft LISTSERV that is higher than 16.5-2018a to mitigate the XSS vulnerability.

info.name: Webmin < 1.920 - Authenticated Remote Code Execution
info.author: pussycat0x
info.description: rpc.cgi in Webmin through 1.920 allows authenticated Remote Code Execution via a crafted object name because unserialise_variable makes an eval call. NOTE: the Webmin_Servers_Index documentation states "RPC can be used to run any command or modify any file on a server, which is why access to it must not be granted to un-trusted Webmin users."
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability allows an authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code on the target system.
info.remediation: Upgrade Webmin to version 1.920 or later to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: WordPress My Calendar <= 3.1.9 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: daffainfo,dhiyaneshDk
info.description: WordPress plugin My Calendar <= 3.1.9 is susceptible to reflected cross-site scripting which can be triggered via unescaped usage of URL parameters in multiple locations throughout the site.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to inject malicious scripts into the affected website, leading to potential data theft, session hijacking, or defacement.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version of the My Calendar plugin (>= 3.1.10) or apply the vendor-provided patch to fix the XSS vulnerability.

info.name: ND Booking < 2.5 - Unauthenticated Options Change
info.author: popcorn94
info.description: The Hotel Booking WordPress plugin ND Booking < 2.5 was affected by an Unauthenticated Options Change security vulnerability.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can modify WordPress plugin options, potentially enabling development mode or altering plugin configuration to facilitate further attacks or compromise site functionality.
info.remediation: Update the ND Booking plugin to version 2.5 or later.

words: Updated option "nd_booking_plugin_dev_mode" with the same value.

info.name: DomainMOD <=4.13.0 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: arafatansari
info.description: DomainMOD through 4.13.0 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability via /reporting/domains/cost-by-month.php in Daterange parameters.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the context of the victim's browser, leading to potential data theft, session hijacking, or defacement of the affected website.
info.remediation: Upgrade to the latest version of DomainMOD (>=4.13.1) to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: WPS Hide Login <= 1.5.2.2  - Login Page Bypass
info.author: pussycat0x
info.description: WPS-Hide-Login plugin before 1.5.3 for WordPress contains an action=confirmaction protection bypass, letting attackers bypass security checks, exploit requires sending crafted requests.
info.impact: Attackers can bypass login protection, potentially leading to unauthorized access.
info.remediation: Update to version 1.5.3 or later.

info.name: Gallery Photoblocks < 1.1.43 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: r3Y3r53
info.description: The Gallery PhotoBlocks WordPress plugin was affected by an Authenticated Reflected XSS security vulnerability.
info.impact: Authenticated attackers can inject malicious JavaScript through the id parameter, potentially stealing admin session cookies or performing privileged actions on behalf of administrators.
info.remediation: Fixed in 1.1.43

info.name: WordPress Woody Ad Snippets <2.2.5 - Cross-Site Scripting/Remote Code Execution
info.author: dwisiswant0,fmunozs,patralos
info.description: WordPress Woody Ad Snippets prior to 2.2.5 is susceptible to cross-site scripting and remote code execution via admin/includes/class.import.snippet.php, which allows unauthenticated options import as demonstrated by storing a cross-site scripting payload for remote code execution.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could lead to unauthorized access, data theft, and remote code execution.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version of the Woody Ad Snippets plugin (2.2.5) or apply the vendor-provided patch to mitigate the vulnerability.

info.name: Socomec DIRIS A-40 Devices Password Disclosure
info.author: geeknik
info.description: Socomec DIRIS A-40 devices before 48250501 are susceptible to a password disclosure vulnerability in the web interface that could allow remote attackers to get full access to a device via the /password.jsn URI.
info.impact: An attacker can obtain sensitive information such as passwords, leading to unauthorized access.
info.remediation: Update the firmware of the Socomec DIRIS A-40 devices to the latest version to mitigate the vulnerability.

info.name: WordPress Download Manager <2.9.94 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: daffainfo
info.description: WordPress Download Manager plugin before 2.9.94 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability via the category shortcode feature, as demonstrated by the orderby or search[publish_date] parameter.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could lead to the execution of arbitrary script code in the context of the affected website, potentially allowing an attacker to steal sensitive information or perform unauthorized actions.
info.remediation: Update WordPress Download Manager plugin to version 2.9.94 or later to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: D-Link DNS-320 - Remote Code Execution
info.author: DhiyaneshDk
info.description: The login_mgr.cgi script in D-Link DNS-320 through 2.05.B10 is vulnerable to remote command injection.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can lead to unauthorized access, data loss, and potential compromise of the affected device.
info.remediation: Apply the latest firmware update provided by D-Link to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Enigma NMS < 65.0.0 - Authenticated OS Command Injection
info.author: 0x_Akoko
info.description: An OS command injection vulnerability in the discover_and_manage CGI script in NETSAS Enigma NMS 65.0.0 and prior allows an authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code because of improper neutralization of shell metacharacters in the ip_address variable within an snmp_browser action.
info.impact: Attackers can execute arbitrary code on the server, potentially leading to full system compromise.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version of NETSAS Enigma NMS or apply security patches that fix input sanitization.

info.name: Harbor <=1.82.0 - Privilege Escalation
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: Harbor 1.7.0 through 1.8.2 is susceptible to privilege escalation via core/api/user.go, which allows allows non-admin users to create admin accounts via the POST /api/users API when Harbor is setup with DB as an authentication backend and allows user to do self-registration.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to escalate their privileges and gain unauthorized access to sensitive information.
info.remediation: Upgrade to v1.7.6 v1.8.3. v.1.9.0 or higher. A potential workaround without applying the fix is to configure Harbor to use a non-DB authentication backend such as LDAP.

info.name: PilusCart <=1.4.1 - Local File Inclusion
info.author: 0x_Akoko
info.description: PilusCart versions 1.4.1 and prior suffer from a file disclosure vulnerability via local file inclusion.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can lead to unauthorized access to sensitive files, potential data leakage, and remote code execution.
info.remediation: Upgrade to a patched version of PilusCart (>=1.4.2) or apply the vendor-supplied patch to mitigate the LFI vulnerability.

info.name: nostromo 1.9.6 - Remote Code Execution
info.author: pikpikcu

info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability allows an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the target system.
info.remediation: Upgrade to a patched version of nostromo web server (1.9.7 or later) or apply the vendor-supplied patch.

info.name: WordPress API Bearer Auth <20190907 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: daffainfo

info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to inject malicious scripts into web pages viewed by users, leading to potential data theft or unauthorized actions.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version of WordPress API Bearer Auth plugin (20190907 or later) to mitigate the vulnerability.

info.name: Adobe Experience Manager - Expression Language Injection
info.author: DomenicoVeneziano
info.description: Adobe Experience Manager versions 6.5, 6.4, 6.3, 6.2, 6.1, and 6.0 has an expression language injection vulnerability.
info.impact: Successful exploitation could lead to sensitive information disclosure
info.remediation: To fix the vulnerability, it is necessary to update the Adobe AEM instance using the Service Pack 6.5.3.0

info.name: WordPress Checklist <1.1.9 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: daffainfo
info.description: WordPress Checklist plugin before 1.1.9 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability. The fill parameter is not correctly filtered in the checklist-icon.php file.
info.impact: Allows attackers to inject malicious scripts into web pages viewed by users, leading to potential data theft or unauthorized actions.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version of the WordPress Checklist plugin (1.1.9 or higher) to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Cisco Small Business WAN VPN Routers - Sensitive Information Disclosure
info.author: dwisiswant0
info.description: Cisco Small Business RV320 and RV325 Dual Gigabit WAN VPN Routers could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to retrieve sensitive information due to improper access controls for URLs. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by connecting to an affected device via HTTP or HTTPS and requesting specific URLs. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to download the router configuration or detailed diagnostic information.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to gain access to sensitive information, potentially leading to further attacks.
info.remediation: Cisco has released firmware updates that address this vulnerability.

info.name: rConfig 3.9.2 - Remote Code Execution
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: rConfig 3.9.2 is susceptible to a remote code execution vulnerability. An attacker can directly execute system commands by sending a GET request to ajaxServerSettingsChk.php because the rootUname parameter is passed to the exec function without filtering, which can lead to command execution.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can lead to unauthorized access, data theft, and complete compromise of the affected system.
info.remediation: Upgrade to a patched version of rConfig (3.9.3 or later) or apply the vendor-supplied patch to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: vBulletin 5.0.0-5.5.4 - Remote Command Execution
info.author: madrobot
info.description: vBulletin 5.0.0 through 5.5.4 is susceptible to a remote command execution vulnerability via the widgetConfig parameter in an ajax/render/widget_php routestring request. An attacker can execute malware, obtain sensitive information, modify data, and/or gain full control over a compromised system without entering necessary credentials.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands on the target system.
info.remediation: Upgrade vBulletin to a version that is not affected by CVE-2019-16759.

info.name: D-Link Routers - Remote Code Execution
info.author: dwisiswant0
info.description: D-Link products such as DIR-655C, DIR-866L, DIR-652, and DHP-1565 contain an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability. The issue occurs when the attacker sends an arbitrary input to a "PingTest" device common gateway interface that could lead to common injection. An attacker who successfully triggers the command injection could achieve full system compromise. Later, it was independently found that these issues also affected; DIR-855L, DAP-1533, DIR-862L, DIR-615, DIR-835, and DIR-825.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability allows an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the affected router, potentially leading to complete compromise of the device and the network it is connected to.

info.name: WordPress Visualizer <3.3.1 - Cross-Site Scripting

info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to inject malicious scripts into web pages viewed by users, leading to potential data theft, session hijacking, or defacement of the affected website.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version of WordPress Visualizer plugin (3.3.1) or apply the provided patch to fix the XSS vulnerability.

info.name: Visualizer <3.3.1 - Blind Server-Side Request Forgery

info.remediation: Update Visualizer plugin to version 3.3.1 or later to fix the SSRF vulnerability.

info.name: Yachtcontrol Webapplication 1.0 - Remote Command Injection
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: Yachtcontrol Webapplication 1.0 makes it possible to perform direct operating system commands as an unauthenticated user via the "/pages/systemcall.php?command={COMMAND}" page and parameter, where {COMMAND} will be executed and returning the results to the client. Affects Yachtcontrol webservers disclosed via Dutch GPRS/4G mobile IP-ranges. IP addresses vary due to DHCP client leasing of telco's.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands on the target system.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches or updates provided by the vendor to fix the remote command injection vulnerability.

info.name: Zabbix <=4.4 - Authentication Bypass
info.author: harshbothra_
info.description: Zabbix through 4.4 is susceptible to an authentication bypass vulnerability via zabbix.php?action=dashboard.view&dashboardid=1. An attacker can bypass the login page and access the dashboard page, and then create a Dashboard, Report, Screen, or Map without any Username/Password (i.e., anonymously). All created elements (Dashboard/Report/Screen/Map) are accessible by other users and by an admin.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability allows an attacker to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the Zabbix application.
info.remediation: Upgrade to a patched version of Zabbix (>=4.4) to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: MetInfo 7.0.0 beta - SQL Injection
info.author: ritikchaddha
info.description: MetInfo 7.0.0 beta is susceptible to SQL injection via the admin/?n=language&c=language_general&a=doSearchParameter appno parameter (a different issue than CVE-2019-16997).
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary SQL queries, potentially leading to unauthorized access, data leakage, or data manipulation.
info.remediation: Upgrade to a patched version of MetInfo or apply the necessary security patches provided by the vendor.

info.name: Jfrog Artifactory <6.17.0 - Default Admin Password
info.author: pdteam
info.description: Jfrog Artifactory prior to 6.17.0 uses default passwords (such as "password") for administrative accounts and does not require users to change them. This may allow unauthorized network-based attackers to completely compromise of Jfrog Artifactory.
info.impact: An attacker can gain unauthorized access to the Jfrog Artifactory instance.
info.remediation: Upgrade Jfrog Artifactory to version 6.17.0 or later and change the default admin password to a strong, unique one.

info.name: Kirona Dynamic Resource Scheduler - Information Disclosure
info.author: LogicalHunter
info.description: Kirona Dynamic Resource Scheduler is susceptible to information disclosure. An unauthenticated user can directly access /osm/REGISTER.cmd (aka /osm_tiles/REGISTER.cmd), which contains sensitive information with exposed SQL queries, such as database version, table name, and column name.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can access sensitive information including database version, table names, and column names through exposed SQL queries, facilitating further SQL injection or database attacks.
info.remediation: Apply the latest patch or update provided by the vendor to fix the information disclosure vulnerability.

info.name: D-Link DIR-868L/817LW - Information Disclosure
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: D-Link DIR-868L B1-2.03 and DIR-817LW A1-1.04 routers are vulnerable to information disclosure vulnerabilities because certain web interfaces do not require authentication. An attacker can get the router's username and password (and other information) via a DEVICE.ACCOUNT value for SERVICES in conjunction with AUTHORIZED_GROUP=1%0a to getcfg.php. This could be used to control the router remotely.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to gain access to sensitive information, such as router configuration settings and credentials.
info.remediation: Apply the latest firmware update provided by D-Link to fix the information disclosure vulnerability.

info.name: Jiangnan Online Judge 0.8.0 - Local File Inclusion
info.author: pussycat0x
info.description: Jiangnan Online Judge (aka jnoj) 0.8.0 is susceptible to local file inclusion via web/polygon/problem/viewfile?id=1&name=../.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can lead to unauthorized access to sensitive information, including system files and credentials.
info.remediation: Upgrade Jiangnan Online Judge to a patched version or apply the necessary security patches to fix the Local File Inclusion vulnerability.

info.name: Apache Solr <=8.3.1 - Remote Code Execution
info.author: pikpikcu,madrobot
info.description: Apache Solr versions 5.0.0 to 8.3.1 are vulnerable to remote code execution vulnerabilities through the VelocityResponseWriter. A Velocity template can be provided through Velocity templates in a configset `velocity/ directory or as a parameter. A user defined configset could contain renderable, potentially malicious, templates. Parameter provided templates are disabled by default, but can be enabled by setting `params.resource.loader.enabled by defining a response writer with that setting set to `true`. Defining a response writer requires configuration API access. Solr 8.4 removed the params resource loader entirely, and only enables the configset-provided template rendering when the configset is `trusted` (has been uploaded by an authenticated user).
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability allows an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the affected system.
info.remediation: Upgrade to a patched version of Apache Solr (8.4.0 or later) to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Apache Dubbo 2.5.x-2.7.4 - Insecure Deserialization
info.author: Khalid6468
info.description: Unsafe deserialization occurs within a Dubbo application which has HTTP remoting enabled. An attacker may submit a POST request with a Java object in it to completely compromise a Provider instance of Apache Dubbo, if this instance enables HTTP. This issue affected Apache Dubbo 2.7.0 to 2.7.4, 2.6.0 to 2.6.7, and all 2.5.x versions.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can exploit unsafe deserialization to execute arbitrary code on Dubbo Provider instances with HTTP remoting enabled, leading to complete server compromise.
info.remediation: Upgrade to Apache Dubbo version 2.7.5 or later, or disable HTTP remoting if not required.

info.remediation: Update Popup-Maker plugin to version 1.8.12 or later.

info.name: ThinVNC 1.0b1 - Authentication Bypass
info.author: DhiyaneshDK
info.description: ThinVNC 1.0b1 is vulnerable to arbitrary file read, which leads to a compromise of the VNC server. The vulnerability exists even when authentication is turned on during the deployment of the VNC server. The password for authentication is stored in cleartext in a file that can be read via a ../../ThinVnc.ini directory traversal attack vector.
info.impact: An attacker can bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the ThinVNC application.
info.remediation: Upgrade to a patched version of ThinVNC or implement additional authentication mechanisms.

info.name: WordPress <= 5.2.4 - Unauthenticated View Private/Draft Posts
info.author: 0x_Akoko
info.description: WordPress before 5.2.4 contains an information disclosure caused by mishandling of the static query property, letting unauthenticated users view certain content, exploit requires no authentication.
info.impact: Unauthenticated users can view restricted content, leading to information disclosure.
info.remediation: Update to WordPress 5.2.4 or later.

info.name: Cisco Prime Infrastructure and Cisco Evolved Programmable Network Manager - Remote Code Execution
info.author: _0xf4n9x_
info.description: Cisco Prime Infrastructure (PI) and Cisco Evolved Programmable Network (EPN) Manager could allow an authenticated, remote attacker to execute code with root-level privileges on the underlying operating system. This vulnerability exist because the software improperly validates user-supplied input. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by uploading a malicious file to the administrative web interface. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to execute code with root-level privileges on the underlying operating system.
info.impact: Authenticated attackers can upload malicious files to execute code with root-level privileges on the underlying operating system, leading to complete system compromise and potential network infiltration.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches provided by Cisco to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Xiaomi Mi WiFi R3G Routers - Local file Inclusion
info.author: ritikchaddha
info.description: Xiaomi Mi WiFi R3G devices before 2.28.23-stable are susceptible to local file inclusion vulnerabilities via a misconfigured NGINX alias, as demonstrated by api-third-party/download/extdisks../etc/config/account. With this vulnerability, the attacker can bypass authentication.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can bypass authentication and read arbitrary files including configuration files containing credentials, potentially leading to complete router compromise.
info.remediation: Update the firmware of the Xiaomi Mi WiFi R3G routers to the latest version, which includes a fix for the local file inclusion vulnerability.

info.name: Ignite Realtime Openfire <4.42 - Local File Inclusion
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: Ignite Realtime Openfire through 4.4.2 is vulnerable to local file inclusion via PluginServlet.java. It does not ensure that retrieved files are located under the Openfire home directory.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can lead to unauthorized access to sensitive information, remote code execution, and potential compromise of the affected system.
info.remediation: Upgrade Ignite Realtime Openfire to version 4.42 or later to mitigate this vulnerability.

words: Most properties are stored in the Openfire database

info.name: Ignite Realtime Openfire <=4.4.2 - Server-Side Request Forgery
info.author: pdteam
info.description: Ignite Realtime Openfire through version 4.4.2 allows attackers to send arbitrary HTTP GET requests in FaviconServlet.java, resulting in server-side request forgery.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to send crafted requests to internal resources, leading to unauthorized access or information disclosure.
info.remediation: Upgrade to the latest version of Ignite Realtime Openfire (>=4.4.3) to fix this vulnerability.

info.name: DOMOS 5.5 - Local File Inclusion
info.author: 0x_Akoko
info.description: SECUDOS DOMOS before 5.6 allows local file inclusion via the log module.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to read sensitive files on the server.
info.remediation: Apply the latest patch or update to a version that is not affected by this vulnerability.

info.name: strapi CMS <3.0.0-beta.17.5 - Admin Password Reset
info.author: idealphase
info.description: strapi CMS before 3.0.0-beta.17.5 allows admin password resets because it mishandles password resets within packages/strapi-admin/controllers/Auth.js and packages/strapi-plugin-users-permissions/controllers/Auth.js.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to reset the admin password and gain unauthorized access to the Strapi CMS admin panel.
info.remediation: Upgrade Strapi CMS to a version higher than 3.0.0-beta.17.5 to mitigate the vulnerability.

info.name: Allied Telesis AT-GS950/8 - Local File Inclusion
info.author: 0x_Akoko
info.description: Allied Telesis AT-GS950/8 until Firmware AT-S107 V.1.1.3 is susceptible to local file inclusion via its web interface.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability allows an attacker to read arbitrary files on the affected device, leading to unauthorized access and potential data leakage.
info.remediation: Apply the latest firmware update provided by Allied Telesis to fix the vulnerability.

info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches and updates from the vendor to address this vulnerability.
info.impact: Attackers can upload malicious files and execute arbitrary code remotely, leading to full system compromise.

info.name: MicroStrategy Library <11.1.3 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: tess
info.description: MicroStrategy Library before 11.1.3 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability. An attacker can inject arbitrary script in the browser of an unsuspecting user in the context of the affected site. This can allow the attacker to steal cookie-based authentication credentials and launch other attacks.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the context of the victim's browser, leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: The issue can be resolved by downloading and installing 1.1.3, which has the patch.

info.name: Cisco RV110W RV130W RV215W Router - Information leakage
info.author: SleepingBag945
info.description: A vulnerability in the web-based management interface of Cisco RV110W, RV130W, and RV215W Routers could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to access the syslog file on an affected device. The vulnerability is due to improper authorization of an HTTP request. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by accessing the URL for the syslog file. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to access the information contained in the file.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to gain sensitive information from the router.
info.remediation: Apply the latest firmware update provided by Cisco to fix the vulnerability.

info.name: WordPress Hero Maps Premium <=2.2.1 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: daffainfo
info.description: WordPress Hero Maps Premium plugin 2.2.1 and prior contains an unauthenticated reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability via the views/dashboard/index.php p parameter.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to inject malicious scripts into the affected website, leading to potential data theft, session hijacking, or defacement.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version of the WordPress Hero Maps Premium plugin (>=2.2.2) or apply the vendor-provided patch to fix the XSS vulnerability.

info.name: Rumpus FTP Web File Manager 8.2.9.1 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: madrobot
info.description: Rumpus FTP Web File Manager 8.2.9.1 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability via the Login page. An attacker can send a crafted link to end users and can execute arbitrary JavaScript.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the context of the victim's browser, leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Upgrade to the latest version of Rumpus FTP Web File Manager or apply the vendor-provided patch to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Huawei Firewall - Local File Inclusion
info.author: taielab
info.description: USG9500 with versions of V500R001C30SPC100, V500R001C30SPC200, V500R001C30SPC600, V500R001C60SPC500, V500R005C00SPC100, V500R005C00SPC200 have an information leakage vulnerability. Due to improper processing of the initialization vector used in a specific encryption algorithm, an attacker who gains access to this cryptographic primitive may exploit this vulnerability to cause the value of the confidentiality associated with its use to be diminished.
info.impact: Attackers with network access can exploit the weakened encryption to potentially recover confidential information that was meant to be protected by the encryption algorithm.
info.remediation: Upgrade to a patched firmware version provided by Huawei or apply vendor-recommended mitigations.

info.name: Cisco Small Business 200,300 and 500 Series Switches - Open Redirect
info.author: bhutch
info.description: Cisco Small Business 200,300 and 500 Series Switches contain an open redirect vulnerability in the Web UI. An attacker can redirect a user to a malicious site and possibly obtain sensitive information, modify data, and/or execute unauthorized operations.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to redirect users to malicious websites, leading to phishing attacks or the download of malware.
info.remediation: Apply the necessary patches or updates provided by Cisco to fix the open redirect vulnerability.

info.name: Citrix ADC and Gateway - Directory Traversal
info.author: organiccrap,geeknik
info.description: Citrix Application Delivery Controller (ADC) and Gateway 10.5, 11.1, 12.0, 12.1, and 13.0 are susceptible to directory traversal vulnerabilities.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can lead to unauthorized access to sensitive information, potential data leakage, and further compromise of the affected system.
info.remediation: Apply the necessary security patches provided by Citrix to fix the directory traversal vulnerability.

info.name: TOTOLINK/Realtek Routers - Information Disclosure
info.author: ritikchaddha
info.description: A certain router administration interface using Realtek APMIB (e.g., on TOTOLINK models) allows unauthenticated remote attackers to disclose the entire router configuration, including sensitive credentials, via accessing the "config.dat" file. Affected devices include TOTOLINK A3002RU through 2.0.0, A702R through 2.1.3, N301RT through 2.1.6, N302R through 3.4.0, N300RT through 3.4.0, N200RE through 4.0.0, N150RT through 3.4.0, N100RE through 3.4.0, and other Realtek SDK-based devices.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can retrieve the entire router configuration including Wi-Fi passwords, admin credentials, and network settings, enabling complete network takeover.
info.remediation: Upgrade to firmware versions beyond those listed as vulnerable, or replace affected devices with patched alternatives.

info.name: TOTOLINK/Realtek Routers - Information Disclosure
info.author: ritikchaddha
info.description: A certain router administration interface using Realtek APMIB (e.g., on TOTOLINK models) allows unauthenticated remote attackers to disclose the entire router configuration, including sensitive credentials, via accessing the "config.dat" file. Affected devices include TOTOLINK A3002RU through 2.0.0, A702R through 2.1.3, N301RT through 2.1.6, N302R through 3.4.0, N300RT through 3.4.0, N200RE through 4.0.0, N150RT through 3.4.0, N100RE through 3.4.0, and other Realtek SDK-based devices.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can retrieve the entire router configuration including Wi-Fi passwords, admin credentials, and network settings, enabling complete network takeover.
info.remediation: Upgrade to firmware versions beyond those listed as vulnerable, or replace affected devices with patched alternatives.

info.name: TOTOLINK Realtek SD Routers - Remote Command Injection
info.author: gy741
info.description: TOTOLINK Realtek SDK based routers may allow an authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary OS commands via the sysCmd parameter to the boafrm/formSysCmd URI, even if the GUI (syscmd.htm) is not available. This allows for full control over the device's internals. This affects A3002RU through 2.0.0, A702R through 2.1.3, N301RT through 2.1.6, N302R through 3.4.0, N300RT through 3.4.0, N200RE through 4.0.0, N150RT through 3.4.0, and N100RE through 3.4.0.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands on the affected device.
info.remediation: Apply the latest firmware update provided by the vendor to fix the vulnerability.

info.name: TOTOLINK/Realtek Routers - CAPTCHA Bypass
info.author: ritikchaddha
info.description: On certain TOTOLINK Realtek SDK based routers, the CAPTCHA text can be retrieved via a POST request to the boafrm/formLogin URI with the JSON payload {"topicurl":"setting/getSanvas"}. This allows an unauthenticated attacker to bypass CAPTCHA verification, gaining unauthorized access to restricted functions. Once valid credentials are known or brute-forced, an attacker can fully control the device using HTTP requests and Basic Authentication. Affected router models include A3002RU through 2.0.0, A702R through 2.1.3, N301RT through 2.1.6, N302R through 3.4.0, N300RT through 3.4.0, N200RE through 4.0.0, N150RT through 3.4.0, N100RE through 3.4.0, and other Realtek SDK-derived devices.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can bypass CAPTCHA verification to brute-force credentials and gain unauthorized administrative access, leading to complete device control and potential network compromise.
info.remediation: Upgrade to firmware versions beyond those listed as vulnerable, or replace affected devices with patched alternatives.

info.name: phpMyChat-Plus 1.98 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: madrobot
info.description: phpMyChat-Plus 1.98 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability via pmc_username parameter of pass_reset.php in password reset URL.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary script code in the context of the victim's browser, potentially leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Upgrade to a patched version of phpMyChat-Plus or apply the necessary security patches to mitigate the XSS vulnerability.

info.name: WordPress Email Subscribers & Newsletters <4.2.3 - Arbitrary File Retrieval
info.author: KBA@SOGETI_ESEC,madrobot,dwisiswant0
info.description: WordPress Email Subscribers & Newsletters plugin before 4.2.3 is susceptible to arbitrary file retrieval via a flaw that allows unauthenticated file download and user information disclosure. An attacker can  obtain sensitive information, modify data, and/or execute unauthorized administrative operations.
info.impact: An attacker can access sensitive files on the server, potentially leading to unauthorized access or data leakage.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version of WordPress Email Subscribers & Newsletters plugin (4.2.3) or apply the patch provided by the vendor.

info.name: TVT NVMS 1000 - Local File Inclusion
info.author: daffainfo
info.description: TVT NVMS-1000 devices allow GET /.. local file inclusion attacks.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to gain unauthorized access to sensitive information stored on the system.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches or updates provided by the vendor to fix the local file inclusion vulnerability in TVT NVMS 1000 software.

info.name: WordPress Laborator Neon Theme 2.0 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: knassar702
info.description: WordPress Laborator Neon theme 2.0 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability via the data/autosuggest-remote.php q parameter.
info.impact: Attackers can execute arbitrary JavaScript in victims' browsers, potentially stealing session cookies, credentials, or performing administrative actions on behalf of users.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patch or update provided by the theme developer to fix the XSS vulnerability.

info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can result in unauthorized access to the system, remote code execution, and potential compromise of sensitive data.
info.remediation: Apply the latest patch or update to Simple Employee Records System 1.0 to fix the unrestricted file upload vulnerability.

info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can execute arbitrary system commands via shell metacharacters, leading to complete server compromise and access to all managed systems.
info.remediation: Upgrade to KACE K1000 version 6.4 SP3 (6.4.120822) or later.

info.name: InfluxDB <1.7.6 - Authentication Bypass
info.author: pussycat0x,c-sh0
info.description: InfluxDB before 1.7.6 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability via the authenticate function in services/httpd/handler.go. A JWT token may have an empty SharedSecret (aka shared secret). An attacker can possibly obtain sensitive information, modify data, and/or execute unauthorized administrative operations in the context of the affected site.
info.impact: An attacker can bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the InfluxDB database.
info.remediation: Update Influxdb to version 1.7.6~rc0-1 or higher.

info.name: Easy WP SMTP <= 1.3.9 - Missing Authorization to Arbitrary Options Update
info.author: DhiyaneshDK
info.description: The Easy WP SMTP plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in versions up to, and including, 1.3.9. This is due to missing capability checks on the admin_init() function, in addition to insufficient input validation. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to modify the plugins settings and arbitrary options on the site that can be used to inject new administrative user accounts.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can modify plugin settings and arbitrary site options to inject new administrative user accounts, leading to complete WordPress site takeover.
info.remediation: Upgrade to Easy WP SMTP version 1.4.0 or later.

info.name: WordPress Advanced Access Manager - Path Traversal
info.author: riteshs4hu

This allows unauthenticated attackers to read any file on the server, including sensitive files such as wp-config.php
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can read sensitive files like wp-config.php, leading to information disclosure and potential further exploitation.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version of the plugin that addresses this vulnerability.

info.name: BEWARD N100 H.264 VGA IP Camera M2.1.6 - Arbitrary File Disclosure
info.author: geeknik,liangtovi-debug

info.impact: Authenticated attackers can read sensitive system files, potentially exposing critical information.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version or apply vendor patches addressing this vulnerability

info.name: Oracle Fusion Middleware WebCenter Sites 12.2.1.3.0 - Broken Access Control
info.author: leovalcante
info.description: Oracle Fusion Middleware WebCenter Sites 12.2.1.3.0 suffers from broken access control. Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in unauthorized access to critical data or complete access to all Oracle WebCenter Sites accessible data.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to gain unauthorized access to sensitive information or perform unauthorized actions.
info.remediation: Apply the necessary patches or updates provided by Oracle to fix the Broken Access Control vulnerability (CVE-2019-2578).

info.name: Oracle Fusion Middleware WebCenter Sites 12.2.1.3.0 - SQL Injection
info.author: leovalcante

info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary SQL commands, potentially leading to unauthorized access, data manipulation, or denial of service.
info.remediation: Apply the necessary patches or updates provided by Oracle to mitigate the SQL Injection vulnerability.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server Administration Console - Remote Code Execution
info.author: igibanez
info.description: The Oracle WebLogic Server component of Oracle Fusion Middleware (subcomponent: Web Services) versions 0.3.6.0.0, 12.1.3.0.0 and 12.2.1.3.0 contain an easily exploitable vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle WebLogic Server.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the affected system.
info.remediation: Apply the necessary patches or updates provided by Oracle to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Oracle Business Intelligence Publisher - XML External Entity Injection
info.author: madrobot
info.description: Oracle Business Intelligence Publisher is vulnerable to an XML external entity injection attack. The supported versions affected are 11.1.1.9.0, 12.2.1.3.0 and 12.2.1.4.0. This easily exploitable vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers with network access via HTTP to compromise BI Publisher.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to gain unauthorized access to sensitive information or disrupt the availability of the system.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches provided by Oracle to fix this vulnerability.

info.name: Atlassian Confluence Server - Path Traversal
info.author: harshbothra_
info.description: The Widget Connector macro in Atlassian Confluence Server before version 6.6.12 (the fixed version for 6.6.x), from version 6.7.0 before 6.12.3 (the fixed version for 6.12.x), from version 6.13.0 before 6.13.3 (the fixed version for 6.13.x), and from version 6.14.0 before 6.14.2 (the fixed version for 6.14.x), allows remote attackers to achieve path traversal and remote code execution on a Confluence Server or Data Center instance via server-side template injection.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can exploit server-side template injection to achieve path traversal and execute arbitrary code, leading to complete Confluence server compromise.
info.remediation: Apply the necessary security patches or upgrade to a patched version of Atlassian Confluence Server to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Atlassian Confluence Download Attachments - Remote Code Execution
info.author: rootxharsh,iamnoooob,pdresearch
info.description: Confluence Server and Data Center had a path traversal vulnerability in the downloadallattachments resource. A remote attacker who has permission to add attachments to pages and / or blogs or to create a new space or a personal space or who has 'Admin' permissions for a space can exploit this path traversal vulnerability to write files to arbitrary locations which can lead to remote code execution on systems that run a vulnerable version of Confluence Server or Data Center.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the affected system.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches provided by Atlassian to fix the vulnerability.

info.name: Atlassian Jira <7.13.3/8.0.0-8.1.1 - Incorrect Authorization
info.author: TechbrunchFR,milo2012
info.description: Atlasssian Jira before version 7.13.3 and from version 8.0.0 before version 8.1.1 is susceptible to incorrect authorization. The ManageFilters.jspa resource allows a remote attacker to enumerate usernames via an incorrect authorization check, thus possibly obtaining sensitive information, modifying data, and/or executing unauthorized operations.
info.impact: The vulnerability allows unauthorized users to access sensitive information or perform unauthorized actions.
info.remediation: Ensure this permission is restricted to specific groups that require it via Administration > System > Global Permissions. Turning the feature off will not affect existing filters and dashboards. If you change this setting, you will still need to update the existing filters and dashboards if they have already been shared publicly. Since Jira 7.2.10, a dark feature to disable site-wide anonymous access was introduced.

info.name: Jira < 8.1.1 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: pdteam
info.description: Jira before 8.1.1 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability via ConfigurePortalPages.jspa resource in the searchOwnerUserName parameter.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the context of the victim's browser, leading to potential session hijacking, data theft, or defacement.
info.remediation: Upgrade Jira to version 8.1.1 or later to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Jira - Incorrect Authorization
info.author: Ganofins
info.description: Jira before version 7.13.3, from version 8.0.0 before version 8.0.4, and from version 8.1.0 before version 8.1.1 is susceptible to an incorrect authorization check in the /rest/api/2/user/picker rest resource, enabling an attacker to enumerate usernames and gain improper access.
info.impact: This vulnerability can lead to unauthorized access to sensitive data, potential data breaches, and unauthorized actions within the Jira system.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches and updates provided by Atlassian to fix the vulnerability and ensure proper authorization controls are in place.

info.name: Spring Cloud Config Server - Local File Inclusion
info.author: madrobot
info.description: Spring Cloud Config Server versions 2.1.x prior to 2.1.2, 2.0.x prior to 2.0.4, 1.4.x prior to 1.4.6, and older unsupported versions are vulnerable to local file inclusion because they allow applications to serve arbitrary configuration files. An attacker can send a request using a specially crafted URL that can lead to a directory traversal attack.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to read arbitrary files on the server, potentially leading to unauthorized access or sensitive information disclosure.
info.remediation: Upgrade to a patched version of Spring Cloud Config Server or apply the recommended security patches.

info.name: LabKey Server Community Edition <18.3.0 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: princechaddha
info.description: LabKey Server Community Edition before 18.3.0-61806.763 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability via the onerror parameter in the /__r2/query endpoints, which allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to inject arbitrary JavaScript.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary scripts in the victim's browser, leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Upgrade LabKey Server Community Edition to version 18.3.0 or later to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: LabKey Server Community Edition <18.3.0 - Open Redirect
info.author: 0x_Akoko
info.description: LabKey Server Community Edition before 18.3.0-61806.763 contains an open redirect vulnerability via the /__r1/ returnURL parameter, which allows an attacker to redirect a user to a malicious site and possibly obtain sensitive information, modify data, and/or execute unauthorized operations.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to redirect users to malicious websites, leading to phishing attacks or the theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Upgrade LabKey Server Community Edition to version 18.3.0 or later to mitigate the vulnerability.

info.name: Barco/AWIND OEM Presentation Platform - Remote Command Injection
info.author: _0xf4n9x_
info.description: The Crestron AM-100 firmware 1.6.0.2, Crestron AM-101 firmware 2.7.0.1, Barco wePresent WiPG-1000P firmware 2.3.0.10, Barco wePresent WiPG-1600W before firmware 2.4.1.19, Extron ShareLink 200/250 firmware 2.0.3.4, Teq AV IT WIPS710 firmware 1.1.0.7, SHARP PN-L703WA firmware 1.4.2.3, Optoma WPS-Pro firmware 1.0.0.5, Blackbox HD WPS firmware 1.0.0.5, InFocus LiteShow3 firmware 1.0.16, and InFocus LiteShow4 2.0.0.7 are vulnerable to command injection via the file_transfer.cgi HTTP endpoint. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can use this vulnerability to execute operating system commands as root.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could lead to unauthorized remote code execution, potentially compromising the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the affected system.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches or updates provided by the vendor to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: IBM BigFix Platform - Information Disclosure
info.author: daffainfo
info.description: IBM BigFix Platform 9.2 and 9.5 contains an information disclosure vulnerability caused by not enabling authenticated access in relay, letting remote attackers query and gather update and fixlet information, exploit requires no authentication.
info.impact: Attackers can remotely gather sensitive update and fixlet deployment information, potentially aiding targeted attacks.
info.remediation: Enable authenticated access for relay to prevent unauthorized information queries.

info.name: IBM Planning Analytics - Authentication Bypass & Remote Code Execution Version Detection
info.author: 0x_Akoko
info.description: IBM Planning Analytics versions 2.0.0 through 2.0.8 are vulnerable to a configuration overwrite that allows an unauthenticated user to login as "admin", and then execute code as root or SYSTEM via TM1 scripting.
info.impact: Attackers can gain admin access and execute arbitrary code with SYSTEM privileges, leading to full system compromise.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version or 2.0.9 or apply the security patches provided by IBM.

info.name: YouPHPTube Encoder 2.3 - Remote Command Injection
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: YouPHPTube Encoder 2.3 is susceptible to a command injection vulnerability which could allow an attacker to compromise the server. These exploitable unauthenticated command injections exist via the parameter base64Url in /objects/getImage.php.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can lead to unauthorized remote code execution, potentially compromising the entire system.
info.remediation: Apply the latest patch or upgrade to a version that is not affected by this vulnerability.

info.name: YouPHPTube Encoder - Arbitrary File Write
info.author: pussycat0x
info.description: Exploitable unauthenticated command injections exist in YouPHPTube Encoder 2.3 a plugin for providing encoder functionality in YouPHPTube.The parameter base64Url in /objects/getImageMP4.php is vulnerable to a command injection attack.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can execute arbitrary system commands through command injection, leading to complete server compromise and potential access to all media content.
info.remediation: Upgrade to YouPHPTube Encoder version 2.4 or later, or apply vendor-provided security patches.

info.name: YouPHPTube Encoder 2.3 - Command Injection
info.author: pussycat0x
info.description: Exploitable unauthenticated command injections exist in YouPHPTube Encoder 2.3 a plugin for providing encoder functionality in YouPHPTube.The parameter base64Url in /objects/getImageMP4.php is vulnerable to a command injection attack.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can execute arbitrary system commands through command injection, leading to complete server compromise and potential access to all media content.
info.remediation: Upgrade to YouPHPTube Encoder version 2.4 or later, or apply vendor-provided security patches.

info.name: Rails File Content Disclosure
info.author: omarkurt
info.description: Rails <5.2.2.1, <5.1.6.2, <5.0.7.2, <4.2.11.1 and v3 are susceptible to a file content disclosure vulnerability because specially crafted accept headers can cause contents of arbitrary files on the target system's file system to be exposed.
info.impact: This vulnerability can lead to unauthorized access to sensitive information stored on the server.
info.remediation: Apply the patch provided by the Rails team or upgrade to a version that includes the fix.

info.name: Revive Adserver 4.2 - Remote Code Execution
info.author: omarjezi
info.description: Revive Adserver 4.2 is susceptible to remote code execution. An attacker can send a crafted payload to the XML-RPC invocation script and trigger the unserialize() call on the "what" parameter in the "openads.spc" RPC method. This can be exploited to perform various types of attacks, e.g. serialize-related PHP vulnerabilities or PHP object injection. It is possible, although unconfirmed, that the vulnerability has been used by some attackers in order to gain access to some Revive Adserver instances and deliver malware through them to third-party websites.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the target system.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches or upgrade to a newer version of Revive Adserver.

info.name: FortiOS - Insecure LDAP Configuration Detection
info.author: ayewo
info.description: The FortiGate LDAP configuration was detected to be insecure due to missing ca-cert, secure LDAPS, or server-identity-check, potentially exposing LDAP communications to credential interception or man-in-the-middle attacks under specific network conditions.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can intercept sensitive information by impersonating LDAP servers within the same subnet.
info.remediation: Configure LDAP server settings properly and disable default configurations; update to the latest firmware version.

info.name: WordPress Sell Media 2.4.1 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: dwisiswant0
info.description: WordPress Plugin Sell Media v2.4.1 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in /inc/class-search.php that allows remote attackers to inject arbitrary web script or HTML via the keyword parameter (aka $search_term or the Search field).
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute malicious scripts in the context of a victim's browser, potentially leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version of WordPress Sell Media or apply the vendor-provided patch to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Drupal - Remote Code Execution
info.author: madrobot
info.description: Drupal 8.5.x before 8.5.11 and Drupal 8.6.x before 8.6.10 V contain certain field types that do not properly sanitize data from non-form sources, which can lead to arbitrary PHP code execution in some cases.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the affected Drupal site.
info.remediation: Apply the official security patch provided by Drupal to fix the deserialization vulnerability.

info.name: Total Donations Plugin for WordPress < 2.0.6 - Arbitrary Options Update
info.author: DhiyaneshDK
info.description: Incorrect access control in migla_ajax_functions.php in the Calmar Webmedia Total Donations plugin through 2.0.5 for WordPress allows unauthenticated attackers to update arbitrary WordPress option values, leading to site takeover. These attackers can send requests to wp-admin/admin-ajax.php to call the miglaA_update_me action to change arbitrary options on affected sites. This can be used to enable new user registration and set the default role for new users to Administrator.
info.impact: Attackers can modify site options, enabling new user registration as Administrator, leading to site takeover.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version of the plugin where this issue is fixed.

info.name: W3 Total Cache 0.9.2.6-0.9.3 - Unauthenticated File Read / Directory Traversal
info.author: randomrobbie
info.description: WordPress plugin W3 Total Cache before version 0.9.4 allows remote attackers to read arbitrary files via the SubscribeURL field in SubscriptionConfirmation JSON data via pub/sns.php.
info.impact: An unauthenticated attacker can read sensitive files or traverse directories on the target system, potentially leading to unauthorized access or information disclosure.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version of W3 Total Cache plugin (0.9.3 or higher) to mitigate the vulnerability.

info.name: GitLab Enterprise Edition - Server-Side Request Forgery
info.author: ritikchaddha
info.description: An issue was discovered in GitLab Enterprise Edition before 11.5.8, 11.6.x before 11.6.6, and 11.7.x before 11.7.1. The Jira integration feature is vulnerable to an unauthenticated blind SSRF issue.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can exploit blind SSRF to access internal services, potentially retrieving sensitive information or performing unauthorized actions on internal systems.
info.remediation: Upgrade to GitLab Enterprise Edition 11.5.8, 11.6.6, 11.7.1 or later versions.

info.name: phpMyAdmin <4.8.5 - Local File Inclusion
info.author: pwnhxl
info.description: phpMyAdmin before 4.8.5 is susceptible to local file inclusion. When the AllowArbitraryServer configuration setting is set to true, an attacker can read, with the use of a rogue MySQL server, any file on the server that the web server's user can access. This is related to the mysql.allow_local_infile PHP configuration, and the inadvertent ignoring of options(MYSQLI_OPT_LOCAL_INFIL calls.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can lead to unauthorized access to sensitive files.
info.remediation: Upgrade phpMyAdmin to version 4.8.5 or later to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Pypiserver <1.2.5 - Carriage Return Line Feed Injection
info.author: 0x_Akoko
info.description: Pypiserver through 1.2.5 and below is susceptible to carriage return line feed injection. An attacker can set arbitrary HTTP headers and possibly conduct cross-site scripting attacks via a %0d%0a in a URI.
info.impact: Attackers can inject arbitrary HTTP headers through CRLF injection, potentially conducting cross-site scripting attacks or cache poisoning.
info.remediation: Upgrade to Pypiserver version 1.2.5 or later.

info.name: Magento - SQL Injection
info.author: MaStErChO
info.description: An unauthenticated user can execute SQL statements that allow arbitrary read access to the underlying database, which causes sensitive data leakage.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can execute SQL injection to extract sensitive database contents including customer information, payment details, and administrative credentials, potentially leading to complete store compromise.
info.remediation: This issue is fixed in Magento 2.1 prior to 2.1.18, Magento 2.2 prior to 2.2.9, Magento 2.3 prior to 2.3.2.

info.name: QNAP QTS and Photo Station 6.0.3 - Remote Command Execution
info.author: DhiyaneshDK
info.description: This improper access control vulnerability allows remote attackers to gain unauthorized access to the system. To fix these vulnerabilities, QNAP recommend updating Photo Station to their latest versions.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands on the target system.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patch or upgrade to a non-vulnerable version of QNAP QTS and Photo Station.

info.name: QNAP Photo Station - Path Traversal
info.author: s4e-io
info.description: QNAP devices running Photo Station contain an external control of file name or path vulnerability allowing remote attackers to access or modify system files.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can exploit path traversal to access or modify system files, potentially reading sensitive configuration files and credentials.
info.remediation: Upgrade to QNAP Photo Station version that addresses this vulnerability or apply vendor-provided patches.

info.name: Zarafa WebApp <=2.0.1.47791 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: pdteam
info.description: Zarafa WebApp 2.0.1.47791 and earlier contains an unauthenticated reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability. An attacker can execute arbitrary script code in the browser of an unsuspecting user in the context of the affected site.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the context of the victim's browser, leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: This is a discontinued product. The issue was fixed in later versions. However, some former Zarafa WebApp customers use the related Kopano product instead.

info.name: Sonatype Nexus Repository Manager  <3.15.0 - Remote Code Execution
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: Sonatype Nexus Repository Manager before 3.15.0 is susceptible to remote code execution.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the affected system.
info.remediation: Upgrade Sonatype Nexus Repository Manager to a version higher than 3.15.0.

info.name: eMerge E3 1.00-06 - Local File Inclusion
info.author: 0x_Akoko
info.description: Linear eMerge E3-Series devices are vulnerable to local file inclusion.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can lead to unauthorized access to sensitive information, remote code execution, and potential compromise of the affected system.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patch or update to a non-vulnerable version of eMerge E3.

info.name: Linear eMerge E3 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: arafatansari
info.description: Linear eMerge E3-Series devices are vulnerable to cross-site scripting via the 'layout' parameter.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary script code in the context of a user's browser, potentially leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches or updates provided by the vendor to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: eMerge E3 1.00-06 - Remote Code Execution
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: Linear eMerge E3-Series devices are susceptible to remote code execution vulnerabilities.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the affected system.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patch or update to a non-vulnerable version of eMerge E3.

info.name: Optergy Proton/Enterprise Building Management System - Open Redirect
info.author: 0x_Akoko
info.description: Optergy Proton/Enterprise Building Management System contains an open redirect vulnerability. An attacker can redirect a user to a malicious site and possibly obtain sensitive information, modify data, and/or execute unauthorized operations.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to redirect users to malicious websites, leading to phishing attacks or the download of malware.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches or updates provided by Optergy to fix the open redirect vulnerability.

info.name: Optergy Proton/Enterprise - Unauthenticated RCE via Backdoor Console
info.author: daffainfo
info.description: Optergy Proton/Enterprise devices allow Remote Root Code Execution via a Backdoor Console.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can exploit the backdoor console to execute arbitrary system commands with root privileges, leading to complete device compromise and control over building management systems.
info.remediation: Apply vendor-provided firmware updates or disable the affected console feature if possible.

info.name: Genie Access WIP3BVAF IP Camera - Local File Inclusion
info.author: 0x_Akoko
info.description: Genie Access WIP3BVAF WISH IP 3MP IR Auto Focus Bullet Camera devices through 3.X are vulnerable to local file inclusion via the web interface, as demonstrated by reading /etc/shadow.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to read sensitive files on the system.
info.remediation: Apply the latest firmware update provided by the vendor to fix the local file inclusion vulnerability.

info.name: SonicWall SRA 4600 VPN - SQL Injection

info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches or firmware updates provided by SonicWall to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: KindEditor 4.1.11 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: KindEditor 4.1.11 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability via the php/demo.php content1 parameter.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the context of the victim's browser, leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Upgrade to a patched version of KindEditor or apply the necessary security patches provided by the vendor.

info.name: Kibana Timelion - Arbitrary Code Execution
info.author: dwisiswant0
info.description: Kibana versions before 5.6.15 and 6.6.1 contain an arbitrary code execution flaw in the Timelion visualizer. An attacker with access to the Timelion application could send a request that will attempt to execute javascript code. This could possibly lead to an attacker executing arbitrary commands with permissions of the Kibana process on the host system.
info.impact: Arbitrary code execution can result in unauthorized access, data leakage, and system compromise.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches or upgrade to a patched version of Kibana to mitigate the vulnerability.

info.name: Adobe Experience Manager - XML External Entity Injection
info.author: DhiyaneshDk
info.description: Adobe Experience Manager 6.5, 6.4, 6.3 and 6.2 are susceptible to XML external entity injection. An attacker can possibly obtain sensitive information, modify data, and/or execute unauthorized administrative operations in the context of the affected site.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can lead to unauthorized access to sensitive information, server-side request forgery, and potential remote code execution.
info.remediation: Apply the necessary security patches provided by Adobe to mitigate the vulnerability. Additionally, ensure that the server is properly configured to restrict access to sensitive files and prevent XXE attacks.

info.name: qdPM 9.1 - Cross-site Scripting
info.author: theamanrawat
info.description: qdPM 9.1 suffers from Cross-site Scripting (XSS) in the search[keywords] parameter.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute malicious scripts in the context of the victim's browser, potentially leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Upgrade to a patched version of qdPM or apply the necessary security patches provided by the vendor.

info.name: Jira - Local File Inclusion
info.author: Kishore Krishna (siLLyDaddy)
info.description: Jira before version 7.13.4, from version 8.0.0 before version 8.0.4, and from version 8.1.0 before version 8.1.1, allows remote attackers to access files in the Jira webroot under the META-INF directory via local file inclusion.
info.impact: This vulnerability can result in sensitive information exposure, unauthorized access to files, and potential compromise of the Jira application.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches or updates provided by Atlassian to mitigate the vulnerability.

info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches and updates provided by Atlassian to fix the vulnerability.

info.name: Jira <8.4.0 - Information Disclosure
info.author: harshbothra_
info.description: Jira before 8.4.0 is susceptible to information disclosure. The /rest/api/latest/groupuserpicker resource can allow an attacker to enumerate usernames, and thereby potentially obtain sensitive information, modify data, and/or execute unauthorized operations.

info.remediation: Upgrade Jira to version 8.4.0 or later to fix the information disclosure vulnerability.

info.name: Jira <8.4.0 - Server-Side Request Forgery
info.author: TechbrunchFR
info.description: Jira before 8.4.0 is susceptible to server-side request forgery. The /plugins/servlet/gadgets/makeRequest resource contains a logic bug in the JiraWhitelist class, which can allow an attacker to access the content of internal network resources and thus modify data, and/or execute unauthorized operations.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can lead to unauthorized access to internal resources, data leakage, and potential remote code execution.
info.remediation: Upgrade Jira to version 8.4.0 or later to mitigate the SSRF vulnerability.

info.name: Totaljs <3.2.3 - Local File Inclusion
info.author: madrobot
