info.remediation: Upgrade Totaljs to version 3.2.3 or later to fix the LFI vulnerability.

info.name: HotelDruid 2.3.0 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: LogicalHunter
info.description: HotelDruid 2.3.0 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability affecting nsextt, cambia1, mese_fine, origine, and anno parameters in creaprezzi.php, tabella3.php, personalizza.php, and visualizza_tabelle.php.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute malicious scripts in the context of the victim's browser, leading to potential data theft or unauthorized actions.
info.remediation: Upgrade to a patched version of HotelDruid or apply appropriate input sanitization to prevent XSS attacks.

info.name: WordPress Core 5.0.0 - Crop-image Shell Upload
info.author: sttlr
info.description: WordPress through 5.0.3 allows Path Traversal in wp_crop_image(). An attacker (who has privileges to crop an image) can write the output image to an arbitrary directory via a filename containing two image extensions and ../ sequences, such as a filename ending with the .jpg?/../../file.jpg substring.
info.impact: Authenticated attackers with image cropping privileges can write output images to arbitrary directories via path traversal, potentially overwriting critical system files or placing web shells in accessible locations.
info.remediation: Upgrade to WordPress version 5.0.4 or later.

info.remediation: Update to ThinkPHP 3.2.4 or later, or apply vendor patches.

info.name: Homematic CCU3 - Local File Inclusion
info.author: 0x_Akoko
info.description: eQ-3 AG Homematic CCU3 3.43.15 and earlier allows remote attackers to read arbitrary files of the device's filesystem, aka local file inclusion. This vulnerability can be exploited by unauthenticated attackers with access to the web interface.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to read sensitive files on the system.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches or updates provided by the vendor.

info.name: JFrog Artifactory 6.7.3 - Admin Login Bypass
info.author: akshansh
info.description: JFrog Artifactory 6.7.3 is vulnerable to an admin login bypass issue because by default the access-admin account is used to reset the password of the admin account. While this is only allowable from a connection directly from localhost, providing an X-Forwarded-For HTTP header to the request allows an unauthenticated user to login with the default credentials of the access-admin account while bypassing the whitelist of allowed IP addresses. The access-admin account can use Artifactory's API to request authentication tokens for all users including the admin account and, in turn, assume full control of all artifacts and repositories managed by Artifactory.
info.impact: Successful exploitation allows unauthorized access to the admin panel.
info.remediation: Upgrade to a patched version of JFrog Artifactory or apply the necessary security patches.

info.remediation: Update to the latest version of LabKey Server or apply security patches that fix XML parsing vulnerabilities.

info.name: PHPSHE 1.7 - SQL Injection
info.author: DhiyaneshDK
info.description: A SQL Injection was discovered in PHPSHE 1.7 in include/plugin/payment/alipay/pay.php with the parameter id. The vulnerability does not need any authentication.
info.impact: Attackers can execute arbitrary SQL commands, potentially leading to data theft, modification, or deletion.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version of PHPSHE or apply security patches to sanitize input parameters.

info.name: Sitecore Experience Platform - Deserialization of Untrusted Data
info.author: ritikchaddha
info.description: Sitecore Experience Platform before 8.2 Update-7 and 9.0 before Update-2 is vulnerable to a remote code execution vulnerability (CVE-2019-9874). An attacker can exploit this issue to execute arbitrary code on the affected system via a crafted request to the /sitecore/shell/Applications/Layouts/IDE.aspx endpoint.
info.impact: Attackers can execute arbitrary code remotely, potentially leading to full system compromise.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version of Sitecore or apply security patches addressing deserialization issues.

info.name: WPGraphQL 0.2.3 - User Creation
info.author: DhiyaneshDk
info.description: The WPGraphQL 0.2.3 plugin for WordPress allows remote attackers to register a new user with admin privileges, whenever new user registrations are allowed. This is related to the registerUser mutation.
info.impact: Attackers can create admin users, leading to full control over the WordPress site.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version of WPGraphQL or apply security patches to restrict user registration permissions.

info.name: WPEngine WPGraphQL 0.2.3 - Unauthenticated User Information Disclosure
info.author: intelligent-ears
info.description: An issue was discovered in the WPGraphQL 0.2.3 plugin for WordPress. By querying the 'users' RootQuery, it is possible, for an unauthenticated attacker, to retrieve all WordPress users details such as email address, role, and username.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to enumerate all WordPress users and extract sensitive information including email addresses, usernames, and user roles without authentication.
info.remediation: Update WPGraphQL to version 0.3.0 or later to fix this vulnerability.

info.name: WPEngine WPGraphQL 0.2.3 - Unauthenticated Comment Posting
info.author: intelligent-ears
info.description: The createComment mutation in the WPGraphQL 0.2.3 plugin for WordPress allows unauthenticated users to post comments on any article, even when 'allow comment' is disabled.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to post unauthorized comments on WordPress posts, potentially leading to content manipulation and defacement.
info.remediation: Update WPGraphQL to version 0.3.0 or later to fix this vulnerability.

info.name: WP Google Maps < 7.10.43 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: ritikchaddha
info.description: The wp-google-maps plugin before 7.10.43 for WordPress has XSS via the wp-admin/admin.php PATH_INFO.
info.impact: Attackers can execute arbitrary scripts in the admin context, potentially leading to session hijacking or privilege escalation.
info.remediation: Update to version 7.10.43 or later.

info.name: GetSimple CMS 3.3.13 - Open Redirect

info.name: Zyxel - Cross-Site Scripting

info.name: Keycloak <= 12.0.1 - request_uri Blind Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
info.author: dhiyaneshDk
info.description: Keycloak 12.0.1 and below allows an attacker to force the server to request an unverified URL using the OIDC parameter request_uri. This allows an attacker to execute a server-side request forgery (SSRF) attack.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could lead to unauthorized access to internal resources, data leakage, or further attacks.
info.remediation: Upgrade Keycloak to a version higher than 12.0.1 to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: WAVLINK - Access Control
info.author: arafatansari
info.description: Wavlink WN530HG4, WN531G3, WN533A8, and WN551K are susceptible to improper access control via /cgi-bin/ExportAllSettings.sh, where a crafted POST request returns the current configuration of the device, including the administrator password. No authentication is required. The attacker must perform a decryption step, but all decryption information is readily available.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can lead to unauthorized access to sensitive information or control of the affected device.
info.remediation: Apply the latest firmware update provided by the vendor to fix the access control issue.

info.name: Tenda AC15 AC1900 version 15.03.05.19 - Command Injection
info.author: pussycat0x
info.description: The goform/setUsbUnload endpoint of Tenda AC15 AC1900 version 15.03.05.19 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary system commands via the deviceName POST parameter.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can execute arbitrary SQL commands to access or modify database contents, potentially compromising the entire Tenda router and network configuration.
info.remediation: Upgrade to a patched firmware version or replace the affected device.

raw:
POST /goform/setUsbUnload HTTP/1.1
Host: {{Hostname}}

info.name: GLPI <9.4.6 - Open Redirect
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: GLPI prior 9.4.6 contains an open redirect vulnerability based on a regexp.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to redirect users to malicious websites, leading to phishing attacks.
info.remediation: Upgrade to version 9.4.6 or later.

info.name: Grafana <= 6.7.1 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: emadshanab
info.description: Grafana through 6.7.1 contains an unauthenticated stored cross-site scripting vulnerability due to insufficient input protection in the originalUrl field, which allows an attacker to inject JavaScript code that will be executed after clicking on Open Original Dashboard after visiting the snapshot.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the context of the victim's browser, leading to potential data theft or unauthorized actions.
info.remediation: This issue can be resolved by updating Grafana to the latest version.

info.name: phpMyAdmin 5.0.2 - CRLF Injection
info.author: ritikchaddha
info.description: phpMyAdmin 5.0.2 allows CRLF injection, as demonstrated by %0D%0Astring%0D%0A inputs to login form fields causing CRLF sequences to be reflected on an error page. NOTE: the vendor states "I don't see anything specifically exploitable.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can read arbitrary files from the server including configuration files and credentials, potentially leading to complete system compromise.
info.remediation: Upgrade to a patched version of the ESPCMS or apply vendor-provided security updates.

info.name: MicroStrategy Web 10.4 - Information Disclosure
info.author: tess
info.description: MicroStrategy Web 10.4 is susceptible to information disclosure. The JVM configuration, CPU architecture, installation folder, and other information are exposed through /MicroStrategyWS/happyaxis.jsp. An attacker can use this vulnerability to learn more about the application environment and thereby possibly obtain sensitive information, modify data, and/or execute unauthorized operations.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to gain sensitive information.
info.remediation: Mitigated in all versions 11.0 and higher.

info.name: LimeSurvey 4.1.11 - Local File Inclusion
info.author: daffainfo
info.description: LimeSurvey before 4.1.12+200324 is vulnerable to local file inclusion because it contains a path traversal vulnerability in application/controllers/admin/LimeSurveyFileManager.php.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can lead to unauthorized access to sensitive files, remote code execution, and potential compromise of the server.
info.remediation: Upgrade to the latest version of LimeSurvey (4.1.12 or higher) which includes a fix for this vulnerability.

info.name: Rank Math SEO <= 1.0.40.2 - Privilege Escalation via Unprotected REST API Endpoint
info.author: s4e-io
info.description: The Rank Math plugin through 1.0.40.2 for WordPress allows unauthenticated remote attackers to update arbitrary WordPress metadata, including the ability to escalate or revoke administrative privileges for existing users via the unsecured rankmath/v1/updateMeta REST API endpoint.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can escalate their privileges to administrator level or revoke administrative access from legitimate users, leading to complete compromise of the WordPress site.
info.remediation: Update the Rank Math SEO plugin to version 1.0.41 or later.

info.name: Rank Math SEO <= 1.0.40.2 - Redirect Creation via Unprotected REST API Endpoint
info.author: s4e-io
info.description: The Rank Math plugin through 1.0.40.2 for WordPress allows unauthenticated remote attackers to create new URIs (that redirect to an external web site) via the unsecured rankmath/v1/updateRedirection REST API endpoint. In other words, this is not an "Open Redirect" issue; instead, it allows the attacker to create a new URI with an arbitrary name (e.g., the /exampleredirect URI).
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can create arbitrary redirect URIs on the WordPress site, which can be used for phishing attacks, SEO manipulation, or distributing malware by redirecting users to malicious external sites.
info.remediation: Update the Rank Math SEO plugin to version 1.0.41 or later.

info.name: Grav < 1.7 - Open Redirect
info.author: 0x_Akoko
info.description: Grav before 1.7 has an open redirect vulnerability via common/Grav.php. This is partially fixed in 1.6.23 and still present in 1.6.x.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to redirect users to malicious websites, leading to phishing attacks.
info.remediation: Upgrade Grav CMS to version 1.7 or later to fix the open redirect vulnerability.

info.name: WordPress Chop Slider 3 - Blind SQL Injection
info.author: theamanrawat
info.description: WordPress Chop Slider 3 plugin contains a blind SQL injection vulnerability via the id GET parameter supplied to get_script/index.php. The plugin can allow an attacker to execute arbitrary SQL queries in the context of the WP database user, thereby making it possible to obtain sensitive information, modify data, and/or execute unauthorized administrative operations in the context of the affected site.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to extract sensitive information from the database.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version of the WordPress Chop Slider 3 plugin to mitigate the vulnerability.

info.name: SuperWebmailer 7.21.0.01526 - Remote Code Execution
info.author: Official_BlackHat13
info.description: SuperWebMailer 7.21.0.01526 is susceptible to a remote code execution vulnerability in the Language parameter of mailingupgrade.php. An unauthenticated remote attacker can exploit this behavior to execute arbitrary PHP code via Code Injection.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the affected system.
info.remediation: Upgrade to the latest version of SuperWebmailer to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: PRTG Network Monitor <20.1.57.1745 - Information Disclosure
info.author: x6263
info.description: PRTG Network Monitor before 20.1.57.1745 is susceptible to information disclosure. An attacker can obtain information about probes running or the server itself via an HTTP request, thus potentially being able to modify data and/or execute unauthorized administrative operations in the context of the affected site.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to gain sensitive information from the PRTG Network Monitor.
info.remediation: Upgrade PRTG Network Monitor to version 20.1.57.1745 or higher to mitigate the information disclosure vulnerability.

info.name: Kong Admin <=2.03 - Admin API Access
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: Kong Admin through 2.0.3 contains an issue via docker-kong which makes the admin API port accessible on interfaces other than 127.0.0.1.
info.impact: Remote attackers can gain unauthorized administrative access to the Kong Admin API.
info.remediation: Upgrade to Kong version 2.0.3 or later to fix the vulnerability and ensure proper authentication and access control mechanisms are in place.

info.name: Media Library Assistant < 2.82 - Unauthenticated Limited Local File Inclusion
info.author: Sourabh-Sahu
info.description: Media Library Assistant plugin for WordPress before 2.82 contains a local file inclusion caused by unsanitized mla_gallery link parameter, letting attackers include arbitrary local files, exploit requires access to the vulnerable link.
info.impact: Attackers can include arbitrary local files, potentially leading to information disclosure or code execution.
info.remediation: Update to version 2.82 or later.

info.name: WordPress Duplicator 1.3.24 & 1.3.26 - Local File Inclusion
info.author: dwisiswant0
info.description:
WordPress Duplicator 1.3.24 & 1.3.26 are vulnerable to local file inclusion vulnerabilities that could allow attackers to download arbitrary files, such as the wp-config.php file. According to the vendor, the vulnerability was only in two
versions v1.3.24 and v1.3.26, the vulnerability wasn't
present in versions 1.3.22 and before.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can lead to unauthorized access to sensitive files, remote code execution, and potential compromise of the entire WordPress installation.
info.remediation: Update the WordPress Duplicator plugin to the latest version (1.3.27 or higher) to mitigate the vulnerability.

info.name: Mitel MiCollab AWV 8.1.2.4 and 9.1.3 - Directory Traversal
info.author: ritikchaddha
info.description: A Directory Traversal vulnerability in the web conference component of Mitel MiCollab AWV before 8.1.2.4 and 9.x before 9.1.3 could allow an attacker to access arbitrary files from restricted directories of the server via a crafted URL, due to insufficient access validation. A successful exploit could allow an attacker to access sensitive information from the restricted directories.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to view, modify, or delete arbitrary files on the system, potentially leading to unauthorized access or data leakage.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches or updates provided by Mitel to mitigate the vulnerability and prevent unauthorized access.

info.name: Micro Focus Operations Bridge Manager <=2020.05 - Remote Code Execution
info.author: dwisiswant0
info.description: Micro Focus Operations Bridge Manager in versions 2020.05 and below is vulnerable to remote code execution via UCMDB. The vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Data Center Automation. An attack requires network access and authentication as a valid application user. Originated from Metasploit module (#14654).
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the affected system.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patch or upgrade to a non-vulnerable version of Micro Focus Operations Bridge Manager.

info.name: Micro Focus UCMDB - Remote Code Execution
info.author: dwisiswant0
info.description: Micro Focus UCMDB is susceptible to remote code execution. Impacted products include Operation Bridge Manager versions 2020.05, 2019.11, 2019.05, 2018.11, 2018.05, 10.63,10.62, 10.61, 10.60, 10.12, 10.11, 10.10 and all earlier versions, and Operations Bridge (containerized) 2020.05, 2019.08, 2019.05, 2018.11, 2018.08, 2018.05. 2018.02 and 2017.11. 3.), and Application Performance Management versions 9,51, 9.50 and 9.40 with UCMDB 10.33 CUP 3.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the affected system.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches or updates provided by Micro Focus to fix this vulnerability.

info.name: WordPress GTranslate <2.8.52 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: dhiyaneshDK
info.description: WordPress GTranslate plugin before 2.8.52 contains an unauthenticated reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability via a crafted link. This requires use of the hreflang tags feature within a sub-domain or sub-directory paid option.
info.impact: Attackers can inject malicious JavaScript through a crafted link, potentially stealing user credentials, session tokens, or performing unauthorized actions on behalf of victims when they click the malicious link.
info.remediation: Update the WordPress GTranslate plugin to version 2.8.52 or later.

info.name: Apache Unomi - Remote Code Execution
info.author: Sourabh-Sahu
info.description: Apache Unomi allows conditions to use OGNL scripting which offers the possibility to call static Java classes from the JDK that could execute code with the permission level of the running Java process, enabling attackers to execute arbitrary code.
info.impact: Successful exploitation allows an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the server with the privileges of the Java process, potentially leading to complete system compromise.
info.remediation: Update Apache Unomi to version 1.5.2 or later. Disable OGNL scripting in conditions if not required.

info.name: Apache Airflow <=1.10.10 - Remote Code Execution
info.author: pdteam
info.description: Apache Airflow versions 1.10.10 and below are vulnerable to remote code/command injection vulnerabilities in one of the example DAGs shipped with Airflow. This could allow any authenticated user to run arbitrary commands as the user running airflow worker/scheduler (depending on the executor in use).
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the affected system.
info.remediation: If you already have examples disabled by setting load_examples=False in the config then you are not vulnerable.

info.name: Apache HTTP Server - Remote Code Execution
info.author: wofeiwo@80sec.com,pszyszkowski,pdresearch,iamnoooob
info.description: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.32 to 2.4.44 contains an info disclosure and possible remote code execution caused by a vulnerability in mod_proxy_uwsgi, letting remote attackers access sensitive information and potentially execute arbitrary code, exploit requires sending crafted requests.
info.impact: Attackers can exploit the mod_proxy_uwsgi vulnerability to access sensitive information or execute arbitrary code on the Apache HTTP Server, potentially compromising the entire web server and its hosted applications.
info.remediation: Update Apache HTTP Server to version 2.4.45 or later.

info.name: Apache Cocoon 2.1.12 - XML Injection
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: Apache Cocoon 2.1.12 is susceptible to  XML injection. When using the StreamGenerator, the code parses a user-provided XML. A specially crafted XML, including external system entities, can be used to access any file on the server system.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can lead to unauthorized access, data leakage, and remote code execution.
info.remediation: Upgrade to Apache Cocoon 2.1.13 or later.

info.name: WordPress Catch Breadcrumb <1.5.4 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: daffainfo
info.description: WordPress Catch Breadcrumb plugin before 1.5.4 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability via the s parameter (a search query). Also affected are 16 themes if the plugin is enabled: Alchemist and Alchemist PRO, Izabel and Izabel PRO, Chique and Chique PRO, Clean Enterprise and Clean Enterprise PRO, Bold Photography PRO, Intuitive PRO, Devotepress PRO, Clean Blocks PRO, Foodoholic PRO, Catch Mag PRO, Catch Wedding PRO, and Higher Education PRO.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to inject malicious scripts into web pages viewed by users, leading to potential data theft, session hijacking, or defacement of the affected website.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version of WordPress Catch Breadcrumb plugin (1.5.4 or higher) to mitigate the vulnerability.

info.name: Zoho ManageEngine OpManger - Arbitrary File Read
info.author: dwisiswant0
info.description: Zoho ManageEngine OpManager Stable build before 124196 and Released build before 125125 allows an unauthenticated attacker to read arbitrary files on the server by sending a specially crafted request.
info.impact: An attacker can read sensitive files on the server, potentially leading to unauthorized access, data leakage, or further exploitation.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patch or upgrade to a patched version of Zoho ManageEngine OpManger to mitigate the vulnerability.

info.name: WAVLINK WN530H4 live_api.cgi - Command Injection
info.author: DhiyaneshDK
info.description: A remote command-line injection vulnerability in the /cgi-bin/live_api.cgi endpoint of the WAVLINK WN530H4 M30H4.V5030.190403 allows an attacker to execute arbitrary Linux commands as root without authentication.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can execute arbitrary Linux commands as root on the WAVLINK WN530H4 device, potentially leading to complete system compromise, data theft, or using the device as a pivot point for further attacks.
info.remediation: Apply vendor security patches if available or replace the device with a secure alternative. Restrict access to the management interface.

info.name: WAVLINK WN530H4 M30H4.V5030.190403 - Information Disclosure
info.author: arafatansari
info.description: WAVLINK WN530H4 M30H4.V5030.190403 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the /cgi-bin/ExportAllSettings.sh endpoint. This can allow an attacker to leak router settings, including cleartext login details, DNS settings, and other sensitive information without authentication.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to gain access to sensitive information, such as router configuration settings and user credentials.
info.remediation: Apply the latest firmware update provided by the vendor to fix the information disclosure vulnerability.

info.name: rConfig 3.9.4 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: r3Y3r53
info.description: The rConfig 3.9.4 is vulnerable to cross-site scripting. The devicemgmnt.php file improperly validates the request coming from the user input. Due to this flaw, An attacker can exploit this vulnerability by crafting arbitrary javascript in `deviceId` GET parameter of devicemgmnt.php resulting in execution of the javascript.
info.impact: Authenticated attackers can inject malicious JavaScript through the deviceId parameter, potentially stealing session cookies or performing administrative actions on behalf of authenticated users.
info.remediation: Upgrade to rConfig version 3.9.7 or later.

info.name: rConfig 3.9.4 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: r3Y3r53
info.description: rConfig 3.9.4 is vulnerable to reflected XSS. The configDevice.php file improperly validates user input. An attacker can exploit this vulnerability by crafting arbitrary JavaScript in the rid GET parameter of devicemgmnt.php
info.impact: Authenticated attackers can inject malicious JavaScript through the rid parameter, potentially stealing session cookies or performing administrative actions on behalf of authenticated users.
info.remediation: Upgrade to rConfig version 3.9.7 or later.

info.name: Intelbras TIP200/TIP200LITE/TIP300 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: ritikchaddha
info.description: Intelbras TIP200 60.61.75.15, TIP200LITE 60.61.75.15, and TIP300 65.61.75.15 are vulnerable to reflected cross-site scripting (XSS) via the page parameter in /cgi-bin/cgiServer.exx, allowing attackers to execute arbitrary JavaScript in the context of the user.
info.impact: Authenticated attackers can inject malicious JavaScript through the page parameter, potentially stealing session cookies or performing unauthorized actions on behalf of authenticated users.
info.remediation: Update the device firmware to the latest version provided by Intelbras.

info.name: Onkyo TX-NR585 Web Interface - Directory Traversal
info.author: 0x_Akoko
info.description: Onkyo TX-NR585 1000-0000-000-0008-0000 devices allows remote unauthenticated users on the network to read sensitive files via %2e%2e%2f directory traversal and local file inclusion.
info.impact: An attacker can access sensitive files on the system, potentially leading to unauthorized access, information disclosure, or further exploitation.
info.remediation: Apply the latest firmware update provided by the vendor to fix the directory traversal vulnerability.

info.name: TeamPass 2.1.27.36 - Improper Authentication
info.author: arafatansari
info.description: TeamPass 2.1.27.36 is susceptible to improper authentication. An attacker can retrieve files from the TeamPass web root, which may include backups or LDAP debug files, and therefore possibly obtain sensitive information, modify data, and/or execute unauthorized operations.
info.impact: An attacker can bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to sensitive information.
info.remediation: Upgrade to a patched version of TeamPass or apply the recommended security patches.

info.name: Roundcube Webmail - Command Injection
info.author: domwhewell-sage
info.description: Roundcube Webmail before 1.4.4 contains a command injection caused by shell metacharacters in configuration settings for im_convert_path or im_identify_path, letting attackers execute arbitrary code, exploit requires attacker to control configuration settings.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to execute arbitrary commands on the server, potentially leading to a full compromise of the system.
info.remediation: To remediate this vulnerability, update to Roundcube Webmail 1.4.5, 1.3.12 or later.

words: The config file was saved successfully

info.name: vBulletin SQL Injection
info.author: pdteam
info.description: vBulletin before 5.5.6pl1, 5.6.0 before 5.6.0pl1, and 5.6.1 before 5.6.1pl1 has incorrect access control that permits SQL injection attacks.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can lead to unauthorized access, data leakage, and potential compromise of the underlying system.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patch or upgrade to a non-vulnerable version of vBulletin.

info.author: dwisiswant0
info.description: WordPress Contact Form 7 before 1.3.3.3 allows unrestricted file upload and remote code execution by setting supported_type to php% and uploading a .php% file.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on the affected WordPress site.
info.remediation: Update the Contact Form 7 plugin to version 1.3.3.3 or later to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.impact: Attackers can delete arbitrary files on the server, potentially causing data loss or service disruption.
info.remediation: Update to version 4.2.8 or later.

info.name: Wavlink Multiple AP - Remote Command Injection
info.author: gy741
info.description: Wavlink products are affected by a vulnerability that may allow remote unauthenticated users to execute arbitrary commands as root on Wavlink devices. The user input is not properly sanitized which allows command injection via the "key" parameter in a login request. It has been tested on Wavlink WN575A4 and WN579X3 devices, but other products may also be affected.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could lead to unauthorized access, data leakage, and potential compromise of the affected device.
info.remediation: Apply the latest firmware update provided by the vendor to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Submitty <= 20.04.01 - Open Redirect
info.author: 0x_Akoko
info.description: Submitty through 20.04.01 contains an open redirect vulnerability via authentication/login?old= during an invalid login attempt. An attacker can redirect a user to a malicious site and possibly obtain sensitive information, modify data, and/or execute unauthorized operations.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to redirect users to malicious websites, leading to phishing attacks.
info.remediation: Upgrade to Submitty version 20.04.01 or later to fix the open redirect vulnerability.

info.name: Ultimate Addons for Elementor <= 1.24.1 - Registration Bypass
info.author: daffainfo
info.description: An issue was discovered in the "Ultimate Addons for Elementor" plugin before 1.24.2 for WordPress, as exploited in the wild in May 2020 in conjunction with CVE-2020-13126. Unauthenticated attackers can create users with the Subscriber role even if registration is disabled.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can create user accounts with Subscriber role, potentially leading to further malicious activities or privilege escalation
info.remediation: Update to version 1.24.2 or later.

info.name: Artica Proxy Community Edition <4.30.000000 - Local File Inclusion
info.author: 0x_Akoko
info.description: Artica Proxy Community Edition before 4.30.000000 is vulnerable to local file inclusion via the fw.progrss.details.php popup parameter.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to read arbitrary files on the server, potentially leading to further compromise of the system.
info.remediation: Upgrade to Artica Proxy Community Edition version 4.30.000000 or later to fix the Local File Inclusion vulnerability.

info.name: Netsweeper <=6.4.3 - Python Code Injection
info.author: dwisiswant0
info.description: Netsweeper through 6.4.3 allows unauthenticated remote code execution because webadmin/tools/unixlogin.php (with certain Referer headers) launches a command line with client-supplied parameters, and allows injection of shell metacharacters.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can lead to remote code execution, compromising the affected system.
info.remediation: Upgrade to a patched version of Netsweeper (>=6.4.4) to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Contentful <=2020-05-21 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: Contentful through 2020-05-21 for Python contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability via the api parameter to the-example-app.py.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute malicious scripts in the context of the victim's browser, potentially leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Upgrade Contentful to a version that is not vulnerable to CVE-2020-13258 or apply the necessary patches provided by the vendor.

info.name: Grafana 3.0.1-7.0.1 - Server-Side Request Forgery
info.author: Joshua Rogers
info.description: Grafana 3.0.1 through 7.0.1 is susceptible to server-side request forgery via the avatar feature, which can lead to remote code execution. Any unauthenticated user/client can make Grafana send HTTP requests to any URL and return its result. This can be used to gain information about the network Grafana is running on, thereby potentially enabling an attacker to obtain sensitive information, modify data, and/or execute unauthorized administrative operations in the context of the affected site.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to bypass security controls, access internal resources, and potentially perform further attacks.
info.remediation: Upgrade to 6.3.4 or higher.

info.name: Microweber <1.1.20 - Information Disclosure
info.author: ritikchaddha,amit-jd
info.description: Microweber before 1.1.20 is susceptible to information disclosure via userfiles/modules/users/controller/controller.php. An attacker can disclose the users database via a /modules/ POST request and thus potentially access sensitive information, modify data, and/or execute unauthorized operations.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to gain unauthorized access to sensitive information.
info.remediation: Upgrade Microweber to version 1.1.20 or later to mitigate the vulnerability.

info.name: Bitrix24 <=20.0.0 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: pikpikcu,3th1c_yuk1,s4e-io
info.description: The Web Application Firewall in Bitrix24 up to and including 20.0.0 allows XSS via the items[ITEMS][ID] parameter to the components/bitrix/mobileapp.list/ajax.php/ URI.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the context of the victim's browser, leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Upgrade to a patched version of Bitrix24 (version >20.0.0) to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: rConfig 3.9 - Authentication Bypass(Admin Login)
info.author: theamanrawat
info.description: lib/crud/userprocess.php in rConfig 3.9.x before 3.9.7 has an authentication bypass, leading to administrator account creation. This issue has been fixed in 3.9.7.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can bypass authentication to create administrator accounts, leading to complete control over the rConfig installation and access to all network device configurations.
info.remediation: Upgrade to rConfig version 3.9.7 or later.

info.name: wpDiscuz <= 5.3.5 - SQL Injection
info.author: Sourabh-Sahu
info.description: A SQL injection issue in the gVectors wpDiscuz plugin 5.3.5 and earlier for WordPress allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary SQL commands via the order parameter of a wpdLoadMoreComments request.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can execute arbitrary SQL commands to extract database contents including user credentials, posts, and sensitive WordPress configuration data.
info.remediation: Upgrade to wpDiscuz version 5.3.6 or later.

info.name: WordPress acf-to-rest-api <=3.1.0 - Insecure Direct Object Reference
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: WordPress acf-to-rest-ap through 3.1.0 allows an insecure direct object reference via permalinks manipulation, as demonstrated by a wp-json/acf/v3/options/ request that can read sensitive information in the wp_options table such as the login and pass values.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to access sensitive data, such as user information or administrative credentials.
info.remediation: Update the acf-to-rest-api plugin to version >3.1.0 or apply the latest security patches.

info.name: Extreme Management Center 8.4.1.24 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: tess
info.description: Extreme Management Center 8.4.1.24 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability via a parameter in a GET request. An attacker can inject arbitrary script in the browser of an unsuspecting user in the context of the affected site. This can allow the attacker to steal cookie-based authentication credentials and launch other attacks.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary scripts in the victim's browser, leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patch or upgrade to a non-vulnerable version of Extreme Management Center.

info.name: Artica Pandora FMS 7.44 - Remote Code Execution
info.author: theamanrawat
info.description: Artica Pandora FMS 7.44 allows remote command execution via the events feature.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can execute arbitrary system commands via the events feature, leading to complete server compromise and access to all monitoring data.
info.remediation: Upgrade to Pandora FMS version 7.45 or later, or apply vendor-provided security patches.

info.name: Intelbras TIP 200/200 LITE/300 - Local File Inclusion
info.author: ritikchaddha
info.description: Intelbras TIP 200 60.61.75.15, TIP 200 LITE 60.61.75.15, and TIP 300 65.61.75.22 are vulnerable to local file inclusion via the 'page' parameter in /cgi-bin/cgiServer.exx, allowing unauthenticated attackers to read arbitrary files such as /etc/passwd.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can read arbitrary files including sensitive configuration files and credentials, potentially leading to complete device compromise.
info.remediation: Update the device firmware to the latest version provided by Intelbras.

info.name: Airflow Experimental <1.10.11 - REST API Auth Bypass
info.author: pdteam
info.description: Airflow's Experimental API prior 1.10.11 allows all API requests without authentication.
info.impact: Allows unauthorized access to Airflow Experimental REST API
info.remediation: From Airflow 1.10.11 forward, the default has been changed to deny all requests by default.  Note - this change fixes it for new installs but existing users need to change their config to default `[api]auth_backend = airflow.api.auth.backend.deny_all` as mentioned in the Updating Guide linked in the references.

info.name: Apache Kylin - Exposed Configuration File
info.author: pikpikcu
info.impact: An attacker can gain sensitive information from the exposed configuration file, potentially leading to further attacks.
info.remediation: Secure the configuration file by restricting access permissions and implementing proper access controls.

info.name: Apache Unomi <1.5.2 - Remote Code Execution
info.author: dwisiswant0
info.description:
Apache Unomi allows conditions to use OGNL and MVEL scripting which
offers the possibility to call static Java classes from the JDK
that could execute code with the permission level of the running Java process.
This vulnerability affects all versions of Apache Unomi prior to 1.5.2.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the affected server.
info.remediation: Apache Unomi users should upgrade to 1.5.2 or later.

info.name: Apache APISIX - Insufficiently Protected Credentials
info.author: pdteam
info.description: Apache APISIX 1.2, 1.3, 1.4, and 1.5 is susceptible to insufficiently protected credentials. An attacker can enable the Admin API and delete the Admin API access IP restriction rules. Eventually, the default token is allowed to access APISIX management data.
info.impact: The vulnerability could result in unauthorized access to sensitive information, leading to potential data breaches or unauthorized actions.
info.remediation: Upgrade to the latest version of Apache APISIX, which includes a fix for the vulnerability. Additionally, ensure that sensitive credentials are properly protected and stored securely.

info.name: WordPress PayPal Pro <1.1.65 - SQL Injection
info.author: princechaddha
info.description: WordPress PayPal Pro plugin before 1.1.65 is susceptible to SQL injection via the 'query' parameter which allows for any unauthenticated user to perform SQL queries with the results output to a web page in JSON format.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary SQL queries, potentially leading to unauthorized access, data leakage, or data manipulation.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version of the WordPress PayPal Pro plugin (1.1.65 or higher) to mitigate the SQL Injection vulnerability.

info.name: Gitea 1.1.0 - 1.12.5 - Remote Code Execution
info.author: theamanrawat
info.description: Gitea 1.1.0 through 1.12.5 is susceptible to authenticated remote code execution, via the git hook functionality, in customer environments where the documentation is not understood (e.g., one viewpoint is that the dangerousness of this feature should be documented immediately above the ENABLE_GIT_HOOKS line in the config file). NOTE: The vendor has indicated this is not a vulnerability and states "This is a functionality of the software that is limited to a subset of accounts. If you give someone the privilege to execute arbitrary code on your server, they can execute arbitrary code on your server. We provide very clear warnings to users around this functionality and what it provides."
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the target system.
info.remediation: Fixed in version 1.16.7.

info.name: Atlassian Jira Server/Data Center <8.5.8/8.6.0 - 8.11.1 - Information Disclosure
info.author: x1m_martijn
info.description: Atlassian Jira Server and Data Center before 8.5.8 and 8.6.0 through 8.11.1 are susceptible to information disclosure via the /secure/QueryComponent!Default.jspa endpoint. An attacker can view custom field names and custom SLA names.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to gain access to sensitive information, potentially leading to further attacks.
info.remediation: Upgrade Atlassian Jira Server/Data Center to a version higher than 8.11.1 to mitigate the vulnerability.

info.name: Jira Server and Data Center - Information Disclosure
info.author: bjhulst
info.description: Jira Server and Data Center is susceptible to information disclosure. An attacker can enumerate users via the /ViewUserHover.jspa endpoint and thus potentially access sensitive information, modify data, and/or execute unauthorized operations. Affected versions are before version 7.13.6, from version 8.0.0 before 8.5.7, and from version 8.6.0 before 8.12.0.
info.impact: An attacker can gain access to sensitive information, potentially leading to further attacks.
info.remediation: Apply the necessary patches or updates provided by Atlassian to fix the vulnerability.

info.name: Agentejo Cockpit 0.10.2 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: edoardottt
info.description: Agentejo Cockpit 0.10.2 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability due to insufficient sanitization of the to parameter in the /auth/login route, which allows for injection of arbitrary JavaScript code into a web page's content.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the context of the victim's browser, leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Upgrade to the latest version of Agentejo Cockpit or apply the vendor-provided patch to fix the XSS vulnerability.

info.name: NeDi 1.9C - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: NeDi 1.9C is vulnerable to cross-site scripting because of an incorrect implementation of sanitize() in inc/libmisc.php. This function attempts to escape the SCRIPT tag from user-controllable values, but can be easily bypassed, as demonstrated by an onerror attribute of an IMG element as a Devices-Config.php?sta= value.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the context of the victim's browser, leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Upgrade to a patched version of NeDi or apply the vendor-supplied patch to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server - Remote Command Execution
info.author: princechaddha,DhiyaneshDk
info.description: Oracle WebLogic Server 10.3.6.0.0, 12.1.3.0.0, 12.2.1.3.0, 12.2.1.4.0 and 14.1.1.0.0 is susceptible to remote code execution. An attacker can execute malware, obtain sensitive information, modify data, and/or gain full control over a compromised machine without entering necessary credentials. See also CVE-2020-14882, which is addressed in the October 2020 Critical Patch Update.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands with the privileges of the WebLogic server.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches provided by Oracle to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Oracle Fusion - Directory Traversal/Local File Inclusion
info.author: Ivo Palazzolo (@palaziv)
info.description: Oracle Business Intelligence Enterprise Edition 5.5.0.0.0, 12.2.1.3.0, and 12.2.1.4.0 are vulnerable to local file inclusion vulnerabilities via "getPreviewImage."
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to read sensitive files, execute arbitrary code, or gain unauthorized access to the system.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches and updates provided by Oracle to fix this vulnerability.

info.name: Oracle Weblogic Server - Remote Command Execution
info.author: dwisiswant0
info.description: Oracle WebLogic Server contains an easily exploitable remote command execution vulnerability which allows unauthenticated attackers with network access via HTTP to compromise the server.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands with the privileges of the affected application.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches provided by Oracle to fix the vulnerability.

info.name: Oracle Fusion Middleware WebLogic Server Administration Console - Remote Code Execution
info.author: pdteam,vicrack
info.description: The Oracle Fusion Middleware WebLogic Server admin console in versions 10.3.6.0.0, 12.1.3.0.0, 12.2.1.3.0, 12.2.1.4.0 and 14.1.1.0.0 is vulnerable to an easily exploitable vulnerability that allows high privileged attackers with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle WebLogic Server.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the affected system.
info.remediation: Apply the necessary patches or updates provided by Oracle to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Suprema BioStar <2.8.2 - Local File Inclusion
info.author: gy741
info.description: Suprema BioStar before 2.8.2 Video Extension allows remote attackers can read arbitrary files from the server via local file inclusion.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to access sensitive information, such as configuration files, credentials, or other sensitive data stored on the server.
info.remediation: Upgrade Suprema BioStar to version 2.8.2 or later to fix the LFI vulnerability.

info.name: PrestaShop < 1.7.6.6 - Information Exposure via Upload Directory
info.author: 0x_Akoko
info.description: PrestaShop versions after 1.5.0.0 and before 1.7.6.6 are vulnerable to information exposure through directory listing in the upload directory due to a missing index.php file.
info.impact: Attackers can enumerate uploaded files potentially exposing sensitive customer data, invoices, or internal documents.
info.remediation: Upgrade to PrestaShop version 1.7.6.6 or later, or add an empty index.php file in the upload directory as a workaround.

dsl: contains_any(body, "Index of", "Directory listing for", "[To Parent Directory]", "<title>Index of")

info.name: Traefik - Open Redirect
info.author: dwisiswant0
info.description: Traefik before 1.7.26, 2.2.8, and 2.3.0-rc3 contains an open redirect vulnerability in the X-Forwarded-Prefix header. An attacker can redirect a user to a malicious site and possibly obtain sensitive information, modify data, and/or execute unauthorized operations.
info.impact: An attacker can manipulate the redirect URL and trick users into visiting malicious websites.
info.remediation: Apply the vendor-provided patch or upgrade to a non-vulnerable version of Traefik.

info.name: Yii 2 < 2.0.38 - Remote Code Execution
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: Yii 2 (yiisoft/yii2) before version 2.0.38 is vulnerable to remote code execution if the application calls `unserialize()` on arbitrary user input.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the affected system.
info.remediation: Upgrade to version 2.0.38 or later. A possible workaround without upgrading is available in the linked advisory.

info.name: Nette Framework - Remote Code Execution
info.author: becivells
info.description: Nette Framework versions before 2.0.19, 2.1.13, 2.2.10, 2.3.14, 2.4.16, and 3.0.6 are vulnerable to a code injection attack via specially formed parameters being passed to a URL. Nette is a PHP/Composer MVC Framework.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the affected system.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches provided by the Nette Framework to fix the deserialization vulnerability.

info.name: DrayTek Vigor - Command Injection
info.author: ritikchaddha
info.description: DrayTek Vigor devices contain a command injection vulnerability in the cvmcfgupload functionality. The vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands through specially crafted requests to the /cgi-bin/mainfunction.cgi/cvmcfgupload endpoint.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can execute arbitrary system commands on DrayTek Vigor devices via the cvmcfgupload endpoint, leading to complete device compromise and potential network infiltration.
info.remediation: Update the firmware to the latest version provided by DrayTek. If no update is available, consider implementing network segmentation to restrict access to the device's management interface.

info.name: TileServer GL <=3.0.0 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: Akash.C
info.description: TileServer GL through 3.0.0 is vulnerable to reflected cross-site scripting via server.js  because the content of the key GET parameter is reflected unsanitized in an HTTP response for the application's main page.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to inject malicious scripts into web pages viewed by users, leading to potential data theft, session hijacking, or defacement.
info.remediation: Upgrade TileServer GL to a version higher than 3.0.0 or apply the vendor-provided patch to fix the XSS vulnerability.

info.name: MobileIron Core & Connector <= v10.6 & Sentry <= v9.8 - Remote Code Execution
info.author: dwisiswant0
info.description: A remote code execution vulnerability in MobileIron Core & Connector versions 10.3.0.3 and earlier, 10.4.0.0, 10.4.0.1, 10.4.0.2, 10.4.0.3, 10.5.1.0, 10.5.2.0 and 10.6.0.0; and Sentry versions 9.7.2 and earlier, and 9.8.0; and Monitor and Reporting Database (RDB) version 2.0.0.1 and earlier contain a vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via unspecified vectors.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the affected system, potentially leading to complete compromise of the MobileIron infrastructure.
info.remediation: Upgrade MobileIron Core & Connector and Sentry to versions above v10.6 & v9.8 respectively

info.name: TerraMaster TOS <.1.29 - Remote Code Execution
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: TerraMaster TOS before 4.1.29 has invalid parameter checking that leads to code injection as root. This is a dynamic class method invocation vulnerability in include/exportUser.php, in which an attacker can trigger a call to the exec method with (for example) OS commands in the opt parameter.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the affected system.
info.remediation: Upgrade TerraMaster TOS to version 1.29 or higher to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: RosarioSIS 6.7.2 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: 0xr2r,jarvis-survives
info.description: RosarioSIS version 6.7.2 and earlier contains a reflected cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the Preferences module. The 'tab' parameter in Modules.php is not properly sanitized, allowing an attacker to inject arbitrary JavaScript code via a crafted URL.
info.impact: An attacker can execute arbitrary JavaScript in the context of a victim's browser session, potentially leading to session hijacking, credential theft, or other malicious actions.
info.remediation: Update RosarioSIS to the latest version where input validation has been improved.

info.name: Gogs 0.5.5 - 0.12.2 - Remote Code Execution
info.author: theamanrawat
info.description: Gogs 0.5.5 through 0.12.2 is susceptible to authenticated remote code execution via the git hooks functionality. There can be a privilege escalation if access to this feature is granted to a user who does not have administrative privileges. NOTE: Since this is mentioned in the documentation but not in the UI, it could be considered a "product UI does not warn user of unsafe actions" issue.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the affected system.
info.remediation: Upgrade Gogs to a version that is not affected by the vulnerability (0.12.3 or later).

info.name: D-Link DIR-816L 2.x - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: edoardottt
info.description: D-Link DIR-816L devices 2.x before 1.10b04Beta02 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability. In the file webinc/js/info.php, no output filtration is applied to the RESULT parameter before being printed on the webpage. An attacker can inject arbitrary script in the browser of an unsuspecting user in the context of the affected site, which can allow for theft of cookie-based authentication credentials and launch of other attacks.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary script code in the context of a victim's browser, potentially leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Apply the latest firmware update provided by D-Link to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Tiki Wiki CMS GroupWare - Authentication Bypass
info.author: JeonSungHyun[nukunga],gy741,oIfloraIo,nechyo,harksu
info.description: tiki-login.php in Tiki before 21.2 sets the admin password to a blank value after 50 invalid login attempts.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can trigger 50 failed login attempts to reset the admin password to blank, gaining complete administrative access to the Tiki Wiki CMS and all its content.
info.remediation: Upgrade to Tiki Wiki CMS version 21.2 or later.

info.name: Mida eFramework <=2.9.0 - Remote Command Execution
info.author: dwisiswant0
info.description: Mida eFramework through 2.9.0 allows an attacker to achieve remote code execution with administrative (root) privileges. No authentication is required.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands on the target system.
info.remediation: Upgrade Mida eFramework to a version higher than 2.9.0 to mitigate the vulnerability.

info.name: Cisco Unified IP Conference Station 7937G - Denial-of-Service
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: Cisco Unified IP Conference Station 7937G 1-4-4-0 through 1-4-5-7 allows attackers to restart the device remotely via specially crafted packets that can cause a denial-of-service condition. Note: We cannot prove this vulnerability exists. Out of an abundance of caution, this CVE is being assigned to better serve our customers and ensure all who are still running this product understand that the product is end of life and should be removed or upgraded.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to disrupt the functionality of the conference station, leading to a denial of service for legitimate users.
info.remediation: Apply the latest firmware update provided by Cisco to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Prometheus Blackbox Exporter - Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
info.author: DhiyaneshDk
info.description: Prometheus Blackbox Exporter through 0.17.0 contains a server-side request forgery caused by unsanitized target parameter in /probe, letting attackers perform SSRF attacks, exploit requires sending crafted target parameter.
info.impact: Attackers can perform SSRF attacks, potentially accessing internal services or causing denial of service.
info.remediation: Update to version 0.17.1 or later to fix the vulnerability.

info.name: SaltStack <=3002 - Shell Injection
info.author: dwisiswant0
info.description: SaltStack Salt through 3002 allows an unauthenticated user with network access to the Salt API to use shell injections to run code on the Salt-API using the SSH client.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can execute arbitrary shell commands via the Salt API, leading to complete server compromise and access to all managed systems.
info.remediation: Upgrade to a patched version of SaltStack (>=3003) to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Microsoft SharePoint - Remote Code Execution
info.author: dwisiswant0
info.description: Microsoft SharePoint is vulnerable to a remote code execution when the software fails to check the source markup of an application package.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the affected system, potentially leading to a complete compromise of the SharePoint server.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security updates provided by Microsoft to address this vulnerability.

info.name: Nova Lite < 1.3.9 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: daffainfo
info.description: Nova Lite before 1.3.9 for WordPress is susceptible to reflected cross-site scripting via search.php.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute malicious scripts in the context of the victim's browser, potentially leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Upgrade to Nova Lite version 1.3.9 or later to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: WSO2 Carbon Management Console <=5.10 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: madrobot
info.description: WSO2 Management Console through 5.10 is susceptible to reflected cross-site scripting which can be exploited by tampering a request parameter in Management Console. This can be performed in both authenticated and unauthenticated requests.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the context of the victim's browser, leading to potential data theft, session hijacking, or defacement of the affected application.
info.remediation: Upgrade to a patched version of WSO2 Carbon Management Console (5.11 or above) or apply the provided security patch to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: SEOWON INTECH SLC-130 & SLR-120S - Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution
info.author: gy741,edoardottt
info.description: SEOWON INTECH SLC-130 and SLR-120S devices allow remote code execution via the ipAddr parameter to the system_log.cgi page.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the affected device.
info.remediation: Apply the latest firmware update provided by the vendor to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Fuel CMS 1.4.7 - SQL Injection
info.author: Thirukrishnan
info.description: FUEL CMS 1.4.7 allows SQL Injection via the col parameter to /pages/items, /permissions/items, or /navigation/items.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability allows an attacker to execute arbitrary SQL queries, potentially leading to unauthorized access, data manipulation, or data leakage.
info.remediation: Fixed in version 115

info.name: vBulletin 5.5.4 - 5.6.2- Remote Command Execution
info.author: pussycat0x
info.description: vBulletin versions 5.5.4 through 5.6.2 allow remote command execution via crafted subWidgets data in an ajax/render/widget_tabbedcontainer_tab_panel request. NOTE: this issue exists because of an incomplete fix for CVE-2019-16759.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability allows an attacker to execute arbitrary commands on the target system.
info.remediation: Upgrade vBulletin to a version that is not affected by CVE-2020-17496.

info.name: Artica Web Proxy 4.30 - OS Command Injection
info.author: dwisiswant0
info.description: Artica Web Proxy 4.30 allows an authenticated remote attacker to inject commands via the service-cmds parameter in cyrus.php. These commands are executed with root privileges via service_cmds_peform.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can lead to unauthorized remote code execution, compromising the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the affected system.
info.remediation: Upgrade to a patched version of Artica Web Proxy or apply the vendor-supplied patch to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Artica Web Proxy 4.30 - Authentication Bypass/SQL Injection
info.author: dwisiswant0
info.description: Artica Web Proxy 4.30.00000000 allows remote attacker to bypass privilege detection and gain web backend administrator privileges through SQL injection of the apikey parameter in fw.login.php.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to bypass authentication and execute arbitrary SQL queries, potentially leading to unauthorized accessand data leakage.
info.remediation: Upgrade to a patched version of Artica Web Proxy or apply the vendor-supplied patch to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Apache Flink 1.5.1 - Local File Inclusion
info.author: pdteam
info.description: Apache Flink 1.5.1 is vulnerable to local file inclusion because of a REST handler that allows file uploads to an arbitrary location on the local file system through a maliciously modified HTTP HEADER.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to access sensitive information, such as configuration files, credentials, or other sensitive data stored on the server.
info.remediation: Upgrade Apache Flink to a version that is not affected by the vulnerability (1.5.2 or later).

info.name: Apache Flink - Local File Inclusion
info.author: pdteam
info.description: Apache Flink 1.11.0 (and released in 1.11.1 and 1.11.2 as well) allows attackers to read any file on the local filesystem of the JobManager through the REST interface of the JobManager process (aka local file inclusion).
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can read arbitrary files from the JobManager local filesystem, potentially exposing sensitive configuration files, credentials, and proprietary data.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches or upgrade to a patched version of Apache Flink to mitigate the vulnerability.

info.name: Apache Airflow <1.10.14 - Authentication Bypass
info.author: piyushchhiroliya
info.description: Apache Airflow prior to 1.10.14 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability via incorrect session validation with default configuration. An attacker on site A can access unauthorized Airflow on site B through the site A session.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can lead to unauthorized access to sensitive information or unauthorized execution of arbitrary code.
info.remediation: Change default value for [webserver] secret_key config.

info.name: Apache Struts 2.0.0-2.5.25 - Remote Code Execution
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: Apache Struts 2.0.0 through Struts 2.5.25 is susceptible to remote code execution because forced OGNL evaluation, when evaluated on raw user input in tag attributes, may allow it.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the affected server.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches or upgrade to a non-vulnerable version of Apache Struts.

info.name: Z-Blog <=1.5.2 - Open Redirect
info.author: 0x_Akoko
info.description: Z-Blog 1.5.2 and earlier contains an open redirect vulnerability via the redirect parameter in zb_system/cmd.php. An attacker can redirect a user to a malicious site and possibly obtain sensitive information, modify data, and/or execute unauthorized operations.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to redirect users to malicious websites, leading to phishing attacks or the execution of further attacks.
info.remediation: Upgrade Z-Blog to version 1.5.3 or later to fix the open redirect vulnerability.
