info.name: Jeesns 1.4.2 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: Jeesns 1.4.2 is vulnerable to reflected cross-site scripting that allows attackers to execute arbitrary web scripts or HTML via a crafted payload in the system error message's text field.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute malicious scripts in the victim's browser, leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Upgrade to the latest version of Jeesns or apply the vendor-provided patch to fix the XSS vulnerability.

info.name: Jeesns 1.4.2 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: Jeesns 1.4.2 is vulnerable to reflected cross-site scripting in the /newVersion component and allows attackers to execute arbitrary web scripts or HTML.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute malicious scripts in a victim's browser, leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Upgrade Jeesns to the latest version or apply the vendor-provided patch to fix the XSS vulnerability.

info.name: Jeesns 1.4.2 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: Jeesns 1.4.2 is vulnerable to reflected cross-site scripting in the /weibo/topic component and allows attackers to execute arbitrary web scripts or HTML via a crafted payload in the system error message's text field.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute malicious scripts in the victim's browser, leading to potential data theft, session hijacking, or defacement of the affected website.
info.remediation: Upgrade Jeesns to the latest version or apply the vendor-provided patch to fix the XSS vulnerability.

info.name: FHEM 6.0 - Local File Inclusion
info.author: 0x_Akoko
info.description: FHEM version 6.0 suffers from a local file inclusion vulnerability.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to read sensitive files on the target system.
info.remediation: Apply the latest patch or upgrade to a version that is not affected by the vulnerability.

info.name: Vtiger CRM v7.2.0 - Directory Listing
info.author: 0x_Akoko
info.description: Vtiger CRM v7.2.0 contains a directory traversal vulnerability caused by improper access controls in /libraries and /layout directories, letting attackers display hidden files and list directories, exploit requires no authentication.
info.impact: Attackers can access sensitive files and directory structures, potentially leading to information disclosure or further exploitation.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version of Vtiger CRM or apply security patches that enforce proper access controls.

info.name: Apache OFBiz <=16.11.07 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: pdteam
info.description: Apache OFBiz 16.11.01 to 16.11.07 is vulnerable to cross-site scripting because data sent with contentId to /control/stream is not sanitized.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute malicious scripts in the context of the victim's browser, potentially leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Upgrade Apache OFBiz to a version higher than 16.11.07 to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: qdPM 9.1 - Cross-site Scripting
info.author: theamanrawat
info.description: qdPM V9.1 is vulnerable to Cross Site Scripting (XSS) via qdPM\install\modules\database_config.php.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to inject malicious scripts into web pages viewed by users, leading to potential data theft, session hijacking, or defacement.
info.remediation: To mitigate this vulnerability, it is recommended to apply the latest security patches or updates provided by the vendor.

info.name: Apache Kylin 3.0.1 - Command Injection Vulnerability
info.author: iamnoooob,rootxharsh,pdresearch
info.description: Apache Kylin 2.3.0, and releases up to 2.6.5 and 3.0.1 has some restful apis which will concatenate os command with the user input string, a user is likely to be able to execute any os command without any protection or validation.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can lead to unauthorized remote code execution and potential compromise of the affected server.
info.remediation: Upgrade to a patched version of Apache Kylin or apply the necessary security patches provided by the vendor.

info.name: Gridx 1.3 - Remote Code Execution
info.author: geeknik
info.description: Gridx 1.3 is susceptible to remote code execution via tests/support/stores/test_grid_filter.php, which allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted values submitted to the $query parameter.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the affected system.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patch or upgrade to a non-vulnerable version of Gridx.

info.name: ZZcms - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: edoardottt
info.description: ZZcms 2019 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in the user login page. An attacker can inject arbitrary JavaScript code in the referer header via user/login.php, which can allow theft of cookie-based credentials and launch of subsequent attacks.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the context of the victim's browser, leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Upgrade to the latest version to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: WeiPHP 5.0 - SQL Injection
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: WeiPHP 5.0 contains a SQL injection vulnerability via the wp_where function. An attacker can possibly obtain sensitive information from a database, modify data, and execute unauthorized administrative operations in the context of the affected site.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary SQL queries, potentially leading to unauthorized access, data leakage, or data manipulation.
info.remediation: Upgrade to a patched version of WeiPHP or apply the vendor-supplied patch to fix the SQL Injection vulnerability.

info.name: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Web Interface - Cross Site-Scripting
info.author: madrobot,j4vaovo
info.description: PAN-OS management web interface is vulnerable to reflected cross-site scripting. A remote attacker able to convince an administrator with an active authenticated session on the firewall management interface to click on a crafted link to that management web interface could potentially execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the administrator's browser and perform administrative actions. This issue impacts: PAN-OS 8.1 versions earlier than PAN-OS 8.1.16; PAN-OS 9.0 versions earlier than PAN-OS 9.0.9.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary script code in the context of the targeted user's browser, potentially leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches or updates provided by Palo Alto Networks to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: ThinkCMF X2.2.2 - Remote Code Execution
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: ThinkCMF X2.2.2 and below contain a remote code execution caused by processing crafted packets, letting attackers execute arbitrary code remotely, exploit requires sending malicious packets.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can execute arbitrary PHP code on ThinkCMF servers, leading to complete server compromise and access to all website data.
info.remediation: Upgrade to ThinkCMF version X2.2.3 or later.

info.name: GiveWP - Missing Authorization to Settings Update
info.author: daffainfo
info.description: GiveWP plugin through 2.5.9 for WordPress contains an unauthenticated settings change caused by insecure access in includes/gateways/stripe/includes/admin/admin-actions.php, letting attackers modify settings without authentication, exploit requires no authentication.
info.impact: Attackers can modify plugin settings without authentication, potentially leading to unauthorized transactions or configuration changes.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version of GiveWP plugin that addresses this issue.

info.name: Jenkins Gitlab Hook <=1.4.2 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: madrobot
info.description: Jenkins Gitlab Hook 1.4.2 and earlier does not escape project names in the build_now endpoint, resulting in a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the context of the victim's browser, leading to potential data theft or unauthorized actions.
info.remediation: Upgrade to the latest version of Jenkins Gitlab Hook plugin (>=1.4.3) to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: shadoweb wdja v1.5.1 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: pikpikcu,ritikchaddha
info.description: shadoweb wdja v1.5.1 is susceptible to cross-site scripting because it allows attackers to execute arbitrary code and gain escalated privileges via the backurl parameter to /php/passport/index.php.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute malicious scripts in the context of the victim's browser, leading to potential data theft, session hijacking, or defacement of the affected website.
info.remediation: Upgrade to the latest version to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: DomainMOD 4.13.0 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: arafatansari
info.description: DomainMOD 4.13.0 is vulnerable to cross-site scripting via reporting/domains/cost-by-owner.php in the "or Expiring Between" parameter.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the context of the victim's browser, potentially leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Upgrade to the latest version of DomainMOD or apply the vendor-provided patch to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Jenkins <=2.218 - Information Disclosure
info.author: c-sh0
info.description: Jenkins through 2.218, LTS 2.204.1 and earlier, is susceptible to information disclosure. An attacker can access exposed session identifiers on a user detail object in the whoAmI diagnostic page and thus potentially access sensitive information, modify data, and/or execute unauthorized operations.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to gain sensitive information from the Jenkins server.
info.remediation: Upgrade Jenkins to a version higher than 2.218 to mitigate the vulnerability.

info.name: Inspur ClusterEngine 4.0 - Remote Code Execution
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: Inspur ClusterEngine V4.0 is suscptible to a remote code execution vulnerability. A remote attacker can send a malicious login packet to the control server.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the affected system.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches or updates provided by Inspur to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Jenkin Audit Trail <=3.2 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: j3ssie/geraldino2
info.description: Jenkins Audit Trail 3.2 and earlier does not escape the error message for the URL Patterns field form validation, resulting in a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to inject malicious scripts into the application, leading to potential data theft, session hijacking, or defacement.
info.remediation: Upgrade to the latest version of Jenkin Audit Trail (>=3.3) which includes a fix for this vulnerability.

info.name: HomeAutomation 3.3.2 - Open Redirect
info.author: 0x_Akoko
info.description: HomeAutomation 3.3.2 contains a redirect vulnerability caused by improper verification of the 'redirect' GET parameter in 'api.php', letting attackers redirect users to arbitrary websites, exploit requires user interaction with a crafted link.
info.impact: Attackers can redirect users to malicious external websites through crafted links, potentially facilitating phishing attacks or malware distribution.
info.remediation: Upgrade to HomeAutomation version 3.3.3 or later, or apply vendor-provided security patches.

info.name: PHPGurukul Hospital Management System 4.0 - SQL Injection
info.author: ritikchaddha
info.description: PHPGurukul Hospital Management System in PHP v4.0 has a SQL injection vulnerability in \hms\user-login.php. Remote unauthenticated users can exploit the vulnerability to obtain sensitive database information.
info.impact: Successful exploitation allows attackers to access sensitive data from the database, potentially leading to data leakage and further compromise of the application.
info.remediation: Upgrade to the latest version or apply proper input sanitization and parameterized queries to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: 74cms - ajax_street.php 'x' SQL Injection

info.description: SQL Injection in 74cms 3.2.0 via the x parameter to plus/ajax_street.php.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could lead to unauthorized access, data leakage, and potential compromise of the underlying database.
info.remediation: Apply the vendor-provided patch or update to the latest version of 74cms to mitigate the SQL Injection vulnerability.

info.name: 74cms - ajax_common.php SQL Injection
info.author: ritikchaddha
info.description: SQL Injection in 74cms 3.2.0 via the query parameter to plus/ajax_common.php.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can lead to unauthorized access, data leakage, and potential compromise of the underlying database.
info.remediation: Apply the latest patch or update provided by the vendor to fix the SQL Injection vulnerability in the 74cms - ajax_common.php file.

info.name: 74cms - ajax_officebuilding.php SQL Injection
info.author: ritikchaddha
info.description: A SQL injection vulnerability exists in 74cms 3.2.0 via the x parameter to ajax_officebuilding.php.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary SQL queries, potentially leading to unauthorized access, data leakage, or data manipulation.
info.remediation: Apply the latest patch or update provided by the vendor to fix the SQL Injection vulnerability in the 74cms - ajax_officebuilding.php file.

info.name: 74cms - ajax_street.php 'key' SQL Injection

info.description: SQL Injection in 74cms 3.2.0 via the key parameter to plus/ajax_street.php.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary SQL queries, potentially leading to unauthorized access, data leakage, or data manipulation.
info.remediation: Apply the latest patch or update provided by the vendor to fix the SQL Injection vulnerability in the 'key' parameter of ajax_street.php in 74cms.

info.name: b2evolution CMS <6.11.6 - Open Redirect
info.author: geeknik
info.description: b2evolution CMS before 6.11.6 contains an open redirect vulnerability via the redirect_to parameter in email_passthrough.php. An attacker can redirect a user to a malicious site and possibly obtain sensitive information, modify data, and/or execute unauthorized operations.
info.impact: This vulnerability can be exploited by attackers to trick users into visiting malicious websites, potentially leading to phishing attacks, malware infections, or unauthorized access to sensitive information.
info.remediation: Upgrade b2evolution CMS to version 6.11.6 or later to mitigate the open redirect vulnerability (CVE-2020-22840).

info.name: OPNsense <=20.1.5 - Open Redirect
info.author: 0x_Akoko
info.description: OPNsense through 20.1.5 contains an open redirect vulnerability via the url redirect parameter in the login page, which is not filtered. An attacker can redirect a user to a malicious site and possibly obtain sensitive information, modify data, and/or execute unauthorized operations.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to redirect users to malicious websites, leading to phishing attacks or the disclosure of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Upgrade OPNsense to a version higher than 20.1.5 to mitigate the vulnerability.

info.name: Aryanic HighMail (High CMS) - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: geeknik
info.description: A cross-site scripting vulnerability in Aryanic HighMail (High CMS) versions 2020 and before allows remote attackers to inject arbitrary web script or HTML, via 'user' to LoginForm.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the context of the victim's browser, leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: To mitigate this vulnerability, it is recommended to implement proper input validation and sanitization techniques to prevent the execution of malicious scripts.

info.name: Kyocera Printer d-COPIA253MF - Directory Traversal
info.author: 0x_Akoko
info.description: Kyocera Printer d-COPIA253MF plus is susceptible to a directory traversal vulnerability which could allow an attacker to retrieve or view arbitrary files from the affected server.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to read arbitrary files from the server, potentially leading to unauthorized access or sensitive information disclosure.
info.remediation: Apply the latest firmware update provided by Kyocera to fix the directory traversal vulnerability.

info.name: Monstra CMS 3.0.4 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: ritikchaddha
info.description: Monstra CMS 3.0.4 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability via the page feature in admin/index.php. An attacker can inject arbitrary script in the browser of an unsuspecting user in the context of the affected site. This can allow the attacker to steal cookie-based authentication credentials and launch other attacks.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the context of the victim's browser, leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Upgrade to the latest version of Monstra CMS or apply the vendor-provided patch to fix the XSS vulnerability.

info.impact: Authenticated attackers can inject malicious JavaScript through the AppName and AddressList parameters, potentially stealing admin session cookies or performing administrative actions on behalf of authenticated users.

info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the victim's browser, leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Upgrade to the latest version of Mara CMS or apply the vendor-provided patch to fix the XSS vulnerability.

info.name: INTELBRAS TELEFONE IP TIP200 60.61.75.22 - Local File Inclusion
info.author: ritikchaddha

info.impact: Authenticated attackers can read arbitrary files from the device including configuration files and credentials, potentially leading to complete device compromise.
info.remediation: Update the device firmware to the latest version provided by INTELBRAS.

info.name: WordPress Plugin File Manager (wp-file-manager) Backup Disclosure
info.author: x1m_martijn
info.description: mndpsingh287 WP File Manager v6.4 and lower fails to restrict external access to the fm_backups directory with a .htaccess file. This results in the ability for unauthenticated users to browse and download any site backups, which sometimes include full database backups, that the plugin has taken.
info.impact: This vulnerability can lead to unauthorized access to sensitive information, such as database backups, configuration files, and other sensitive data.
info.remediation: Update the WordPress Plugin File Manager (wp-file-manager) to the latest version to mitigate the backup disclosure vulnerability.

info.name: Mongo-Express - Remote Code Execution
info.author: leovalcante
info.description: Mongo-Express before 1.0.0 is susceptible to remote code execution because it uses safer-eval to validate user supplied javascript. Unfortunately safer-eval sandboxing capabilities are easily bypassed leading to remote code execution in the context of the node server.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the affected system.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches or updates provided by the vendor to fix this vulnerability.

info.name: EpiServer Find <13.2.7 - Open Redirect

info.description: EpiServer Find before 13.2.7 contains an open redirect vulnerability via the _t_redirect parameter in a crafted URL, such as a /find_v2/_click URL. An attacker can redirect a user to a malicious site and possibly obtain sensitive information, modify data, and/or execute unauthorized operations.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to redirect users to malicious websites, leading to phishing attacks.
info.remediation: Upgrade to EpiServer Find version 13.2.7 or later to fix the open redirect vulnerability.

info.name: NexusDB <4.50.23 - Local File Inclusion
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: NexusQA NexusDB before 4.50.23 allows the reading of files via ../ directory traversal and local file inclusion.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to access sensitive information, such as configuration files, credentials, or other sensitive data.
info.remediation: Upgrade NexusDB to version 4.50.23 or later to mitigate the LFI vulnerability.

info.name: D-Link DSL 2888a - Authentication Bypass/Remote Command Execution
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: D-Link DSL-2888A devices with firmware prior to AU_2.31_V1.1.47ae55 are vulnerable to authentication bypass issues which can lead to remote command execution. An unauthenticated attacker could bypass authentication to access authenticated pages and functionality.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to bypass authentication and execute arbitrary commands on the affected router.
info.remediation: Apply the latest firmware update provided by D-Link to fix the vulnerability.

info.name: WSO2 API Manager <=3.1.0 - Blind XML External Entity Injection
info.author: lethargynavigator
info.description: WSO2 API Manager 3.1.0 and earlier is vulnerable to blind XML external entity injection (XXE). XXE often allows an attacker to view files on the server file system, and to interact with any backend or external systems that the application itself can access which allows the attacker to transmit sensitive data from the compromised server to a system that the attacker controls.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could lead to unauthorized access to sensitive information, denial of service, or server-side request forgery.
info.remediation: Upgrade to a patched version of WSO2 API Manager (3.1.1 or above) or apply the provided security patch.

info.name: OX Appsuite - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: DhiyaneshDk
info.description: OX App Suite through 7.10.4 allows XSS via the app loading mechanism (the PATH_INFO to the /appsuite URI).
info.impact: Attackers can inject malicious JavaScript through the PATH_INFO parameter, potentially stealing session cookies or performing unauthorized actions on behalf of users.
info.remediation: Upgrade to OX App Suite version 7.10.5 or later.

info.name: OsTicket < 1.14.3 - Server Side Request Forgery
info.author: hnd3884
info.description: SSRF vulnerability exists in osTicket before 1.14.3, allowing an attacker to add malicious files to the server or perform port scanning.
info.impact: Authenticated attackers can perform SSRF attacks to scan internal ports, access internal services, or retrieve sensitive information from internal systems.
info.remediation: Upgrade to osTicket version 1.14.3 or later.

info.name: Quixplorer <=2.4.1 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: edoardottt
info.description: Quixplorer through 2.4.1 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability. An attacker can inject arbitrary script in the browser of an unsuspecting user in the context of the affected site, which can allow the attacker to steal cookie-based authentication credentials and launch other attacks.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the context of the victim's browser, leading to potential data theft, session hijacking, or defacement of the affected website.
info.remediation: Upgrade to a patched version of Quixplorer (>=2.4.2) or apply the vendor-supplied patch to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Cute Editor for ASP.NET 6.4 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: edoardottt
info.description: Cute Editor for ASP.NET 6.4 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability. An attacker can inject arbitrary script in the browser of an unsuspecting user in the context of the affected site. This can allow the attacker to steal cookie-based authentication credentials and launch other attacks.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to inject malicious scripts into web pages viewed by users, leading to potential data theft, session hijacking, or defacement.
info.remediation: Upgrade to a patched version of Cute Editor for ASP.NET or implement proper input validation to prevent XSS attacks.

info.name: QCube Cross-Site-Scripting
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: A reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in qcubed (all versions including 3.1.1) in profile.php via the stQuery-parameter allows unauthenticated attackers to steal sessions of authenticated users.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute malicious scripts in the victim's browser, potentially leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Upgrade to the latest version to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: PHP-Fusion 9.03.50 - Remote Code Execution
info.author: geeknik
info.description: PHP-Fusion 9.03.50 downloads/downloads.php allows an authenticated user (not admin) to send a crafted request to the server and perform remote command execution.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability allows an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the affected system, potentially leading to full compromise.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patch or upgrade to a non-vulnerable version of PHP-Fusion.

info.name: D-Link DCS-2530L/DCS-2670L - Administrator Password Disclosure
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: D-Link DCS-2530L before 1.06.01 Hotfix and DCS-2670L through 2.02 devices are vulnerable to password disclosures vulnerabilities because the  /config/getuser endpoint allows for remote administrator password disclosure.
info.impact: An attacker can obtain the administrator password, potentially leading to unauthorized access and control of the camera.
info.remediation: Update the camera firmware to the latest version to fix the vulnerability.

info.name: Pritunl VPN Server 1.29.2145.25 - Username Enumeration
info.author: pussycat0x
info.description: Pritunl 1.29.2145.25 contains a username enumeration issue caused by different error responses in /auth/session login attempts, letting attackers verify valid usernames, exploit requires network access to the login endpoint.
info.impact: Attackers can enumerate valid VPN usernames, potentially aiding targeted attacks or credential stuffing efforts.
info.remediation: Implement uniform error responses for login attempts to prevent username enumeration.

info.name: WordPress File Manager Plugin - Remote Code Execution
info.author: foulenzer
info.description: The WordPress File Manager plugin prior to version 6.9 is susceptible to remote code execution. The vulnerability allows unauthenticated remote attackers to upload .php files.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the affected WordPress site.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version of the WordPress File Manager Plugin to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could lead to remote code execution, allowing attackers to take control of the affected system.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches provided by Sophos to mitigate the vulnerability.

info.name: Xinuo Openserver 5/6 - Cross-Site scripting
info.author: 0x_Akoko
info.description: Xinuo (formerly SCO) Openserver versions 5 and 6 allows remote attackers to inject arbitrary web script or HTML tag via the parameter 'section' and is vulnerable to reflected cross-site scripting.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary scripts or steal sensitive information from users.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches or updates provided by Xinuo to fix the XSS vulnerability.

info.name: D-Link DNS-320 - Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution
info.author: gy741
info.description: D-Link DNS-320 FW v2.06B01 Revision Ax is susceptible to a command injection vulnerability in a system_mgr.cgi component. The component does not successfully sanitize the value of the HTTP parameters f_ntp_server, which in turn leads to arbitrary command execution.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on the affected device.
info.remediation: Apply the latest firmware update provided by D-Link to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server - Remote Code Execution
info.author: dwisiswant0
info.description: Oracle WebLogic Server (Oracle Fusion Middleware (component: WLS Core Components) is susceptible to a remote code execution vulnerability. Supported versions that are affected are 10.3.6.0.0, 12.1.3.0.0, 2.2.1.3.0 and 12.2.1.4.0. This easily exploitable vulnerability could allow unauthenticated attackers with network access via IIOP to compromise Oracle WebLogic Server.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the affected system.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches provided by Oracle to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: ThinkAdmin 6 - Local File Inclusion
info.author: geeknik
info.description: ThinkAdmin version 6 is affected by a local file inclusion vulnerability because an unauthorized attacker can read arbitrary files on a remote server via GET request encode parameter.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can lead to unauthorized access to sensitive files, remote code execution, and potential compromise of the entire system.
info.remediation: Apply the latest patch or upgrade to a version that is not affected by the vulnerability.

info.name: Commvault CommCell - Local File Inclusion
info.author: pdteam
info.description: CommCell in Commvault before 14.68, 15.x before 15.58, 16.x before 16.44, 17.x before 17.29, and 18.x before 18.13 are vulnerable to local file inclusion because an attacker can view a log file can instead view a file outside of the log-files folder.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to read sensitive files on the system.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches or updates provided by Commvault to fix the local file inclusion vulnerability.

info.name: HashiCorp Consul/Consul Enterprise <=1.9.4 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: c-sh0
info.description: HashiCorp Consul and Consul Enterprise up to version 1.9.4 are vulnerable to cross-site scripting via the key-value (KV) raw mode.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the context of the victim's browser, leading to potential data theft, session hijacking, or defacement of the affected Consul/Consul Enterprise application.

info.name: Cisco SD-WAN vManage Software - Local File Inclusion
info.author: madrobot
info.description: Cisco SD-WAN vManage Software in the application data endpoints is vulnerable to local file inclusion which could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to gain access to sensitive information.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to read sensitive files on the affected system.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches provided by Cisco to fix the vulnerability.

info.name: Event Espresso Core-Reg 4.10.7.p - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: Event Espresso Core-Reg 4.10.7.p is vulnerable to cross-site scripting in wp-content/plugins/event-espresso-core-reg/admin_pages/messages/templates/ee_msg_admin_overview.template.php and allows remote attackers to inject arbitrary web script or HTML via the page parameter.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could lead to the execution of arbitrary script code in the context of the affected website, potentially allowing an attacker to steal sensitive information or perform unauthorized actions.
info.remediation: Upgrade to Event Espresso Core-Reg version 4.10.7.p or later to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Alerta < 8.1.0 - Authentication Bypass
info.author: CasperGN,daffainfo
info.description: Alerta prior to version 8.1.0 is prone to authentication bypass when using LDAP as an authorization provider and the LDAP server accepts Unauthenticated Bind requests.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability allows an attacker to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to Alerta.
info.remediation: Upgrade Alerta to version 8.1.0 or later to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: XStream <1.4.14 - Remote Code Execution

An attacker can run arbitrary shell commands by manipulating the processed input stream, thereby making it possible to obtain sensitive information, modify data, and/or execute unauthorized administrative operations in the context of the affected site. Users who rely on blocklists are affected.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the target system.
info.remediation: Fixed in 1.4.14.

info.name: PrestaShop Product Comments <4.2.0 - SQL Injection
info.author: edoardottt
info.description: PrestaShop Product Comments module before version 4.2.1 contains a SQL injection vulnerability, An attacker can use a blind SQL injection to retrieve data or stop the MySQL service, thereby possibly obtaining sensitive information, modifying data, and/or executing unauthorized administrative operations in the context of the affected site.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability allows an attacker to execute arbitrary SQL queries, potentially leading to unauthorized access, data leakage, or data manipulation.
info.remediation: Fixed in 4.2.1.

info.name: XStream <1.4.15 - Server-Side Request Forgery
info.author: pwnhxl
info.description: XStream before 1.4.15 is susceptible to server-side request forgery. An attacker can request data from internal resources that are not publicly available by manipulating the processed input stream, thereby making it possible to obtain sensitive information, modify data, and/or execute unauthorized administrative operations.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to make requests to internal resources, potentially leading to data leakage or further attacks.
info.remediation: Install at least 1.4.15 if you rely on XStream's default blacklist of the Security Framework, and at least Java 15 or higher.

info.name: Gitlab CE/EE 13.4 - 13.6.2 - Information Disclosure
info.author: _0xf4n9x_,pikpikcu
info.description: GitLab CE and EE 13.4 through 13.6.2 is susceptible to Information disclosure via GraphQL. User email is visible. An attacker can possibly obtain sensitive information, modify data, and/or execute unauthorized administrative operations in the context of the affected site.
info.impact: An attacker can gain unauthorized access to sensitive information.
info.remediation: Upgrade Gitlab CE/EE to version 13.6.3 or later.

info.name: SAP Solution Manager - Open Redirect
info.author: Gal Nagli,LRVT
info.description: SAP Solution Manager contains an open redirect vulnerability via the logoff endpoint. An attacker can redirect a user to a malicious site and possibly obtain sensitive information, modify data, and/or execute unauthorized operations.
info.impact: Attackers can redirect users to malicious websites through crafted links, potentially facilitating phishing attacks or credential theft.
info.remediation: Apply security patches or updates provided by SAP to fix the vulnerability.

info.name: WordPress WP Courses Plugin Information Disclosure
info.author: dwisiswant0
info.description: WordPress WP Courses Plugin < 2.0.29 contains a critical information disclosure which exposes private course videos and materials.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to gain sensitive information about the WordPress WP Courses Plugin.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version of the WordPress WP Courses Plugin (1.0.9) to fix the information disclosure vulnerability.

info.name: Ruckus vRioT IoT Controller - Authentication Bypass
info.author: DhiyaneshDk
info.description: Ruckus vRioT through 1.5.1.0.21 contains an API backdoor caused by a hardcoded token in validate_token.py,letting unauthenticated attackers interact with the API without authentication.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can interact with the API without authentication via a hardcoded token, allowing complete control over the IoT controller and connected devices.
info.remediation: Update to Ruckus vRioT version 1.5.1.0.22 or later.

info.name: NETGEAR ProSAFE Plus - Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution
info.author: gy741
info.description: NETGEAR ProSAFE Plus  before 2.6.0.43 is susceptible to unauthenticated remote code execution. Any HTML page is allowed as a valid endpoint to submit POST requests, allowing debug action via the submitId and debugCmd parameters. The problem is publicly exposed in the login.html webpage, which has to be publicly available to perform login requests but does not implement any restriction for executing debug actions. This will allow attackers to execute system commands.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the affected device.
info.remediation: Apply the latest firmware update provided by NETGEAR to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: phpMyAdmin < 5.0.3 - SQL Injection
info.author: 0x_Akoko
info.description: phpMyAdmin before 4.9.6 and 5.x before 5.0.3 contains a SQL injection caused by improper processing of SQL statements in the search feature, letting attackers inject malicious SQL, exploit requires crafted search input.
info.impact: Attackers can execute arbitrary SQL commands, potentially leading to data theft, modification, or deletion.
info.remediation: Update to phpMyAdmin 4.9.6 or 5.0.3, or latest version.

info.name: Emby < 4.5.0 - Server Server-Side Request Forgery
info.author: dwisiswant0
info.description: Emby Server before 4.5.0 allows server-side request forgery (SSRF) via the Items/RemoteSearch/Image ImageURL parameter.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to access internal resources, perform port scanning, and potentially pivot to other systems.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches or upgrade to a patched version of Emby Server.

info.name: LionWiki <3.2.12 - Local File Inclusion
info.author: 0x_Akoko
info.description: LionWiki before 3.2.12 allows an unauthenticated user to read files as the web server user via crafted strings in the index.php f1 variable, aka local file inclusion.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to access sensitive information, such as configuration files, credentials, or other sensitive data.
info.remediation: Upgrade LionWiki to version 3.2.12 or later to mitigate the LFI vulnerability.

info.name: JD Edwards EnterpriseOne Tools 9.2 - Information Disclosure
info.author: DhiyaneshDk,pussycat0x
info.description: JD Edwards EnterpriseOne Tools 9.2 is susceptible to information disclosure via the Monitoring and Diagnostics component. An attacker with network access via HTTP can possibly obtain sensitive information, modify data, and/or execute unauthorized administrative operations in the context of the affected site.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could lead to unauthorized access to sensitive information.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches or updates provided by the vendor to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Akkadian Provisioning Manager 4.50.02 - Sensitive Information Disclosure
info.author: gy741
info.description: Akkadian Provisioning Manager 4.50.02 could allow viewing of sensitive information within the /pme subdirectories.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to gain access to sensitive information, potentially leading to further attacks.
info.remediation: Apply the latest patch or upgrade to a newer version of Akkadian Provisioning Manager to fix the vulnerability.

info.name: Processwire CMS <2.7.1 - Local File Inclusion
info.author: 0x_Akoko
info.description: Processwire CMS prior to 2.7.1 is vulnerable to local file inclusion because it allows a remote attacker to retrieve sensitive files via the download parameter to index.php.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to read sensitive files, execute arbitrary code, or gain unauthorized access to the system.
info.remediation: Upgrade Processwire CMS to version 2.7.1 or later to fix the Local File Inclusion vulnerability.

info.name: Good Layers LMS Plugin <= 2.1.4 - SQL Injection
info.author: edoardottt
info.description: An unauthenticated SQL Injection vulnerability in Good Layers LMS Plugin <= 2.1.4 exists due to the usage of "wp_ajax_nopriv" call in WordPress, which allows any unauthenticated user to get access to the function "gdlr_lms_cancel_booking" where POST Parameter "id" was sent straight into SQL query without sanitization.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary SQL queries, potentially leading to unauthorized access, data leakage, or data manipulation.
info.remediation: Upgrade to the latest version of the Good Layers LMS Plugin (2.1.5 or higher) to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: WordPress Loginizer < 1.6.4 – Unauthenticated SQL Injection via `log` Parameter
info.author: intelligent-ears
info.description: The Loginizer plugin before 1.6.4 for WordPress allows SQL injection (with resultant XSS), related to loginizer_login_failed and lz_valid_ip.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can execute SQL injection to extract database contents and execute malicious scripts, potentially compromising the entire WordPress installation and all user data.
info.remediation: Fixed in version 1.6.4

info.name: Wing FTP 6.4.4 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: Wing FTP 6.4.4 is vulnerable to cross-site scripting via its web interface because an arbitrary IFRAME element can be included in the help pages via a crafted link, leading to the execution of (sandboxed) arbitrary HTML and JavaScript in the user's browser.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary script code in the context of the victim's browser, leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Upgrade to the latest version of Wing FTP server or apply the vendor-provided patch to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: KeyCloak - Information Exposure
info.author: mchklt
info.description: A flaw was found in keycloak in versions prior to 13.0.0. The client registration endpoint allows fetching information about PUBLIC clients (like client secret) without authentication which could be an issue if the same PUBLIC client changed to CONFIDENTIAL later. The highest threat from this vulnerability is to data confidentiality.
info.impact: The vulnerability allows an attacker to gain sensitive information from the KeyCloak server.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches or updates provided by the KeyCloak vendor.

info.name: NETGEAR - Authentication Bypass
info.author: gy741
info.description: NETGEAR R6020, R6080, R6120, R6220, R6260, R6700v2, R6800, R6900v2, R7450, JNR3210, WNR2020, Nighthawk AC2100, and Nighthawk AC2400 routers are vulnerable to authentication bypass vulnerabilities which could allow network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can lead to unauthorized access to the router's settings, allowing an attacker to modify network configurations, intercept traffic, or launch further attacks.
info.remediation: Apply the latest firmware update provided by NETGEAR to fix the authentication bypass vulnerability.

info.name: IceWarp WebMail 11.4.5.0 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: madrobot
info.description: IceWarp WebMail 11.4.5.0 is vulnerable to cross-site scripting via the language parameter.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the context of the victim's browser, leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patch or upgrade to a non-vulnerable version of IceWarp WebMail.

info.name: SonarQube - Authentication Bypass
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description:
SonarQube 8.4.2.36762 allows remote attackers to discover cleartext SMTP,
SVN, and GitLab credentials via the api/settings/values URI.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to sensitive information.
info.remediation: Reportedly, the vendor's position for SMTP and SVN is "it is the administrator's responsibility to configure it."

info.name: TerraMaster TOS < 4.2.06 - User Enumeration
info.author: pussycat0x
info.description: User Enumeration vulnerability in TerraMaster TOS <= 4.2.06 allows remote unauthenticated attackers to identify valid users within the system via the username parameter to wizard/initialise.php.
info.impact: An attacker can enumerate valid usernames, potentially aiding in further attacks.
info.remediation: Upgrade TerraMaster TOS to version 4.2.06 or later.

raw:
GET /tos/index.php?user/login HTTP/1.1
Host: {{Hostname}}
POST /wizard/initialise.php HTTP/1.1
Host: {{Hostname}}
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8
X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest
Referer: {{RootURL}}/tos/index.php?user/login

tab=checkuser&username=admin

info.name: TerraMaster TOS - Unauthenticated Remote Command Execution
info.author: gy741
info.description: TerraMaster TOS <= 4.2.06 is susceptible to a remote code execution vulnerability which could allow remote unauthenticated attackers to inject OS commands via /include/makecvs.php via the Event parameter.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands on the affected system.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patch or update provided by TerraMaster to fix the vulnerability.

info.name: Rocket.Chat <3.9.1 - Information Disclosure
info.author: pdteam
info.description: Rocket.Chat through 3.9.1 is susceptible to information disclosure. An attacker can enumerate email addresses via the password reset function and thus potentially access sensitive information, modify data, and/or execute unauthorized operations.
info.impact: The vulnerability can lead to the exposure of sensitive information, such as user credentials or private conversations, potentially compromising the confidentiality of the system.
info.remediation: Upgrade Rocket.Chat to version 3.9.1 or later to mitigate the information disclosure vulnerability (CVE-2020-28208).

info.name: Mitel ShoreTel 19.46.1802.0 Devices - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: Mitel ShoreTel 19.46.1802.0 devices and their conference component are vulnerable to an unauthenticated attacker conducting reflected cross-site scripting attacks via the PATH_INFO variable to index.php due to insufficient validation for the time_zone object in the HOME_MEETING& page.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary scripts in the victim's browser, leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches or updates provided by Mitel to mitigate the XSS vulnerability.

info.name: geojson2kml - Command Injection
info.author: eeche,chae1xx1os,persona-twotwo,soonghee2
info.description: Detects command injection vulnerability by checking if `hacked.txt` is created and contains the expected content.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could result in unauthorized access, remote code execution, privilege escalation
info.remediation: Do not use geojson2kml. There is no fixed version for geojson2kml.

info.name: ManageEngine OpManager SumPDU 12.1 - 12.5.232 - Java Deserialization
info.author: iamnoooob,pdresearch
info.description: Zoho ManageEngine OpManager Stable build before 125203 (and Released build before 125233) allows Remote Code Execution via the Smart Update Manager (SUM) servlet.
info.impact: Remote attackers can execute arbitrary code on the server, potentially leading to full system compromise.
info.remediation: Update to build 125203 or later.

info.name: Monitorr 1.7.6m - Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution
info.author: gy741
info.description: Monitorr 1.7.6m is susceptible to a remote code execution vulnerability. Improper input validation and lack of authorization leads to arbitrary file uploads in the web application. An unauthorized attacker with web access to could upload and execute a specially crafted file, leading to remote code execution within the Monitorr.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can lead to unauthorized remote code execution on the affected system.
info.remediation: Upgrade to a patched version of Monitorr or apply the necessary security patches.

info.name: WordPress Canto 1.3.0 - Blind Server-Side Request Forgery
info.author: LogicalHunter
info.description: WordPress Canto plugin 1.3.0 is susceptible to blind server-side request forgery. An attacker can make a request to any internal and external server via /includes/lib/detail.php?subdomain and thereby possibly obtain sensitive information, modify data, and/or execute unauthorized administrative operations in the context of the affected site.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could result in unauthorized access to sensitive internal resources and potential data leakage.
info.remediation: Update WordPress Canto to the latest version (1.3.1) or apply the patch provided by the vendor.

info.name: WP Hotel Booking < 1.10.4 - PHP Object Injection
info.author: DhiyaneshDk
info.description: The wp-hotel-booking plugin through 1.10.2 for WordPress allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code because of an unserialize operation on the thimpress_hotel_booking_1 cookie in load in includes/class-wphb-sessions.php.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can exploit PHP object injection to execute arbitrary code, leading to complete server compromise.
info.remediation: Upgrade to WP Hotel Booking version 1.10.3 or later.

info.name: PacsOne Server <7.1.1 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: geeknik
info.description: PacsOne Server (PACS Server In One Box) below 7.1.1 is vulnerable to cross-site scripting.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary scripts in the context of the victim's browser, potentially leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Upgrade to PacsOne Server version 7.1.1 or later to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Alumni Management System 1.0 - SQL Injection
info.author: arafatansari
info.description: SourceCodester Alumni Management System 1.0 contains a sql_injection caused by unsanitized input in admin/login.php, letting attackers bypass authentication, exploit requires injection of malicious SQL payload.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can bypass authentication through SQL injection, gaining administrative access to the Alumni Management System and access to all alumni data.
info.remediation: Apply vendor patches or upgrade to a patched version.

info.name: Car Rental Management System 1.0 - Local File Inclusion
info.author: daffainfo
info.description: Car Rental Management System 1.0 allows an unauthenticated user to perform a file inclusion attack against the /index.php file with a partial filename in the "page" parameter, leading to code execution.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to read sensitive files on the server, potentially leading to unauthorized access or information disclosure.
info.remediation: Apply the latest patch or update provided by the vendor to fix the LFI vulnerability in the Car Rental Management System 1.0.

info.name: 74CMS - Remote File Inclusion
info.author: DhiyaneshDK
info.description: PHP remote file inclusion in the assign_resume_tpl method in Application/Common/Controller/BaseController.class.php in 74CMS before 6.0.48 allows remote code execution.
info.impact: Remote attackers can execute arbitrary code on the server, potentially leading to full system compromise.
info.remediation: Update to version 6.0.48 or later.

raw:
POST /index.php?m=home&a=assign_resume_tpl HTTP/1.1
Host: {{Hostname}}
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

variable=1&tpl=<?php phpinfo(); echo md5("{{num}}");ob_flush();?>

info.name: Zeroshell 3.9.3 - Command Injection
info.author: DhiyaneshDk
info.description: Zeroshell 3.9.3 contains a command injection vulnerability in the /cgi-bin/kerbynet StartSessionSubmit parameter that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute a system command by using shell metacharacters and the %0a character.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands on the target system.
info.remediation: Upgrade to the latest version of Zeroshell or apply security patches provided by the vendor.

info.name: Wordpress EventON Calendar 3.0.5 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: daffainfo
info.description: Wordpress EventON Calendar 3.0.5 is vulnerable to cross-site scripting because it allows addons/?q= XSS via the search field.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could lead to the execution of arbitrary script code in the context of the affected website, potentially allowing an attacker to steal sensitive information or perform unauthorized actions.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version of the Wordpress EventON Calendar plugin (3.0.6) to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Jira Server Pre-Auth - Arbitrary File Retrieval (WEB-INF, META-INF)
info.author: dwisiswant0
info.description: The CachingResourceDownloadRewriteRule class in Jira Server and Jira Data Center allowed unauthenticated remote attackers to read arbitrary files within WEB-INF and META-INF directories via an incorrect path access check.
info.impact: An attacker can retrieve sensitive files containing configuration information, potentially leading to further exploitation or unauthorized access.
info.remediation: Apply the necessary patches or updates provided by Atlassian to fix the vulnerability.

info.name: ZyXel USG - Hardcoded Credentials
info.author: canberbamber
info.description: A hardcoded credential vulnerability was identified in the 'zyfwp' user account in some Zyxel firewalls and AP controllers. The account was designed to deliver automatic firmware updates to connected access points through FTP.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to gain unauthorized access to the affected device, potentially leading to further compromise of the network.
info.remediation: Update the firmware of the ZyXel USG device to the latest version, which addresses the hardcoded credentials issue.

info.name: IncomCMS 2.0 - Arbitrary File Upload
info.author: princechaddha
info.description: IncomCMS 2.0 has a an insecure file upload vulnerability in modules/uploader/showcase/script.php. This allows unauthenticated attackers to upload files into the server.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can result in unauthorized access, data leakage, and potential remote code execution.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patch or update to a version that addresses the vulnerability.

info.name: Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance Software/Cisco Firepower Threat Defense - Directory Traversal
info.author: KareemSe1im
info.description: Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) Software and Cisco Firepower Threat Defense (FTD) Software are susceptible to directory traversal vulnerabilities that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to obtain read and delete access to sensitive files on a targeted system.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to read arbitrary files on the affected system, potentially leading to unauthorized access or sensitive information disclosure.
info.remediation: Apply the necessary security patches or updates provided by Cisco to mitigate the vulnerability.

info.name: Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA)/Firepower Threat Defense (FTD) - Local File Inclusion
info.author: pdteam
info.description: Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) Software and Cisco Firepower Threat Defense (FTD) Software is vulnerable to local file inclusion due to directory traversal attacks that can read sensitive files on a targeted system because of a lack of proper input validation of URLs in HTTP requests processed by an affected device. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a crafted HTTP request containing directory traversal character sequences to an affected device. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to view arbitrary files within the web services file system on the targeted device. The web services file system is enabled when the affected device is configured with either WebVPN or AnyConnect features. This vulnerability cannot be used to obtain access to ASA or FTD system files or underlying operating system (OS) files.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to read sensitive files on the affected system.
info.remediation: Apply the necessary security patches or updates provided by Cisco to fix the vulnerability.

info.name: Cockpit CMS 0.6.1 - Remote Code Execution
info.author: DhiyaneshDK
info.description: Cockpit before 0.6.1 allows an attacker to inject custom PHP code and achieve Remote Command Execution via registerCriteriaFunction in lib/MongoLite/Database.php, as demonstrated by values in JSON data to the /auth/check or /auth/requestreset URI.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can inject custom PHP code to achieve remote command execution, leading to complete Cockpit CMS compromise.
info.remediation: Upgrade to Cockpit CMS version 0.6.1 or later.

info.name: SMTP WP Plugin Directory Listing
info.author: PR3R00T
info.description: The WordPress Easy WP SMTP Plugin has its log folder remotely accessible and its content available for access.
info.impact: Low: Information disclosure
info.remediation: Upgrade to version 1.4.3 or newer and consider disabling debug logs.

info.name: Wireless Multiplex Terminal Playout Server <=20.2.8 - Default Credential Detection
info.author: Jeya Seelan
info.description: Wireless Multiplex Terminal Playout Server <=20.2.8 has a default account with a password of pokon available via its web administrative interface.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to gain unauthorized access to the server.
info.remediation: Change the default credentials to strong and unique ones.

info.name: OpenTSDB <=2.4.0 - Remote Code Execution
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: OpenTSDB 2.4.0 and earlier is susceptible to remote code execution via the yrange parameter written to a gnuplot file in the /tmp directory. An attacker can execute malware, obtain sensitive information, modify data, and/or gain full control over a compromised system without entering necessary credentials.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the affected system.
info.remediation: Upgrade OpenTSDB to a version higher than 2.4.0 to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: SearchBlox <9.2.2 - Local File Inclusion
info.author: daffainfo
info.description: SearchBlox prior to version 9.2.2 is susceptible to local file inclusion in  FileServlet that allows remote, unauthenticated users to read arbitrary files from the operating system via a /searchblox/servlet/FileServlet?col=url= request. Additionally, this may be used to read the contents of the SearchBlox configuration file (e.g., searchblox/WEB-INF/config.xml), which contains both the Super Admin API key and the base64 encoded SHA1 password hashes of other SearchBlox users.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to access sensitive information, such as configuration files, credentials, or other sensitive data stored on the server.
info.remediation: Upgrade to SearchBlox version 9.2.2 or later to mitigate the vulnerability.

info.name: Advanced Comment System 1.0 - Local File Inclusion
info.author: daffainfo
info.description: ACS Advanced Comment System 1.0 is affected by local file inclusion via an advanced_component_system/index.php?ACS_path=..%2f URI.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can lead to unauthorized access to sensitive files, remote code execution, and potential compromise of the entire system.
info.remediation: Apply the latest patch or update provided by the vendor to fix the local file inclusion vulnerability in the Advanced Comment System 1.0.

info.name: Belkin Linksys RE6500 <1.0.012.001 - Remote Command Execution
info.author: gy741
info.description: Belkin LINKSYS RE6500 devices before 1.0.012.001 allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands or set a new password via shell metacharacters to the goform/setSysAdm page.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands on the affected device.
info.remediation: Update the Belkin Linksys RE6500 firmware to version 1.0.012.001 or later.

info.name: Klog Server <=2.41 - Unauthenticated Command Injection
info.author: dwisiswant0
info.description: Klog Server 2.4.1 and prior is susceptible to an unauthenticated command injection vulnerability. The `authenticate.php` file uses the `user` HTTP POST parameter in a call to the `shell_exec()` PHP function without appropriate input validation, allowing arbitrary command execution as the apache user. The sudo configuration permits the Apache user to execute any command as root without providing a password, resulting in privileged command execution as root. Originated from Metasploit module, copyright (c) space-r7.
info.impact: An attacker can execute arbitrary commands on the server, leading to remote code execution and potential compromise of the system.
info.remediation: Upgrade to a patched version of Klog Server (>=2.42) or apply the vendor-supplied patch.

info.name: GateOne 1.1 - Local File Inclusion
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: GateOne 1.1 allows arbitrary file retrieval without authentication via /downloads/.. local file inclusion because os.path.join is incorrectly used.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can lead to unauthorized access to sensitive files, remote code execution, and potential compromise of the affected system.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches or updates provided by the vendor to mitigate the LFI vulnerability in GateOne 1.1.

info.name: WordPress Simple Job Board <2.9.4 - Local File Inclusion
info.author: cckuailong
info.description: WordPress Simple Job Board prior to version 2.9.4 is vulnerable to arbitrary file retrieval vulnerabilities because it does not validate the sjb_file parameter when viewing a resume, allowing an authenticated user with the download_resume capability (such as HR users) to download arbitrary files from the web-server via local file inclusion.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to read sensitive files on the server, potentially leading to further compromise.
info.remediation: Update to WordPress Simple Job Board version 2.9.4 or later to fix the vulnerability.

info.name: twitter-server Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: twitter-server before 20.12.0 is vulnerable to cross-site scripting in some configurations. The vulnerability exists in the administration panel of twitter-server in the histograms component via server/handler/HistogramQueryHandler.scala.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute malicious scripts in the context of the victim's browser, potentially leading to session hijacking, data theft, or defacement.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches or updates provided by Twitter to mitigate the XSS vulnerability.

info.name: Cisco ASA/FTD Software - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) Software and Cisco Firepower Threat Defense (FTD) Software are vulnerable to cross-site scripting and could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to conduct attacks against a user of the web services interface of an affected device. The vulnerabilities are due to insufficient validation of user-supplied input by the web services interface of an affected device. An attacker could exploit these vulnerabilities by persuading a user of the interface to click a crafted link. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to execute arbitrary script code in the context of the interface or allow the attacker to access sensitive, browser-based information. Note: These vulnerabilities affect only specific AnyConnect and WebVPN configurations. For more information, see the reference links.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary script code in the context of a targeted user's browser, potentially leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches or updates provided by Cisco to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Agentejo Cockpit < 0.11.2 - NoSQL Injection
info.author: dwisiswant0
info.description: Agentejo Cockpit before 0.11.2 allows NoSQL injection via the Controller/Auth.php check function. The $eq operator matches documents where the value of a field equals the specified value.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could lead to unauthorized access, data leakage, or data manipulation.
info.remediation: Upgrade Agentejo Cockpit to version 0.11.2 or later to mitigate the vulnerability.

info.name: Agentejo Cockpit <0.11.2 - NoSQL Injection
info.author: dwisiswant0
info.description: Agentejo Cockpit before 0.11.2 allows NoSQL injection via the Controller/Auth.php resetpassword function of the Auth controller.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary NoSQL queries, potentially leading to unauthorized access, data manipulation, or denial of service.
info.remediation: Upgrade Agentejo Cockpit to version 0.11.2 or later to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Agentejo Cockpit <0.12.0 - NoSQL Injection
info.author: dwisiswant0
info.description: Agentejo Cockpit prior to 0.12.0 is vulnerable to NoSQL Injection via the newpassword method of the Auth controller, which is responsible for displaying the user password reset form.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to manipulate database queries, potentially leading to unauthorized access, data leakage, or data corruption.
info.remediation: Upgrade Agentejo Cockpit to version 0.12.0 or later to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Wordpress Quiz and Survey Master <7.0.1 - Arbitrary File Deletion
info.author: princechaddha
info.description: Wordpress Quiz and Survey Master <7.0.1 allows users to delete arbitrary files such as wp-config.php file, which could effectively take a site offline and allow an attacker to reinstall with a WordPress instance under their control. This occurred via qsm_remove_file_fd_question, which allowed unauthenticated deletions (even though it was only intended for a person to delete their own quiz-answer files).
info.impact: This vulnerability can lead to unauthorized deletion of critical files, resulting in data loss or server compromise.
info.remediation: Upgrade to the latest version of Wordpress Quiz and Survey Master plugin (7.0.1 or higher) to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Rukovoditel <= 2.7.2 - Cross Site Scripting
info.author: r3Y3r53
info.description: A stored cross site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the 'Users Alerts' feature of Rukovoditel 2.7.2 allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary web scripts or HTML via a crafted payload entered into the 'Title' parameter.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute malicious scripts in the victim's browser, leading to potential data theft, session hijacking, or defacement of the application.
info.remediation: Upgrade Rukovoditel to a version higher than 2.7.2 to mitigate the XSS vulnerability.

info.name: Rukovoditel <= 2.7.2 - Cross Site Scripting
info.author: r3Y3r53
info.description: A stored cross site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the 'Global Lists" feature of Rukovoditel 2.7.2 allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary web scripts or HTML via a crafted payload entered into the 'Name' parameter.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute malicious scripts in the victim's browser, leading to potential data theft, session hijacking, or defacement of the application.
info.remediation: Upgrade Rukovoditel to a version higher than 2.7.2 to mitigate the XSS vulnerability.

info.name: Rukovoditel <= 2.7.2 - Cross Site Scripting
info.author: r3Y3r53
info.description: A stored cross site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the 'Users Access Groups' feature of Rukovoditel 2.7.2 allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary web scripts or HTML via a crafted payload entered into the 'Name' parameter.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute malicious scripts in the victim's browser, leading to potential data theft, session hijacking, or defacement of the application.
info.remediation: Upgrade Rukovoditel to a version higher than 2.7.2 to mitigate the XSS vulnerability.

info.name: Rukovoditel <= 2.7.2 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: r3Y3r53
info.description: A stored cross site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the 'Entities List' feature of Rukovoditel 2.7.2 allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary web scripts or HTML via a crafted payload entered into the 'Name' parameter.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the context of the victim's browser, leading to potential data theft, session hijacking, or defacement of the affected application.
info.remediation: Upgrade Rukovoditel to a version higher than 2.7.2 or apply the vendor-provided patch to mitigate the XSS vulnerability.

info.name: CSE Bookstore 1.0 - SQL Injection
info.author: geeknik
info.description: CSE Bookstore version 1.0 is vulnerable to time-based blind, boolean-based blind and OR error-based SQL injection in pubid parameter in bookPerPub.php. A successful exploitation of this vulnerability will lead to an attacker dumping the entire database.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can execute SQL injection to dump the entire database including sensitive student and administrative data.
info.remediation: Upgrade to the latest version to mitigate this vulnerability.
