info.name: Atmail 6.5.0 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: arafatansari,ritikchaddha
info.description: Atmail 6.5.0 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in WebAdmin Control Pane via the format parameter to the default URI, which allows remote attackers to inject arbitrary web script or HTML via the “format” parameter.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute malicious scripts in the context of the victim's browser, potentially leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches or updates provided by Atmail to fix the XSS vulnerability.

info.name: Spotweb <= 1.5.1 - Cross Site Scripting (Reflected)
info.author: theamanrawat
info.description: There is a Cross Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability in SpotPage_login.php of Spotweb 1.5.1 and below, which allows remote attackers to inject arbitrary web script or HTML via the data[performredirect] parameter.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute malicious scripts in the victim's browser, potentially leading to session hijacking, data theft, or other attacks.
info.remediation: Fixed in version 1.5.2

info.name: kkFileview v4.0.0 - Local File Inclusion
info.author: arafatansari
info.description: kkFileview v4.0.0 is vulnerable to local file inclusion which may lead to a sensitive file leak on a related host.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can lead to unauthorized access to sensitive files, remote code execution, and potential compromise of the entire system.
info.remediation: Upgrade to a patched version of kkFileview v4.0.1 or later, or apply the necessary security patches provided by the vendor.

info.name: WordPress Automatic Plugin - Unauthenticated Options Change
info.author: intelligent-ears
info.description: WordPress Automatic Plugin (versions 3.53.2 and below) contains a critical vulnerability that allows unauthenticated users to change arbitrary WordPress options through the process_form.php script. The vulnerable script uses update_option() on all POST parameters without authentication or capability checks, allowing attackers to create administrator accounts or modify critical settings. The vulnerability can be exploited even if the plugin is deactivated as it's a standalone script.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can update arbitrary WordPress options via process_form.php, enabling them to create administrator accounts, modify critical settings, or completely compromise the WordPress site.
info.remediation: Upgrade to WordPress Automatic Plugin version 3.53.3 or later, or deactivate and delete the plugin.

info.name: GLPI plugin Barcode < 2.6.1 - Path Traversal Vulnerability.
info.author: cckuailong
info.description: Barcode is a GLPI plugin for printing barcodes and QR codes. GLPI instances version 2.x prior to version 2.6.1 with the barcode plugin installed are vulnerable to a path traversal vulnerability.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to read arbitrary files on the server, potentially leading to unauthorized access or sensitive information disclosure.
info.remediation: Upgrade to version 2.6.1 or later. Or, as a workaround, delete the `front/send.php` file.

info.name: Grafana v8.x - Arbitrary File Read
info.author: z0ne,dhiyaneshDk,j4vaovo
info.description: Grafana versions 8.0.0-beta1 through 8.3.0 are vulnerable to a local directory traversal, allowing access to local files. The vulnerable URL path is `<grafana_host_url>/public/plugins/NAME/`, where NAME is the plugin ID for any installed plugin.
info.impact: An attacker can read sensitive files on the server, potentially leading to unauthorized access, data leakage, or further exploitation.
info.remediation: Upgrade to patched versions 8.0.7, 8.1.8, 8.2.7, or 8.3.1.

info.name: Pinterest Automatic < 4.14.4 - Unauthenticated Arbitrary Options Update
info.author: s4e-io
info.description: The Pinterest Automatic plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass due to missing capability checks on the 'wp_pinterest_automatic_parse_request' function and the 'process_form.php' script in versions up to, and including, 1.14.3. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to update arbitrary options on a site that can be used to create new administrative user accounts or redirect unsuspecting site visitors.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can update arbitrary WordPress options including creating administrative accounts or redirecting site visitors to malicious content.
info.remediation: Fixed in 4.14.4

info.name: Admidio - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: gy741
info.description: A cross-site scripting vulnerability is present in Admidio prior to version 4.0.12. The reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability occurs because redirect.php does not properly validate the value of the url parameter. Through this vulnerability, an attacker is capable to execute malicious scripts.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the context of the victim's browser, leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Upgrade to version 4.0.12 or later.

info.name: Gradio < 2.5.0 - Arbitrary File Read
info.author: isacaya
info.description: Files on the host computer can be accessed from the Gradio interface
info.impact: An attacker would be able to view the contents of a file on the computer.
info.remediation: Update to version 2.5.0.

info.name: Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus - Remote Code Execution
info.author: Adam Crosser,gy741
info.description: Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus before 11306, ServiceDesk Plus MSP before 10530, and SupportCenter Plus before 11014 are vulnerable to unauthenticated remote code execution.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the affected system.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patch or upgrade to a patched version of Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus.

info.name: Caucho Resin >=4.0.52 <=4.0.56 - Directory traversal
info.author: carrot2
info.description: There is a Directory traversal vulnerability in Caucho Resin, as distributed in Resin 4.0.52 - 4.0.56, which allows remote attackers to read files in arbitrary directories via a ; in a pathname within an HTTP request.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to read arbitrary files on the server, potentially leading to unauthorized access or sensitive data exposure.
info.remediation: Upgrade Caucho Resin to a version higher than 4.0.56 to mitigate the vulnerability.

info.name: Alibaba Sentinel - Server-side request forgery (SSRF)
info.author: DhiyaneshDK
info.description: There is a Pre-Auth SSRF vulnerability in Alibaba Sentinel version 1.8.2, which allows remote unauthenticated attackers to perform SSRF attacks via the /registry/machine endpoint through the ip parameter.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to send crafted requests from the server, potentially leading to unauthorized access to internal resources or network scanning.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches or updates provided by Alibaba Sentinel to fix the SSRF vulnerability (CVE-2021-44139).

info.name: Reprise License Manager 14.2 - Authentication Bypass
info.author: Akincibor
info.description: Reprise License Manager (RLM) 14.2 does not verify authentication or authorization and allows unauthenticated users to change the password of any existing user.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the Reprise License Manager.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patch or upgrade to a patched version of Reprise License Manager to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Apache Log4j2 Remote Code Injection
info.author: melbadry9,dhiyaneshDK,daffainfo,anon-artist,0xceba,Tea,j4vaovo
info.description: Apache Log4j2 <=2.14.1 JNDI features used in configuration, log messages, and parameters do not protect against attacker controlled LDAP and other JNDI related endpoints. An attacker who can control log messages or log message parameters can execute arbitrary code loaded from LDAP servers when message lookup substitution is enabled.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can lead to remote code execution, potentially compromising the affected system.
info.remediation: Upgrade to Log4j 2.3.1 (for Java 6), 2.12.3 (for Java 7), or 2.17.0 (for Java 8 and later).

info.name: WAVLINK AC1200 - Information Disclosure
info.author: ritikchaddha
info.description: A vulnerability is in the 'live_mfg.html' page of the WAVLINK AC1200, version WAVLINK-A42W-1.27.6-20180418, which can allow a remote attacker to access this page without any authentication. When processed, it exposes some key information of the manager of router.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches and updates from the vendor to address this vulnerability.
info.impact: Successful exploitation could lead to sensitive information disclosure.

info.name: 3DPrint Lite < 1.9.1.5 - Arbitrary File Upload
info.author: s4e-io
info.description: The plugin does not have any authorisation and does not check the uploaded file in its p3dlite_handle_upload AJAX action , allowing unauthenticated users to upload arbitrary file to the web server. However, there is a .htaccess, preventing the file to be accessed on Web servers such as Apache.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can upload arbitrary files including PHP scripts via the p3dlite_handle_upload AJAX action, potentially achieving remote code execution despite .htaccess protection.
info.remediation: Fixed in 1.9.1.5

info.name: Rosario Student Information System Unauthenticated SQL Injection
info.author: furkansayim,xShuden
info.description: An unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability in Rosario Student Information System (aka rosariosis) 8.1 and below allow remote attackers to execute PostgreSQL statements (e.g., SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE) through /Side.php via the syear parameter.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to extract sensitive information from the database, modify data, or execute arbitrary SQL commands.
info.remediation: Upgrade to version 8.1.1 or higher.

info.name: Apache Superset <=1.3.2 - Default Login
info.author: dhiyaneshDK
info.description: Apache Superset through 1.3.2 contains a default login vulnerability via registered database connections for authenticated users. An attacker can obtain access to user accounts and thereby obtain sensitive information, modify data, and/or execute unauthorized operations.
info.impact: An attacker can gain unauthorized access to the Apache Superset application.
info.remediation: Upgrade to Apache Superset 1.4.0 or higher.

info.name: Kaswara Modern VC Addons <= 3.0.1 - Missing Authorization
info.author: daffainfo
info.description: The Kaswara Modern VC Addons plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in versions up to, and including, 3.0.1 due to insufficient capability checking on various AJAX actions. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to perform a wide variety of unauthorized actions such as importing data, uploading arbitrary files, deleting arbitrary files, and more.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can perform unauthorized actions including file uploads, deletions, and data import, potentially leading to site compromise.
info.remediation: Deactivate and delete the plugin from the server

info.name: ZoomSounds Plugin - Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload
info.author: 0xnemian
info.description: ZoomSounds plugin for WordPress contains a file upload vulnerability in savepng.php
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can upload arbitrary PHP files via savepng.php without authentication or validation, achieving remote code execution and complete server compromise.
info.remediation: Upgrade to ZoomSounds plugin version that addresses the file upload vulnerability.

info.name: Zoho ManageEngine Desktop Central - Remote Code Execution
info.author: Adam Crosser
info.description: Zoho ManageEngine Desktop Central contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code in the Desktop Central MSP server.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the affected system.
info.remediation: For Enterprise builds 10.1.2127.17 and earlier, upgrade to 10.1.2127.18. For Enterprise builds 10.1.2128.0 through 10.1.2137.2, upgrade to 10.1.2137.3. For MSP builds 10.1.2127.17 and earlier, upgrade to 10.1.2127.18. For MSP builds 10.1.2128.0 through 10.1.2137.2, upgrade to 10.1.2137.3.

info.name: Open Redirect in Host Authorization Middleware
info.author: geeknik
info.description: Specially crafted "X-Forwarded-Host" headers in combination with certain "allowed host" formats can cause the Host Authorization middleware in Action Pack to redirect users to a malicious website.
info.impact: This vulnerability can lead to phishing attacks, where users are tricked into visiting malicious websites and disclosing sensitive information.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches or updates provided by the vendor to fix the Open Redirect vulnerability in the Host Authorization Middleware.

info.name: Ivanti EPM Cloud Services Appliance Code Injection
info.author: duty_1g,phyr3wall,Tirtha
info.description: Ivanti EPM Cloud Services Appliance (CSA) before version 4.6.0-512 is susceptible to a code injection vulnerability because it allows an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code with limited permissions (nobody).
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could lead to remote code execution and compromise of the affected system.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches provided by Ivanti to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Employee Records System 1.0 - Unauthenticated File Upload RCE
info.author: josephttd
info.description: Employee Records System version 1.0 contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability in uploadID.php that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to upload arbitrary PHP files and achieve remote code execution.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can upload arbitrary PHP files via uploadID.php and achieve remote code execution, leading to complete server compromise.
info.remediation: Apply security patches or upgrade to a later version of Employee Records System.

info.name: Longjing Technology BEMS API 1.21 - Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Download
info.author: gy741
info.description: Longjing Technology BEMS API 1.21 is vulnerable to local file inclusion. Input passed through the fileName parameter through the downloads API endpoint is not properly verified before being used to download files. This can be exploited to disclose the contents of arbitrary and sensitive files through directory traversal attacks.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can download sensitive files outside the intended directory, leading to information disclosure.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version beyond 1.21.

info.name: Thinfinity VirtualUI User Enumeration
info.author: danielmofer
info.description: Thinfinity VirtualUI (before v3.0), /changePassword returns different responses for requests depending on whether the username exists. It may enumerate OS users (Administrator, Guest, etc.)
info.impact: An attacker can use the gathered usernames for further attacks, such as brute-forcing passwords or launching targeted phishing campaigns.
info.remediation: Apply the vendor-supplied patch or upgrade to the latest version of Thinfinity VirtualUI to mitigate the user enumeration vulnerability.

info.name: SpringBlade - Information Leakage
info.author: lbb
info.description: SpringBlade is a comprehensive project upgraded and optimized from a commercial-grade project, featuring both a SpringCloud distributed microservice architecture and a SpringBoot monolithic microservice architecture. The SpringBlade framework has a default SIGN_KEY, which can be exploited by attackers to obtain sensitive information such as user account password logs.
info.impact: Attackers using default SIGN_KEY can forge JWT tokens to obtain sensitive user information including account credentials, password hashes, and logs from the SpringBlade system.
info.remediation: Change the default SIGN_KEY to a strong, unique value in the SpringBlade configuration.

info.name: Oliver 5 Library Server <8.00.008.053 - Local File Inclusion
info.author: gy741
info.description: Oliver 5 Library Server versions prior to 8.00.008.053 are vulnerable to local file inclusion via the FileServlet function.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can read arbitrary files from the Windows server including win.ini via path traversal in the fileName parameter.
info.remediation: Upgrade to Oliver 5 Library Server version 8.00.008.053 or later.

info.name: HD-Network Realtime Monitoring System 2.0 - Local File Inclusion
info.author: Momen Eldawakhly,Evan Rubinstein
info.description: Instances of HD-Network Realtime Monitoring System version 2.0 are vulnerable to a Local File Inclusion vulnerability which allows remote unauthenticated attackers to view confidential information.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to access sensitive information, such as configuration files, credentials, or other sensitive data stored on the server.
info.remediation: Apply the latest patch or update provided by the vendor to fix the LFI vulnerability in HD-Network Realtime Monitoring System 2.0.

info.name: Apache Log4j2 - Remote Code Injection
info.author: ImNightmaree
info.description: Apache Log4j2 Thread Context Lookup Pattern is vulnerable to remote code execution in certain non-default configurations.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the affected system.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches or upgrade to a non-vulnerable version of Apache Log4j2.

info.name: Thinfinity Iframe Injection
info.author: danielmofer
info.description: A vulnerability exists in Thinfinity VirtualUI in a function located in /lab.html reachable which by default  could allow IFRAME injection via the "vpath" parameter.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can lead to unauthorized access, data leakage, and potential remote code execution.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches or updates provided by the vendor to fix the vulnerability.

info.name: Apache APISIX Dashboard <2.10.1 - API Unauthorized Access
info.author: Mr-xn
info.description: In Apache APISIX Dashboard before 2.10.1, the Manager API uses two frameworks and introduces framework `droplet` on the basis of framework `gin.' While all APIs and authentication middleware are developed based on framework `droplet`,  some API directly use the interface of framework `gin` thus bypassing their authentication.
info.impact: An attacker can gain unauthorized access to the API, potentially leading to data breaches or unauthorized actions.
info.remediation: Upgrade to release 2.10.1 or later. Or, change the default username and password, and restrict the source IP to access the Apache APISIX Dashboard.

info.name: Gitea < 1.4.3 - Open Redirect
info.author: ritikchaddha
info.description: Gitea before version 1.4.3 is affected by URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect') via internal URLs. The vulnerability exists in the redirect_to parameter used on the login page (/user/login). Due to improper validation of the redirect URL, an attacker can craft a malicious link that redirects authenticated users to an arbitrary external website after login.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to redirect users to malicious websites, leading to phishing attacks or the theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Upgrade Gitea to version 1.4.3 or later to fix the open redirect vulnerability.

info.name: AppCMS - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: AppCMS 2.0.101 has a cross-site scripting vulnerability in \templates\m\inc_head.php.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the context of the victim's browser, leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Upgrade to the latest version to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: D-Link - Remote Command Execution
info.author: king-alexander
info.description: A Remote Command Execution (RCE) vulnerability exists in all series H/W revisions D-link DIR-810L, DIR-820L/LW, DIR-826L, DIR-830L, and DIR-836L routers via the DDNS function in ncc2 binary file
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can execute arbitrary system commands via command injection in the DDNS function, leading to complete router compromise and control over network traffic.
info.remediation: DIR-810L, DIR-820L, DIR-830L, DIR-826L, DIR-836L, all hardware revisions, have reached their End of Life ("EOL") /End of Service Life ("EOS") Life-Cycle and as such this issue will not be patched.

info.name: Emerson Dixell XWEB-500 - Arbitrary File Write
info.author: hackerarpan
info.description: Emerson Dixell XWEB-500 contains an arbitrary file write caused by unauthenticated access to /cgi-bin/logo_extra_upload.cgi, /cgi-bin/cal_save.cgi, and /cgi-bin/lo_utils.cgi, letting attackers write any file on the system, exploit requires no authentication.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can write arbitrary files to any location on the Dixell XWEB-500 server, potentially uploading malicious CGI scripts or modifying system files.
info.remediation: Apply firmware updates provided by Emerson Dixell or restrict network access to the device.

info.name: Reprise License Manager 14.2 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: edoardottt
info.description: Reprise License Manager 14.2 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in the /goform/activate_process "count" parameter via GET.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the context of the victim's browser, leading to potential session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches or updates provided by the vendor to fix the XSS vulnerability in Reprise License Manager 14.2.

info.name: Telesquare TLR-2005KSH 1.0.0 - Arbitrary File Upload
info.author: gy741
info.description: TLR-2005KSH is affected by an incorrect access control vulnerability. THe PUT method is enabled so an attacker can upload arbitrary files including HTML and CGI formats.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could result in unauthorized accessand data leakage.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patch or update to a version that addresses the arbitrary file upload vulnerability.

info.name: Control Web Panel (CWP) - File Inclusion
info.author: ritikchaddha
info.description: In CWP (Control Web Panel, previously CentOS Web Panel) before version 0.9.8.1107, an unauthenticated attacker can abuse null byte (%00) injection with the "scripts" parameter in the /user/loader.php or /user/login.php endpoints to register arbitrary API keys or access sensitive files. This can be exploited by using multiple %00 sequences to traverse directories via crafted requests such as /user/loader.php?api=1&scripts=.%00./.%00./api/account_new_create&acc=guadaapi, or similar payloads with more %00 instances (e.g., .%00%00%00./.%00%00%00./api/account_new_create). Attackers may use this flaw for arbitrary file access, privilege escalation, or remote code execution.
info.impact: A remote, unauthenticated attacker can leverage this vulnerability to register arbitrary API keys, access sensitive files (such as /etc/passwd), and potentially achieve remote code execution. Successful exploitation results in full compromise of the web panel and host system, allowing for exposure of confidential data, server takeover, and further attacks on internal infrastructure.
info.remediation: Update to version 0.9.8.1107 or later to fix input validation issues.

info.name: Slims9 Bulian 9.4.2 - SQL Injection
info.author: nblirwn
info.description: Slims9 Bulian 9.4.2 is affected by SQL injection in lib/comment.inc.php. User data can be obtained.
info.impact: Authenticated attackers can exploit SQL injection in the comment field to extract database contents including user credentials and sensitive library data.
info.remediation: Upgrade to Slims9 Bulian version 9.4.3 or later.

info.name: osTicket 1.15.x - SQL Injection
info.author: ritikchaddha
info.description: A SQL injection vulnerability in the "Search" functionality of "tickets.php" page in osTicket 1.15.x allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary SQL commands via the "keywords" and "topic_id" URL parameters combination.
info.impact: Authenticated attackers can exploit SQL injection in the Search functionality to extract sensitive database contents including user credentials and ticket information.
info.remediation: Upgrade osTicket to later version to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Pascom CPS Server-Side Request Forgery
info.author: dwisiswant0
info.description: Pascom versions before 7.20 packaged with Cloud Phone System contain a known server-side request forgery vulnerability.
info.impact: The vulnerability can result in unauthorized access to sensitive data or systems, potentially leading to further exploitation or compromise.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches or updates provided by Pascom to fix the Server-Side Request Forgery vulnerability (CVE-2021-45967).

info.name: Pascom CPS - Local File Inclusion
info.author: dwisiswant0
info.description: Pascom packaged with Cloud Phone System (CPS) versions before 7.20 contain a known local file inclusion vulnerability.
info.impact: The vulnerability can be exploited by an attacker to gain unauthorized access to sensitive information, execute arbitrary code, or perform other malicious activities.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches or updates provided by the vendor to fix the Local File Inclusion vulnerability in Pascom CPS.

info.name: Vehicle Service Management System - Stored Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: TenBird
info.description: A Stored Cross Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Vehicle Service Management System 1.0 via the My Account Section in login panel.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to inject malicious scripts into the application, leading to the execution of arbitrary code or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Upgrade to the latest version to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Vehicle Service Management System 1.0 - Stored Cross Site Scripting
info.author: TenBird
info.description: Vehicle Service Management System 1.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability via the Mechanic List section in login panel.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to inject malicious scripts into the application, leading to the execution of arbitrary code or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Upgrade to the latest version to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: ehicle Service Management System 1.0 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: TenBird
info.description: Vehicle Service Management System 1.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability via the Category List section in login panel.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to inject malicious scripts into web pages viewed by users, leading to potential data theft, session hijacking, or defacement.
info.remediation: To remediate this issue, it is recommended to implement proper input validation and sanitization techniques to prevent the execution of malicious scripts.

info.name: Vehicle Service Management System 1.0 - Stored Cross Site Scripting
info.author: TenBird
info.description: Vehicle Service Management System 1.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability via the Service List section in login panel.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to inject malicious scripts into the application, leading to the execution of arbitrary code or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Upgrade to the latest version to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Vehicle Service Management System 1.0 - Cross Site Scripting
info.author: TenBird
info.description: Vehicle Service Management System 1.0 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability via the User List section in login panel.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to inject malicious scripts into web pages viewed by users, leading to potential data theft, session hijacking, or defacement of the affected application.
info.remediation: Upgrade to the latest version to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: webp_server_go 0.4.0 - Path Traversal
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: webp_server_go 0.4.0 contains a path traversal caused by insufficient sanitization in file handling, letting attackers read arbitrary files on the server, exploit requires attacker to send crafted requests.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can read arbitrary files from the server including /etc/passwd via path traversal using double URL encoding.
info.remediation: Upgrade to webp_server_go version 0.4.1 or later that properly sanitizes file paths.

info.name: Ligeo Archives Ligeo Basics - Server Side Request Forgery
info.author: ritikchaddha
info.description: Ligeo Archives Ligeo Basics as of 02_01-2022 is vulnerable to Server Side Request Forgery (SSRF) which allows an attacker to read any documents via the download features.
info.impact: The impact of this vulnerability is significant as it can result in unauthorized access to sensitive data or systems.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches or updates provided by the vendor to fix the Server Side Request Forgery vulnerability.

info.name: AntD Admin - Sensitive Information Disclosure
info.author: ritikchaddha
info.description: AntD Admin has a security vulnerability that stems from Antd-admin 5.5.0 being affected by an incorrect access control vulnerability. Attackers can exploit this vulnerability to gain unauthorized access to some front-end interfaces, resulting in the leakage of sensitive information such as user IDs, names, ages, phone numbers, addresses, and more.
info.impact: Unauthorized users can access sensitive information, leading to potential data leakage and privacy breaches.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version of antd-admin that addresses access control issues.

info.name: D-Link DIR850 ET850-1.08TRb03 - Open Redirect
info.author: 0x_Akoko
info.description: DLink DIR850 ET850-1.08TRb03 contains incorrect access control vulnerability in URL redirection, which can be used to mislead users to go to untrusted sites.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to redirect users to malicious websites, leading to phishing attacks or the download of malware.
info.remediation: Apply the latest firmware update provided by D-Link to fix the open redirect vulnerability.

info.name: D-Link DAP-1620 - Local File Inclusion
info.author: 0x_Akoko
info.description: D-Link DAP-1620 is susceptible to local file Inclusion due to path traversal that can  lead to unauthorized internal files reading [/etc/passwd] and [/etc/shadow].
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to access sensitive information, such as configuration files or credentials, leading to further compromise of the device or network.
info.remediation: Apply the latest firmware update provided by D-Link to fix the local file inclusion vulnerability.

info.name: Zyxel ZyWALL 2 Plus Internet Security Appliance - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: DhiyaneshDk
info.description: ZyXEL ZyWALL 2 Plus Internet Security Appliance contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability. Insecure URI handling leads to bypass of security restrictions, which allows an attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript codes to perform multiple attacks.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary script code in the context of a user's browser, potentially leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches or firmware updates provided by Zyxel to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Franklin Fueling Systems Colibri Controller Module 1.8.19.8580 - Local File Inclusion
info.author: For3stCo1d
info.description: Franklin Fueling Systems Colibri Controller Module 1.8.19.8580 is susceptible to local file inclusion because of insecure handling of a download function that leads to disclosure of internal files due to path traversal with root privileges.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could lead to unauthorized access to sensitive information, including configuration files, credentials, and other sensitive data.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patch or update provided by Franklin Fueling Systems to fix the LFI vulnerability.

info.name: Telesquare TLR-2855KS6 - Arbitrary File Creation
info.author: DhiyaneshDK
info.description: An unauthorized file creation vulnerability in Telesquare TLR-2855KS6 via PUT method can allow creation of CGI scripts.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can create arbitrary files including CGI scripts via HTTP PUT requests, potentially achieving remote code execution.
info.remediation: Apply firmware updates provided by Telesquare or restrict HTTP PUT access to the device.

info.name: Telesquare TLR-2855KS6 - Arbitrary File Deletion
info.author: DhiyaneshDK
info.description: An unauthorized file deletion vulnerability in Telesquare TLR-2855KS6 via DELETE method can allow deletion of system files and scripts.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can delete arbitrary files from the Telesquare TLR-2855KS6 device using HTTP DELETE requests, potentially destroying system files and rendering the device inoperable.
info.remediation: Apply firmware updates provided by Telesquare or restrict HTTP DELETE access to the device.

info.name: SDT-CW3B1 1.1.0 - OS Command Injection
info.author: badboycxcc,prajiteshsingh
info.description: Telesquare SDT-CW3B1 1.1.0 is affected by an OS command injection vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute OS commands without any authentication.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability allows an attacker to execute arbitrary commands on the target system.
info.remediation: Upgrade to a patched version of SDT-CW3B1 or apply the vendor-supplied patch to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Telesquare TLR-2005KSH 1.0.0 - Arbitrary File Delete
info.author: gy741
info.description: Telesquare TLR-2005KSH 1.0.0 is affected by an arbitrary file deletion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to delete any file, even system internal files, via a DELETE request.
info.impact: Successful exploitation could lead to loss of critical data or system instability.
info.remediation: Apply the latest patch or update provided by the vendor to fix the vulnerability.

info.name: GenieACS => 1.2.8 - OS Command Injection
info.author: DhiyaneshDK
info.description: In GenieACS 1.2.x before 1.2.8, the UI interface API is vulnerable to unauthenticated OS command injection via the ping host argument (lib/ui/api.ts and lib/ping.ts). The vulnerability arises from insufficient input validation combined with a missing authorization check.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands on the target system.
info.remediation: Upgrade to a patched version of GenieACS or apply the necessary security patches to mitigate the vulnerability.

info.name: GeoVision GeoWebServer <= 5.3.3 - Local File Inclusion / Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: shamo0
info.description: GeoVision GeoWebServer 5.3.3 and prior is vulnerable to local file inclusion and cross-site scripting due to improper sanitization of user-supplied input in the WebStrings.srf endpoint. An unauthenticated attacker can read arbitrary files from the server or inject malicious scripts.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can read arbitrary files from the server via path traversal, or execute arbitrary JavaScript in the victim's browser via reflected XSS.
info.remediation: Contact GeoVision support for a patched firmware version that addresses the input sanitization issues.

info.name: Keystone 6 Login Page - Open Redirect and Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: ShivanshKhari
info.description: On the login page, there is a "from=" parameter in URL which is vulnerable to open redirect and can be escalated to reflected XSS.
info.impact: Attackers can redirect users to malicious websites or inject malicious JavaScript via the from parameter, potentially facilitating phishing attacks or stealing user credentials.
info.remediation: Please upgrade to @keystone-6/auth >= 1.0.2, where this vulnerability has been closed. If you are using @keystone-next/auth, we strongly recommend you upgrade to @keystone-6

info.name: WordPress Visual Form Builder <3.0.8 - Information Disclosure
info.author: random-robbie
info.description: WordPress Visual Form Builder plugin before 3.0.8 contains a information disclosure vulnerability. The plugin does not perform access control on entry form export, allowing an unauthenticated user to export the form entries as CSV files using the vfb-export endpoint.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could lead to the execution of arbitrary script code in the context of the victim's browser, potentially leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version of the WordPress Visual Form Builder plugin (3.0.8) or apply the vendor-supplied patch to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: WordPress Cookie Information/Free GDPR Consent Solution <2.0.8 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: 8arthur
info.description: WordPress Cookie Information/Free GDPR Consent Solution plugin prior to 2.0.8 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability via the admin dashboard. An attacker can inject arbitrary script in the browser of an unsuspecting user in the context of the affected site. This can allow the attacker to steal cookie-based authentication credentials and launch other attacks.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to inject malicious scripts into web pages viewed by users, leading to potential data theft, session hijacking, or defacement.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version of the WordPress Cookie Information/Free GDPR Consent Solution plugin (2.0.8 or higher) to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: WordPress All-in-one Floating Contact Form <2.0.4 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: DhiyaneshDK
info.description: WordPress All-in-one Floating Contact Form, Call, Chat, and 50+ Social Icon Tabs plugin before 2.0.4 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability on the my-sticky-elements-leads admin page.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to inject malicious scripts into the affected website, leading to potential data theft, session hijacking, or defacement.
info.remediation: Update the WordPress All-in-one Floating Contact Form plugin to version 2.0.4 or later to mitigate the vulnerability.

info.name: WooCommerce Stored Exporter WordPress Plugin < 2.7.1 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: dhiyaneshDk
info.description: The plugin was affected by a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in the woo_ce admin page.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute malicious scripts in the context of a victim's browser, potentially leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version of the WooCommerce Stored Exporter WordPress Plugin (2.7.1) or apply the vendor-provided patch to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: WordPress Accessibility Helper <0.6.0.7 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: dhiyaneshDK
info.description: WordPress Accessibility Helper plugin before 0.6.0.7 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability. It does not sanitize and escape the wahi parameter before outputting back its base64 decode value in the page.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could lead to unauthorized access, data theft, or defacement of the affected WordPress website.
info.remediation: Update to WordPress Accessibility Helper version 0.6.0.7 or later to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: WordPress Page Builder KingComposer <=2.9.6 - Open Redirect
info.author: akincibor
info.description: WordPress Page Builder KingComposer 2.9.6 and prior does not validate the id parameter before redirecting the user to it via the kc_get_thumbn AJAX action (which is available to both unauthenticated and authenticated users).
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to redirect users to malicious websites, leading to phishing attacks or the execution of further attacks.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version of KingComposer (>=2.9.7) to fix the open redirect vulnerability.

info.name: Photo Gallery by 10Web < 1.6.0 - SQL Injection
info.author: ritikchaddha,princechaddha
info.description: The Photo Gallery by 10Web WordPress plugin before 1.6.0 does not validate and escape the bwg_tag_id_bwg_thumbnails_0 parameter before using it in a SQL statement via the bwg_frontend_data AJAX action (available to unauthenticated and authenticated users), leading to an unauthenticated SQL injection
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary SQL queries, potentially leading to unauthorized access, data manipulation, or data leakage.
info.remediation: This is resolved in release 1.6.0.

info.name: CMP WordPress < 4.0.19 - Broken Access Control
info.author: pussycat0x
info.description: CMP WordPress plugin < 4.0.19 contains an arbitrary page layout change caused by insufficient access control in the coming soon page feature, letting unauthenticated users modify the layout, exploit requires no authentication.
info.impact: Unauthenticated users can alter the coming soon page layout, potentially misleading visitors or causing defacement.
info.remediation: Update to version 4.0.19 or later.

info.name: WordPress RSS Aggregator < 4.20 - Authenticated Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: DhiyaneshDK
info.description: WordPress RSS Aggregator < 4.20 is susceptible to cross-site scripting. The plugin does not sanitize and escape the id parameter in the wprss_fetch_items_row_action AJAX action before outputting it back in the response, leading to reflected cross-site scripting.
info.impact: An attacker with authenticated access can inject malicious scripts into the website, potentially leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Update WordPress RSS Aggregator plugin to version 4.20 or later to mitigate the vulnerability.

info.name: WordPress Permalink Manager <2.2.15 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: Akincibor
info.description: WordPress Permalink Manager Lite and Pro plugins before 2.2.15 contain a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability. They do not sanitize and escape query parameters before outputting them back in the debug page.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to inject malicious scripts into web pages viewed by users, leading to potential data theft, session hijacking, or defacement of the affected website.
info.remediation: Update to WordPress Permalink Manager version 2.2.15 or later to mitigate the vulnerability.

info.name: WordPress NewStatPress <1.3.6 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: r3Y3r53
info.description: WordPress NewStatPress plugin before 1.3.6 is susceptible to cross-site scripting. The plugin does not properly escape the whatX parameters before outputting them back in attributes. An attacker can inject arbitrary script in the browser of an unsuspecting user in the context of the affected site. This can allow the attacker to steal cookie-based authentication credentials and launch other attacks.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to inject malicious scripts into the affected website, leading to potential data theft, session hijacking, or defacement.
info.remediation: Fixed in version 1.3.6.

info.name: WordPress Plugin MapPress <2.73.4 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: edoardottt
info.description: WordPress Plugin MapPress before version 2.73.4 does not sanitize and escape the 'mapid' parameter before outputting it back in the "Bad mapid" error message, leading to reflected cross-site scripting.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to inject malicious scripts into web pages viewed by users, leading to potential data theft, session hijacking, or defacement of the affected website.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version of MapPress (2.73.4 or higher) or apply the vendor-provided patch to fix the XSS vulnerability.

info.name: WordPress Spider Calendar <=1.5.65 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: theamanrawat
info.description: WorsPress Spider Calendar plugin through 1.5.65 is susceptible to cross-site scripting. The plugin does not sanitize and escape the callback parameter before outputting it back in the page via the window AJAX action, available to both unauthenticated and authenticated users. An attacker can inject arbitrary script in the browser of an unsuspecting user in the context of the affected site. This can allow the attacker to steal cookie-based authentication credentials and launch other attacks.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to inject malicious scripts into the affected website, leading to potential data theft, session hijacking, or defacement.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version of WordPress Spider Calendar plugin (>=1.5.66) or apply the vendor-supplied patch to fix the XSS vulnerability.

info.name: HTML Email Template Designer < 3.1 - Missing Authorization on Rest Route
info.author: hexcat
info.description: The WP HTML Mail WordPress plugin is vulnerable to unauthorized access which allows unauthenticated attackers to retrieve and modify theme settings due to a missing capability check on the /themesettings REST-API endpoint found in the ~/includes/class-template-designer.php file, in versions up to and including 3.0.9. This makes it possible for attackers with no privileges to execute the endpoint and add malicious JavaScript to a vulnerable WordPress site.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to inject malicious scripts into the subject field of an email template, potentially leading to unauthorized access, data theft, or further compromise of the affected system.
info.remediation: Update to version 3.1 or later of the HTML Email Template Designer plugin to fix the vulnerability.

info.name: WordPress GDPR & CCPA <1.9.27 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: daffainfo
info.description: WordPress GDPR & CCPA plugin before 1.9.27 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability. The check_privacy_settings AJAX action, available to both unauthenticated and authenticated users, responds with JSON data without an "application/json" content-type, and JavaScript code may be executed on a victim's browser.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to inject malicious scripts into web pages viewed by users, leading to potential data theft, session hijacking, or defacement of the affected website.
info.remediation: Version 1.9.26 has added a CSRF check. This vulnerability is only exploitable against unauthenticated users.

info.name: Popup Builder < 4.0.7 - SQL Injection
info.author: r3Y3r53
info.description: The Popup Builder WordPress plugin before 4.0.7 does not validate and properly escape the orderby and order parameters before using them in a SQL statement in the admin dashboard, which could allow high privilege users to perform SQL injection.
info.impact: Authenticated administrators with high privileges can exploit SQL injection to extract database contents, potentially exposing sensitive WordPress data and user credentials.
info.remediation: update to v.4.0.7

info.name: WordPress WOOCS < 1.3.7.5 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: Akincibor
info.description: WordPress WOOCS plugin before 1.3.7.5 is susceptible to cross-site scripting. The plugin does not sanitize and escape the woocs_in_order_currency parameter of the woocs_get_products_price_html AJAX action, available to both unauthenticated and authenticated users, before outputting it back in the response. An attacker can inject arbitrary script in the browser of an unsuspecting user in the context of the affected site. This can allow the attacker to steal cookie-based authentication credentials and launch other attacks.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to inject malicious scripts into web pages viewed by users, leading to potential data theft, session hijacking, or defacement of the affected website.
info.remediation: Update the WordPress WOOCS plugin to version 1.3.7.5 or later to mitigate the XSS vulnerability.

info.name: Redirection for Contact Form 7 < 2.5.0 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: ritikchaddha
info.description: The Redirection for Contact Form 7 WordPress plugin before 2.5.0 does not escape a link generated before outputting it in an attribute, leading to a Reflected Cross-Site Scripting.
info.impact: Allows attackers to execute malicious scripts in the context of a user's browser session
info.remediation: Update Redirection for Contact Form 7 Plugin to the latest version to mitigate CVE-2022-0250

info.name: LearnPress <4.1.6 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: Akincibor
info.description: WordPress LearnPress plugin before 4.1.6 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability. It does not sanitize and escape the lp-dismiss-notice before outputting it back via the lp_background_single_email AJAX action.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to inject malicious scripts into web pages viewed by users, leading to potential data theft, session hijacking, or defacement.
info.remediation: Upgrade LearnPress to version 4.1.6 or later to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Microweber Information Disclosure
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: Microweber contains a vulnerability that allows exposure of sensitive information to an unauthorized actor in Packagist microweber/microweber prior to 1.2.11.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can lead to the exposure of sensitive data, such as user credentials or database information.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patch or update provided by the Microweber CMS vendor to fix the information disclosure vulnerability (CVE-2022-0281).

info.name: WordPress Ad Inserter <2.7.10 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: DhiyaneshDK
info.description: WordPress Ad Inserter plugin before 2.7.10 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability. It does not sanitize and escape the html_element_selection parameter before outputting it back in the page.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could lead to cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks, allowing attackers to execute malicious scripts in the context of the victim's browser.
info.remediation: Fixed in version 2.7.12

info.name: Zyxel - Authentication Bypass
info.author: SleepingBag945,Powerexploit
info.description: An authentication bypass vulnerability in the CGI program of Zyxel USG/ZyWALL series firmware versions 4.20 through 4.70, USG FLEX series firmware versions 4.50 through 5.20, ATP series firmware versions 4.32 through 5.20, VPN series firmware versions 4.30 through 5.20, and NSG series firmware versions V1.20 through V1.33 Patch 4, which could allow an attacker to bypass the web authentication and obtain administrative access of the device.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can bypass web authentication and obtain administrative access to Zyxel devices, potentially gaining complete control over firewalls and network security configurations.
info.remediation: Apply security updates provided by Zyxel for affected USG/ZyWALL, USG FLEX, ATP, VPN, and NSG series devices.

info.name: WordPress XML Sitemap Generator for Google <2.0.4 - Cross-Site Scripting/Remote Code Execution
info.author: Akincibor,theamanrawat
info.description: WordPress XML Sitemap Generator for Google plugin before 2.0.4 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution. It does not validate a parameter which can be set to an arbitrary value, thus causing cross-site scripting via error message or remote code execution if allow_url_include is turned on.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of these vulnerabilities could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the affected system or inject malicious scripts into web pages viewed by users.
info.remediation: Update the WordPress XML Sitemap Generator for Google plugin to version 2.0.4 or later to mitigate the XSS and RCE vulnerabilities.

info.name: WordPress NotificationX <2.3.9 - SQL Injection
info.author: edoardottt
info.description: WordPress NotificationX plugin prior to 2.3.9 contains a SQL injection vulnerability. The plugin does not sanitize and escape the nx_id parameter before using it in a SQL statement, leading to an unauthenticated blind SQL injection. An attacker can possibly obtain sensitive information, modify data, and/or execute unauthorized administrative operations in the context of the affected site.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary SQL queries, potentially leading to unauthorized access, data manipulation.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version of the WordPress NotificationX plugin (2.3.9 or higher) to mitigate the SQL Injection vulnerability.

info.name: Microweber Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: Microweber contains a reflected cross-site scripting in Packagist microweber/microweber prior to 1.2.11.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the context of the victim's browser, leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patch or upgrade to a version that has addressed the vulnerability.

info.name: WordPress Embed Swagger <=1.0.0 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: edoardottt
info.description: WordPress Embed Swagger plugin 1.0.0 and prior contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability due to insufficient escaping/sanitization and validation via the url parameter found in the ~/swagger-iframe.php file, which allows attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts onto the page.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the context of the victim's browser, potentially leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version of the WordPress Embed Swagger plugin (1.0.0) or apply a patch provided by the vendor.

info.name: WordPress TI WooCommerce Wishlist <1.40.1 - SQL Injection
info.author: edoardottt
info.description: WordPress TI WooCommerce Wishlist plugin before 1.40.1 contains a SQL injection vulnerability. The plugin does not sanitize and escape the item_id parameter before using it in a SQL statement via the wishlist/remove_product REST endpoint.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could lead to unauthorized access to the WordPress database.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version of the TI WooCommerce Wishlist plugin (1.40.1 or higher).

info.name: Gogs <0.12.6 - Remote Command Execution
info.author: theamanrawat
info.description: Gogs before 0.12.6 is susceptible to remote command execution via the uploading repository file in GitHub repository gogs/gogs. An attacker can execute malware, obtain sensitive information, modify data, and/or gain full control over a compromised system without entering necessary credentials.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands on the target system.
info.remediation: Fixed in version 0.12.6.

info.name: WordPress White Label CMS <2.2.9 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: random-robbie
info.description: WordPress White Label CMS plugin before 2.2.9 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability. It does not sanitize and validate the wlcms[_login_custom_js] parameter before outputting it back in the response while previewing.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary script code in the context of the affected website, potentially leading to session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Update to WordPress White Label CMS plugin version 2.2.9 or later to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Popup by Supsystic < 1.10.9 - Subscriber Email Addresses Disclosure
info.author: s4e-io
info.description: The Popup by Supsystic WordPress plugin before 1.10.9 does not have any authentication and authorisation in an AJAX action, allowing unauthenticated attackers to call it and get the email addresses of subscribed users
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can obtain email addresses of all subscribed users via an unprotected AJAX endpoint, potentially facilitating phishing campaigns or spam attacks.
info.remediation: Fixed in 1.10.9

info.name: WP Cerber Security, Anti-spam & Malware Scan < 8.9.6 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: s4e-io
info.description: The WP Cerber Security, Anti-spam & Malware Scan WordPress plugin before 8.9.6 does not sanitise the $url variable before using it in an attribute in the Activity tab in the plugins dashboard, leading to an unauthenticated stored Cross-Site Scripting vulnerability.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can inject stored XSS payloads via unsanitized URL parameters, which execute when authenticated administrators view the Activity tab, potentially stealing session cookies or performing administrative actions.
info.remediation: Upgrade to WP Cerber Security version 8.9.6 or later.

info.name: Mastodon Prototype Pollution Vulnerability
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: The GitHub repository mastodon/mastodon prior to 3.5.0 contains a Prototype Pollution vulnerability.
info.impact: Remote code execution
info.remediation: Apply the latest security patches and updates provided by the Mastodon project to mitigate the vulnerability.

info.name: WordPress Page Views Count <2.4.15 - SQL Injection
info.author: theamanrawat
info.description: WordPress Page Views Count plugin prior to 2.4.15 contains an unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability.  It does not sanitise and escape the post_ids parameter before using it in a SQL statement via a REST endpoint. An attacker can possibly obtain sensitive information, modify data, and/or execute unauthorized administrative operations in the context of the affected site.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could lead to unauthorized access to the WordPress database.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version of the WordPress Page Views Count plugin (2.4.15) to mitigate the SQL Injection vulnerability.

info.name: karma-runner DOM-based Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: pikpikcu
info.description: NPM karma prior to 6.3.14. contains a DOM-based cross-site Scripting vulnerability.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the context of the victim's browser, leading to potential data theft, session hijacking, or defacement of the affected website.
info.remediation: Upgrade to the latest version of karma-runner that includes proper input sanitization to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: Email Subscribers & Newsletters <= 5.3.1 - Authenticated SQL Injection
info.author: Shivam Kamboj
info.description: The Email Subscribers & Newsletters WordPress plugin before 5.3.2 does not correctly escape the `order` and `orderby` parameters to the `ajax_fetch_report_list` action, making it vulnerable to blind SQL injection attacks by users with roles as low as Subscriber. Further, it does not have any CSRF protection in place for the action, allowing an attacker to trick any logged in user to perform the action by clicking a link.
info.impact: Attackers can execute arbitrary SQL commands and access sensitive data, potentially leading to data breach or data tampering.
info.remediation: Update to version 5.3.2, or a newer patched version

info.name: MasterStudy LMS <2.7.6 - Improper Access Control
info.author: dwisiswant0,theamanrawat
info.description: WordPress MasterStudy LMS plugin before 2.7.6 is susceptible to improper access control. The plugin does not validate some parameters given when registering a new account, which can allow an attacker to register as an admin, thus potentially being able to obtain sensitive information, modify data, and/or execute unauthorized operations.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to gain unauthorized access to sensitive information, potentially compromising user data and system integrity.
info.remediation: Upgrade to the latest version of the MasterStudy LMS plugin (2.7.6 or higher) to fix the improper access control issue.

info.name: Popup Builder Plugin - SQL Injection and Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: ritikchaddha
info.description: The Popup Builder WordPress plugin before 4.1.1 is vulnerable to SQL Injection and Reflected XSS via the sgpb-subscription-popup-id parameter.
info.impact: Allows attackers to execute malicious SQL queries and inject scripts into web pages
info.remediation: Update Popup Builder Plugin to the latest secure version

info.name: Easy!Appointments <1.4.3 - Broken Access Control
info.author: francescocarlucci,opencirt
info.description: Easy!Appointments prior to 1.4.3 allows exposure of Private Personal Information to an unauthorized actor via the GitHub repository alextselegidis/easyappointments.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to gain unauthorized access to sensitive data or perform unauthorized actions.
info.remediation: Upgrade Easy!Appointments to version 1.4.4 or above to fix the Broken Access Control vulnerability.

info.name: Ditty (formerly Ditty News Ticker) < 3.0.15 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: r3Y3r53
info.description: The Ditty (formerly Ditty News Ticker) WordPress plugin before 3.0.15 is affected by a Reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability.
info.impact: Authenticated attackers can inject malicious JavaScript via the tab parameter, potentially stealing administrator session cookies or performing administrative actions.
info.remediation: upgrade to v.3.0.15

info.name: WordPress E2Pdf <1.16.45 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: theamanrawat
info.description: WordPress E2Pdf plugin before 1.16.45 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability. The plugin does not sanitize and escape some of its settings, even when the unfiltered_html capability is disallowed. An attacker can inject arbitrary script in the browser of an unsuspecting user in the context of the affected site, making it possible to steal cookie-based authentication credentials and launch other attacks.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to inject malicious scripts into web pages viewed by users, leading to potential data theft, session hijacking, or defacement of the affected website.
info.remediation: Update the WordPress E2Pdf plugin to version 1.16.45 or later to mitigate the vulnerability.

info.name: Atlassian Jira Seraph - Authentication Bypass
info.author: DhiyaneshDK
info.description: Jira Seraph allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication by sending a specially crafted HTTP request. This affects Atlassian Jira Server and Data Center versions before 8.13.18, versions 8.14.0 and later before 8.20.6, and versions 8.21.0 and later before 8.22.0. This also affects Atlassian Jira Service Management Server and Data Center versions before 4.13.18, versions 4.14.0 and later before 4.20.6, and versions 4.21.0 and later before 4.22.0.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can lead to unauthorized access to sensitive information, modification of data, and potential disruption of business operations.
info.remediation: Ensure you are using the latest version and that all security patches have been applied.

info.name: Formcraft3 <3.8.28 - Server-Side Request Forgery
info.author: Akincibor,j4vaovo
info.description: Formcraft3 before version 3.8.2  does not validate the URL parameter in the formcraft3_get AJAX action, leading to server-side request forgery issues exploitable by unauthenticated users.
info.impact: An attacker can send crafted requests to the server, potentially leading to unauthorized access to internal resources or network scanning.
info.remediation: Upgrade to Formcraft3 version 3.8.28 or later to fix the SSRF vulnerability.

info.name: MapSVG < 6.2.20 - Unauthenticated SQLi
info.author: DhiyaneshDK
info.description: The MapSVG WordPress plugin before 6.2.20 does not validate and escape a parameter via a REST endpoint before using it in a SQL statement, leading to a SQL Injection exploitable by unauthenticated users.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can execute SQL injection via REST API endpoint to extract database contents or execute arbitrary commands, potentially compromising the entire WordPress database.
info.remediation: Upgrade to MapSVG version 6.2.20 or later.

info.name: WordPress Shareaholic <9.7.6 - Information Disclosure
info.author: atomiczsec
info.description: WordPress Shareaholic plugin prior to 9.7.6 is susceptible to information disclosure. The plugin does not have proper authorization check in one of the AJAX actions, available to both unauthenticated (before 9.7.5) and authenticated (in 9.7.5) users, allowing them to possibly obtain sensitive information such as active plugins and different versions (PHP, cURL, WP, etc.).
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to gain sensitive information from the target system.
info.remediation: Update the Shareaholic plugin to version 9.7.6 or later to fix the information disclosure vulnerability.

info.name: WordPress Contact Form 7 <1.3.6.3 - Stored Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: akincibor
info.description: WordPress Contact Form 7 before 1.3.6.3 contains an unauthenticated stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the Drag and Drop Multiple File Upload plugin. SVG files can be uploaded by default via the dnd_codedropz_upload AJAX action.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to inject malicious scripts into the website, potentially leading to unauthorized access, data theft, or defacement.
info.remediation: Update the WordPress Contact Form 7 plugin to version 1.3.6.3 or later to mitigate the vulnerability.

info.name: Microweber < 1.2.11 - Open Redirection
info.author: Farish
info.description: Open Redirect in Packagist microweber/microweber prior to 1.2.11.
info.impact: Attackers can redirect users to malicious websites through the redirect_to parameter, potentially facilitating phishing attacks or malware distribution.
info.remediation: Upgrade to Microweber version 1.2.11 or later.

info.name: WordPress Mapping Multiple URLs Redirect Same Page <=5.8 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: scent2d
info.description: WordPress Mapping Multiple URLs Redirect Same Page plugin 5.8 and prior contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability. It does not sanitize and escape the mmursp_id parameter before outputting it back in an admin page.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the context of the victim's browser, leading to potential session hijacking, defacement, or theft of sensitive information.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version of the WordPress Mapping Multiple URLs Redirect Same Page plugin (version 5.8 or higher) to mitigate this vulnerability.

info.name: WordPress Plugin WP Statistics <= 13.1.5 - SQL Injection
info.author: theamanrawat
info.description: The WP Statistics WordPress plugin is vulnerable to SQL Injection due to insufficient escaping and parameterization of the current_page_type parameter found in the ~/includes/class-wp-statistics-hits.php file which allows attackers without authentication to inject arbitrary SQL queries to obtain sensitive information, in versions up to and including 13.1.5.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can exploit time-based blind SQL injection to extract sensitive database contents including user credentials and statistics data.
info.remediation: Update wp-statistics plugin to version 13.1.6, or newer.

info.name: Wordpress Profile Builder Plugin Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: dhiyaneshDk
info.description: The Profile Builder User Profile & User Registration Forms WordPress plugin is vulnerable to cross-site scripting due to insufficient escaping and sanitization of the site_url parameter found in the ~/assets/misc/fallback-page.php file which allows attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts onto a pages that executes whenever a user clicks on a specially crafted link by an attacker. This affects versions up to and including 3.6.1..
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to inject malicious scripts into web pages viewed by users, leading to potential data theft, session hijacking, or defacement of the affected website.
info.remediation: Upgrade to version 3.6.5 or later.

info.name: uDraw <3.3.3 - Local File Inclusion
info.author: akincibor
info.description: uDraw before 3.3.3 does not validate the url parameter in its udraw_convert_url_to_base64 AJAX action (available to both unauthenticated and authenticated users) before using it in the file_get_contents function and returning its content base64 encoded in the response. As a result, unauthenticated users could read arbitrary files on the web server (such as /etc/passwd, wp-config.php etc).
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to access sensitive information, such as configuration files, credentials, or other sensitive data stored on the server.
info.remediation: Upgrade uDraw to version 3.3.3 or later to mitigate the vulnerability.

info.name: CommonsBooking < 2.6.8 - SQL Injection
info.author: theamanrawat
info.description: The plugin does not sanitise and escape the location parameter of the calendar_data AJAX action (available to unauthenticated users) before it is used in dynamically constructed SQL queries, leading to an unauthenticated SQL injection.
info.impact: Unauthenticated attackers can execute SQL injection via unsanitized AJAX parameters to extract database contents, potentially exposing sensitive WordPress data including user credentials.
info.remediation: Fixed in version 2.6.8

info.name: Microweber <1.2.11 - Information Disclosure
info.author: amit-jd
info.description: Microweber before 1.2.11 is susceptible to information disclosure. An error message is generated in microweber/microweber which contains sensitive information while viewing comments from load_module:comments#search=. An attacker can possibly obtain sensitive information, modify data, and/or execute unauthorized operations.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to gain unauthorized access to sensitive information.
info.remediation: Upgrade Microweber to version 1.2.11 or later to mitigate the vulnerability.

info.name: Microweber < 1.2.11 - CRLF Injection
info.author: ritikchaddha
info.description: CRLF Injection leads to Stack Trace Exposure due to lack of filtering at https://demo.microweber.org/ in Packagist microweber/microweber prior to 1.2.11.
info.impact: Attackers can inject CRLF sequences via the redirect_to parameter to set arbitrary cookies or inject additional HTTP headers, potentially facilitating session hijacking or cache poisoning attacks.
info.remediation: Upgrade to Microweber version 1.2.11 or later.

info.name: Microweber <1.2.11 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: tess,co5mos
info.description: Packagist prior to 1.2.11 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability via microweber/microweber. User can escape the meta tag because the user doesn't escape the double-quote in the $redirectUrl parameter when logging out.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to inject malicious scripts into web pages viewed by users, leading to potential data theft, session hijacking, or defacement of the affected website.
info.remediation: Upgrade Microweber CMS to version 1.2.11 or later, which includes a fix for this vulnerability.

info.name: WordPress Narnoo Distributor <=2.5.1 - Local File Inclusion
info.author: Veshraj
info.description: WordPress Narnoo Distributor plugin 2.5.1 and prior is susceptible to local file inclusion. The plugin does not validate and sanitize the lib_path parameter before being passed into a call to require() via the narnoo_distributor_lib_request AJAX action, and the content of the file is displayed in the response as JSON data. This can also lead to a remote code execution vulnerability depending on system and configuration.
info.impact: The vulnerability can lead to unauthorized access to sensitive files, potentially exposing sensitive information or allowing for further exploitation.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version of the WordPress Narnoo Distributor plugin (>=2.5.2) to mitigate the LFI vulnerability.

info.name: Rudloff alltube prior to 3.0.1 - Open Redirect
info.author: 0x_Akoko
info.description: An open redirect vulnerability exists in Rudloff/alltube that could let an attacker construct a URL within the application that causes redirection to an arbitrary external domain via Packagist in versions prior to 3.0.1.
info.impact: An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to redirect users to malicious websites, leading to potential phishing attacks or the download of malware.
info.remediation: Upgrade to version 3.0.1 or later to fix the open redirect vulnerability.

info.name: WordPress Master Elements <=8.0 - SQL Injection
info.author: theamanrawat
info.description: WordPress Master Elements plugin through 8.0 contains a SQL injection vulnerability. The plugin does not validate and escape the meta_ids parameter of its remove_post_meta_condition AJAX action, available to both unauthenticated and authenticated users, before using it in a SQL statement. An attacker can possibly obtain sensitive information, modify data, and/or execute unauthorized administrative operations in the context of the affected site.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary SQL queries, potentially leading to unauthorized access, data leakage, or further compromise of the WordPress site.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version of WordPress Master Elements plugin (>=8.1) to mitigate the SQL Injection vulnerability.

info.name: GitLab CE/EE - Information Disclosure
info.author: GitLab Red Team
info.description: GitLab CE/EE is susceptible to information disclosure. An attacker can access runner registration tokens using quick actions commands, thereby making it possible to obtain sensitive information, modify data, and/or execute unauthorized operations. Affected versions are from 12.10 before 14.6.5, from 14.7 before 14.7.4, and from 14.8 before 14.8.2.
info.impact: An attacker can gain access to sensitive information stored in GitLab.
info.remediation: Apply the necessary patches or updates provided by GitLab to fix the vulnerability.

info.name: Infographic Maker iList < 4.3.8 - SQL Injection
info.author: theamanrawat
info.description: The Infographic Maker WordPress plugin before 4.3.8 does not validate and escape the post_id parameter before using it in a SQL statement via the qcld_upvote_action AJAX action (available to unauthenticated and authenticated users), leading to an unauthenticated SQL Injection.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could lead to unauthorized access, data leakage, and potential compromise of the WordPress site.
info.remediation: Fixed in version 4.3.8

info.name: WordPress Simple Link Directory <7.7.2 - SQL injection
info.author: theamanrawat
info.description: WordPress Simple Link Directory plugin before 7.7.2 contains a SQL injection vulnerability. The plugin does not validate and escape the post_id parameter before using it in a SQL statement via the qcopd_upvote_action AJAX action, available to unauthenticated and authenticated users. An attacker can possibly obtain sensitive information, modify data, and/or execute unauthorized administrative operations in the context of the affected site.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could lead to unauthorized access, data leakage, and potential compromise of the WordPress site.
info.remediation: Update to the latest version of WordPress Simple Link Directory plugin (7.7.2 or higher) to mitigate the SQL injection vulnerability.

info.name: WordPress Loco Translate < 2.6.1 - Cross-Site Scripting
info.author: 0x_Akoko
info.description: Loco Translate WordPress plugin before 2.6.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability caused by improper removal of inline events from source translation strings, allowing authenticated users to inject arbitrary JavaScript payloads.
info.impact: Attackers can execute arbitrary JavaScript in the context of the admin panel, potentially leading to session hijacking or defacement.
info.remediation: Update to version 2.6.1 or later.

info.name: Users Ultra <= 3.1.0 - SQL Injection
info.author: theamanrawat
info.description: The Users Ultra WordPress plugin through 3.1.0 fails to properly sanitize and escape the data_target parameter before it is being interpolated in an SQL statement and then executed via the rating_vote AJAX action (available to both unauthenticated and authenticated users), leading to an SQL Injection.
info.impact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary SQL queries, potentially leading to unauthorized accessand data leakage.
info.remediation: Update to Users Ultra version 3.1.0 or later to mitigate this vulnerability.
